jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

The Senior Integrated Content Strategist, B2B owns the integrated content strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B accounts and sets the strategic direction and execution of deliverables. This role operates across the full integrated content ecosystem: thought leadership, sales enablement, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks — all engineered to move a considered, multi-stakeholder buyer through a long B2B sales cycle. Senior Strategists build and defend content roadmaps directly with C-level stakeholders, translating pipeline and revenue goals into a clear content thesis that internal teams and client executives can rally behind. This is a strategist who thinks in systems: mapping content audits to the buyer journey, running audience research and stakeholder interviews to surface what actually moves a B2B deal forward, and adapting the roadmap as account performance and market signals shift. They bring product-level thinking to the content offering itself; proposing new formats and approaches before clients ask. They will also mentor and uplevel the strategists and writers who support their accounts. They are equally fluent identifying the single biggest content opportunity in a client's funnel and articulating why it matters in a room full of VPs and CMOs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end integrated content strategy and execution across thought leadership articles, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks for a portfolio of B2B accounts
  • Lead content audits mapped to the B2B buyer journey, using audience research, market analysis, and direct stakeholder and customer interviews to identify where content is and isn't driving pipeline
  • Set the strategic direction for each account's content roadmap, aligning every deliverable to client revenue and pipeline goals rather than treating content as a standalone output
  • Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem to benefit your department's objectives
  • Ensure timely delivery of all Integrated Content workflows, maintaining 100% adherence to Power Digital's processes (Asana, Slack, Pulse)
  • Proactively surface strategic insights and business-critical updates to both internal and client teams, positioning yourself as the point of authority on the account's content direction
  • Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy
  • Lead cross-functional content initiatives, coordinating with Paid Media, SEO/AEO, Creative, and Sales teams to ensure content strategy operates as the connective tissue across channels
  • Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
  • Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
  • Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
  • Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
  • Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
  • On time for all deliverables & launches
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a B2B Integrated Content Marketing role with direct client-facing experience, ideally supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • A journalism or copywriting foundation is strongly preferred. This discipline underpins credible strategic recommendations and gives this person authority when writing or reviewing high-stakes B2B content
  • Advanced understanding of data analysis and data visualization utilizing tools such as (but not limited to): HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Figma, or Unbounce
  • Advanced, fluent proficiency with AI tools as a core part of the strategic workflow, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — used for research, ideation, drafting, and content operations at scale
  • Advanced knowledge of B2B Integrated Content strategy spanning thought leadership, lead magnets, sales enablement material, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, brand website copy, sales and conversion-focused landing pages, and brand messaging, with a focus on aligning every deliverable to business goals and revenue priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
  • Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers
  • Proactive, solution-oriented problem solver with a team-player mentality and a bias toward original thinking over templated execution
  • Exceptional presentation skills, with proven ability to present integrated content strategy and sales pitch presentations directly to C-suite executives, tailoring storytelling for the room and delivering actionable, defensible recommendations under executive scrutiny
  • Forward-thinking, product-level perspective on the content offering itself; someone who proposes new formats, services, and approaches rather than only refining what already exists

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Book Revenue per Employee: $30k
  • Client Retention: 90%
  • Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 90%
  • Range of the number of accounts (8-12)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Manage accounts with the highest workflow volume or complexity with positive feedback → primarily working on Enterprise and/or Growth accounts
  • Deep literacy of the full B2B marketing funnel and buyer journey, and command of the role Integrated Content plays in moving multi-stakeholder deals through it
  • Identifies the biggest Integrated Content opportunities based on client goals and pipeline priorities, and delivers a clear, defensible strategic roadmap for execution
  • Working with the team to delegate Integrated Content tasks and receive them back with enough time to review so that you are always hitting deadlines in regards to client workflow with minimal errors (no typos, grammatical issues). Strong attention to detail with minimal review from Account Managers and Account Directors.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

jobs.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
jobs.excerpt: CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country.
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Team: People
Reports to: Head of People
Location: Remote (US)
Type: Full-time
Compensation: $150,000 - $175,000

Why This Role, Now

CodePath's hiring has outgrown the setup that got us here. Our next challenge is reimagining the hiring engine so it reliably turns our growth into great hires: a clear bar at every stage, enough qualified candidates in every pipeline, and a team equipped to move quickly without lowering the standard.

This is a net-new leadership role. You will own the talent acquisition function end to end, lead the team that runs it, and partner directly with our senior leaders on the hires that shape the company. You will report to the Head of People and sit at the center of how CodePath grows.

What You Will Own

This role runs at scale. CodePath is hiring across every function at once, engineering, product, growth, curriculum, delivery, and revenue, alongside seasonal instructor hiring and fellowship surge hiring that arrives fast and cannot miss. You will own two outcomes that have to hold together: time to hire, kept to a predictable and competitive window so we do not lose the people we want, and quality of hire, held to a bar that does not drop when the pressure is on. Everything below serves those two outcomes.

Own the hiring system. You will own the process end to end: the rubrics, the interview stages, the scorecards, the paid work sample every CodePath hire completes, and the gates that decide who advances. You will own the operating cadence that keeps searches on clock and the recruiting stack and metrics that run underneath it, pipeline health, conversion, time to offer, and source performance, and you will use them to decide where to invest. You will make sure every stage produces real signal, so that decisions are trustworthy, and you will keep hardening how we evaluate as AI changes what a strong candidate looks like.

Scale pipeline and throughput. You will drive the volume and quality of candidates across every search, from individual contributors to executive and program-launch surge hiring. The goal is straightforward and measurable: every search reaches a strong slate of finalists, sourced and inbound work together, our pipelines reflect the communities CodePath serves, and no role stalls for lack of qualified candidates.

Own the employer brand and candidate experience. You will own how CodePath shows up to candidates who are also evaluating us. On a mission-driven, nonprofit compensation model, the sell is trajectory, craft, and impact rather than top-of-market cash, and it has to carry through every touchpoint from first outreach to offer. You will make that experience a reason strong people choose CodePath.

Lead and grow the talent team. You will manage a team of recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators across full-time and contract roles. You will set the operating rhythm, coach the team, decide where to add capacity, and build a staffing model that matches the hiring load rather than reacting to it.

Partner with the Head of People and leadership. You will turn company goals into a hiring plan, working with the Head of People and senior leaders on org design, leveling, and where headcount should go against what the organization can absorb. You will set talent priorities across competing searches, keep leadership honest about whether we are on track to build the teams the mission needs, and bring a point of view rather than a status report.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

In your first 90 days, you will learn our funnel from application to offer, meet every hiring manager, and diagnose where signal and volume break down today.

By six months, you will have a hiring process where each stage carries a defined purpose and a clear bar, interviewers are trained and accountable for a specific signal, and hiring managers engage on a predictable cadence.

By the end of your first year, open roles consistently reach strong finalist slates, time to hire is under control because the process produces good decisions rather than fast ones, and CodePath has a talent function that scales with the organization instead of straining against it.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in talent acquisition, including several years leading a recruiting team through a period of significant growth.
  • You have built or rebuilt a hiring process, not just run one. You can point to specific changes you made to rubrics, interview design, or gating, and the outcomes they produced.
  • You lead with data. You know your funnel math, you can name your conversion rates by stage, and you use them to decide where to invest.
  • You hold a high bar on quality and can defend it under pressure to move faster. You understand that compressing a process that is not yet producing good signal only leads to worse decisions sooner.
  • You are a strong people manager. You coach recruiters to raise their game, and you build teams that own their work.
  • You partner well with executives and hiring managers. You can push back with respect, hold the line on process, and keep senior stakeholders aligned.
  • You use AI as a genuine multiplier for the mechanical parts of recruiting, and you have a clear view of where human judgment should stay in the loop.

Requirements

  • Experience hiring across technical and non-technical functions at once (engineering, product, growth, operations).
  • Fluency with Greenhouse, Gem, and LinkedIn Recruiter (standard recruiting stack).
  • Experience in a high-growth startup.
  • A track record of building always-on talent pools and an employer brand that draws candidates in.

How We Work

We recruit AI-first. AI clears the busywork so that human judgment on candidates gets more attention, not less. We expect you to adopt and improve these tools, and to have a view on where they help and where they do not belong. We value people who pick up new tools on their own because they want to work better, not because someone told them to.

Why Join

You will take a function that got CodePath this far and reimagine it for a much larger scale, with the mandate and the executive support to do it right. Your work will directly determine the caliber of people who carry CodePath's mission forward, which means it will determine how many students reach a career in tech that would otherwise be out of reach.

Compensation

CodePath standardizes salaries by level, no matter where you live. Salary within this band is determined by the relevant experience and skills you demonstrate through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position, work from anywhere in the U.S. CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 to Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings
Pay range
$150,000—$175,000 USD

A day in the life:

The Senior Integrated Content Strategist, B2B owns the integrated content strategy for a portfolio of complex B2B accounts and sets the strategic direction and execution of deliverables. This role operates across the full integrated content ecosystem: thought leadership, sales enablement, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks — all engineered to move a considered, multi-stakeholder buyer through a long B2B sales cycle. Senior Strategists build and defend content roadmaps directly with C-level stakeholders, translating pipeline and revenue goals into a clear content thesis that internal teams and client executives can rally behind. This is a strategist who thinks in systems: mapping content audits to the buyer journey, running audience research and stakeholder interviews to surface what actually moves a B2B deal forward, and adapting the roadmap as account performance and market signals shift. They bring product-level thinking to the content offering itself; proposing new formats and approaches before clients ask. They will also mentor and uplevel the strategists and writers who support their accounts. They are equally fluent identifying the single biggest content opportunity in a client's funnel and articulating why it matters in a room full of VPs and CMOs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end integrated content strategy and execution across thought leadership articles, sales enablement materials, lead magnets, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, infographics, brand strategy, verbal identity, and messaging playbooks for a portfolio of B2B accounts
  • Lead content audits mapped to the B2B buyer journey, using audience research, market analysis, and direct stakeholder and customer interviews to identify where content is and isn't driving pipeline
  • Set the strategic direction for each account's content roadmap, aligning every deliverable to client revenue and pipeline goals rather than treating content as a standalone output
  • Enhance and optimize business operations through the deployment of AI technologies
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem to benefit your department's objectives
  • Ensure timely delivery of all Integrated Content workflows, maintaining 100% adherence to Power Digital's processes (Asana, Slack, Pulse)
  • Proactively surface strategic insights and business-critical updates to both internal and client teams, positioning yourself as the point of authority on the account's content direction
  • Stay ahead of B2B content marketing trends and AI-driven content practices, educating clients on recommended actions and future strategy
  • Lead cross-functional content initiatives, coordinating with Paid Media, SEO/AEO, Creative, and Sales teams to ensure content strategy operates as the connective tissue across channels
  • Independently manage a book of B2B client accounts, ensuring comprehensive strategic and operational coverage
  • Execute 100% of Integrated Content deliverables with high accuracy and quality (no errors that would yield a negative impact to revenue for clients)
  • Set informed content goals and forecasts based on historical client data and current audience needs, with the ability to adapt or re-forecast as market and account conditions shift
  • Lead communication with internal and client teams including C-level stakeholders
  • Power Circuit Completion & Adoption on applicable accounts
  • On time for all deliverables & launches
  • Other applicable or related duties as assigned

Role Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a B2B Integrated Content Marketing role with direct client-facing experience, ideally supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • A journalism or copywriting foundation is strongly preferred. This discipline underpins credible strategic recommendations and gives this person authority when writing or reviewing high-stakes B2B content
  • Advanced understanding of data analysis and data visualization utilizing tools such as (but not limited to): HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Figma, or Unbounce
  • Advanced, fluent proficiency with AI tools as a core part of the strategic workflow, specifically Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity — used for research, ideation, drafting, and content operations at scale
  • Advanced knowledge of B2B Integrated Content strategy spanning thought leadership, lead magnets, sales enablement material, whitepapers, research reports, one-sheeters, brochures, brand website copy, sales and conversion-focused landing pages, and brand messaging, with a focus on aligning every deliverable to business goals and revenue priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to set strategy including defining the content thesis for an account and defending it under scrutiny
  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, and organizational skills for strategy planning, task delegation, and reviewing deliverables across a high-volume, high-complexity account load
  • Ability to provide positive and constructive feedback to team members supporting on accounts, with proven experience training and upleveling other strategists or writers
  • Proactive, solution-oriented problem solver with a team-player mentality and a bias toward original thinking over templated execution
  • Exceptional presentation skills, with proven ability to present integrated content strategy and sales pitch presentations directly to C-suite executives, tailoring storytelling for the room and delivering actionable, defensible recommendations under executive scrutiny
  • Forward-thinking, product-level perspective on the content offering itself; someone who proposes new formats, services, and approaches rather than only refining what already exists

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Retention: 90%
  • Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 90%

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Manage accounts with the highest workflow volume or complexity with positive feedback → primarily working on Enterprise and/or Growth accounts
  • Deep literacy of the full B2B marketing funnel and buyer journey, and command of the role Integrated Content plays in moving multi-stakeholder deals through it
  • Identifies the biggest Integrated Content opportunities based on client goals and pipeline priorities, and delivers a clear, defensible strategic roadmap for execution
  • Working with the team to delegate Integrated Content tasks and receive them back with enough time to review so that you are always hitting deadlines in regards to client workflow with minimal errors (no typos, grammatical issues). Strong attention to detail with minimal review from Account Managers and Account Directors.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one

jobs.description:
Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA)

Remote | Chiropractic Clinic | 30 Hours/Week |$6/hour
performance-based increase after 6 months

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Medical Virtual Assistant (MVA) to support the overall operational health of a busy healthcare clinic. This role is ideal for someone who is very sharp, proactive, detail-oriented, emotionally intelligent, and able to take ownership of important clinic workflows with minimal supervision.

This is not a basic task-following role. The ideal candidate must be able to think ahead, identify operational gaps, take initiative, and help remove administrative and billing-related tasks from the provider's plate.

We are looking for someone with excellent English communication skills, strong executive presence, high accountability, and the ability to build a trust-based working relationship with the provider and care team.

Key Responsibilities

Insurance Verification

Verify patient insurance after the patient checks in, typically around 15 minutes after the scheduled appointment time. Ensure all insurance information is accurate, updated, and properly documented.

Denied Claims Management

Review denied claims, identify denial reasons, and assist with claim reprocessing. Track issues, follow up on missing information, and help prevent repeat claim errors.

EOB Processing

Review and process Explanation of Benefits documents. Help organize, validate, and clear EOB backlogs while ensuring billing and insurance documentation is accurate.

Patient Balance Resolution

Review outstanding insurance balances and patient account issues. Track unresolved balances, identify the source of the issue, and coordinate next steps for resolution.

Claims Processing

Support claims-related workflows, including Cigna and Veterans Affairs claims. Ensure claims are reviewed, tracked, and escalated when necessary.

Payment Coordination

Assist with vendor payment coordination, including check payments when needed. Ensure payment-related tasks are completed accurately and on time.

SOAP Note Monitoring

Monitor SOAP note completion, accuracy, and compliance. Track missing, incomplete, or delayed documentation and communicate concerns appropriately.

Appointment Tracking

Track missed appointments, canceled appointments, and scheduling trends. Identify patterns that may affect clinic revenue, patient flow, or provider productivity.

Reports and Operational Tracking

Prepare reports on outstanding balances, missed appointments, canceled appointments, EOB backlog, denied claims, and other operational metrics. Reports should include clear insights and practical recommendations when needed.

Team Coordination

Support smooth communication between the provider, care team, and administrative staff. Help ensure updates are clearly shared, priorities are followed through, and important tasks are not missed.

Operational Support

Proactively identify workflow gaps, billing concerns, documentation delays, scheduling issues, and patient account problems. Recommend practical solutions to improve clinic efficiency.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant

  • Experience supporting a US healthcare practice

  • Experience with insurance verification, EOBs, claims, denied claims, patient balances, or billing support

  • Exposure to CPT and ICD-10 codes

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Strong executive presence and professional communication style

  • Must be a Mac OS user

  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Proven leadership, ownership, or high-accountability experience in a previous role

Required Soft Skills

  • Proactive and able to anticipate needs before being asked

  • Highly detail-oriented with billing, documentation, and reporting tasks

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

  • Emotionally intelligent and patient when working with a busy provider

  • Confident, professional, and organized in communication

  • Able to take personal responsibility for assigned work

  • Resourceful and self-motivated when learning new workflows

  • Trustworthy, dependable, and comfortable handling sensitive information

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience supporting a chiropractic clinic

  • Experience with Cigna or Veterans Affairs claims

  • Experience clearing EOB or billing backlogs

  • Experience preparing operational or billing reports

  • Experience mentoring, training, or supporting new team members

  • Experience working closely with a clinic owner, provider, or executive-level leader

Schedule and Compensation

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday

  • Hours: 6 hours per day, 30 hours per week

  • Rate: $6 per hour

  • Work Setup: Remote

  • Device Requirement: Mac OS required

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who does not wait to be told every step. This person should be observant, organized, and confident enough to identify what needs attention.

They should be able to manage detailed billing and administrative tasks while also thinking about the bigger picture of clinic operations. The right candidate will be sharp, emotionally intelligent, highly reliable, and capable of becoming a trusted operational support partner for the provider and care team.

As Principal Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will be the most senior individual contributor on a team of about fifteen engineers, setting the technical direction for the product and leading its largest, most consequential projects from idea to customer.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will shape that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a technical leadership role, not a management role. You will work directly with engineering and product leaders to form the roadmap, then lead engineers across sub-teams to execute it. You will stay hands-on: you write and review code every week, and the hardest problems land on your desk first.

What the team owns

  • Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).
  • The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.
  • Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.
  • Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do

  • Set the technical direction for Chainguard Containers: the architecture of the build pipeline, the registry, and the adoption tooling over the next one to three years, written down and defended in the open.
  • Form the roadmap with engineering and product leaders, then execute it. Turn ambiguous business goals into sequenced, staffed technical plans, and own the delivery of the largest multi-team projects from concept through production and adoption.
  • Make and own the trade-offs that shape the product: build versus buy, when to re-platform and when not to, what to cut to hit a date. Write the decision down and bring dissenting engineers along.
  • Lead through other engineers. Set the design bar, review the designs and code that matter most, and grow the Staff and Senior engineers around you into the next generation of technical leaders.
  • Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and set the standard for how the whole team uses them safely as volume grows.
  • Follow a problem wherever it goes: another team's service, a customer escalation, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, and work across team and company boundaries to get ahead of planning cycles.
  • Represent Chainguard in the container and open source ecosystem: upstream work, standards conversations, talks, and the customer conversations where credibility is the product.
  • Keep the systems you own healthy: observability, on-call, and the structural fixes that stop whole classes of incidents.

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, including several years as the technical lead of large, multi-team projects at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.
  • Closely relevant experience in what we do: container images, container registries and the OCI image format (Open Container Initiative, the standard for container images and registries), Linux distributions or package management, build systems, or software supply chain security.
  • Known in the field. Your work is visible outside your employer: open source you maintain, standards you helped shape, talks or writing that other engineers cite, or systems the industry knows you built.
  • A track record of technical leadership without authority: you have set direction for a team you did not manage, and the team delivered.
  • Experience forming and executing roadmaps with engineering and product leaders, including saying no, re-sequencing, and holding a date.
  • Judgment on trade-offs at the product level. You have made calls that moved a company's roadmap, and you can show what you gave up and why.
  • A systems thinker who designs for the whole path, from upstream source through build, signing, distribution, and the customer's runtime, and who sees second-order effects before they land.
  • High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you unblock others.
  • AI-native in how you build and lead. You use agentic coding tools daily and you have changed how a team works because of them.
  • Architectural depth in Go: you can design a Go service from scratch, plus strong API design, databases and caching, and cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS.
  • Low ego. You do what you say and say what you do, and you communicate early when the news is bad.
  • Excellent written English and experience leading on a distributed, remote-first team.

Nice to haves

  • Deep software supply chain security background: SBOMs (software bill of materials), Sigstore signing, or SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for build integrity).
  • Maintainer of, or significant contributor to, Chainguard's open-source tools (Wolfi, apko, melange) or neighboring projects such as containerd, Kubernetes, or OCI specifications.
  • Experience taking a product from early customers to broad adoption.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.
  • A non-traditional path into engineering. We value people who learned by building.

Location

Remote. United States preferred; Open to Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.

Explore Our Work

Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.

  • Chainguard Academy
Base Salary Range

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst and strategist who can independently own the full arc of an engagement — from framing the problem through delivering a clear, actionable plan — while building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.

In this role, you will work as the lead analyst on a cross-functional team, driving discovery, shaping recommendations, and facilitating high-impact client sessions that turn ambiguity into direction. You'll collaborate closely with strategists, designers, engineers, and delivery leads, and bring the experience and judgment to navigate complexity, competing priorities, and high-stakes decisions with confidence.

Why This Role Matters

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Lead AI and digital strategy engagements end-to-end, from opportunity discovery and problem framing through prioritization, roadmap creation, and pilot planning
  • Map customer journeys, operational workflows, and decision points to identify where automation, AI, and digital solutions create measurable business lift
  • Build and present compelling business cases that quantify value, define KPIs, and align executive and operational stakeholders on what success looks like
  • Produce lightweight prototypes, agent demonstrations, and proof-of-concept experiences that make strategy tangible and testable for clients
  • Partner with client SMEs to encode institutional knowledge into AI-ready assets including prompt libraries, evaluation examples, and retrieval corpora
  • Define practical governance frameworks aligned to the client's risk posture covering responsible AI principles, privacy, human-in-the-loop controls, and escalation paths
  • Shrink feedback loops by testing ideas early with real users and operational teams, iterating based on evidence rather than assumptions
  • Translate between business and technical teams, ensuring strategy connects cleanly to delivery across design, data, engineering, and change management
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and Figma AI — and agentic frameworks where relevant — to move faster than traditional consulting cycles

Collaboration & Communication

  • Independently lead high-impact client sessions including executive briefings, ideation workshops, and process redesign sprints that move groups from ambiguity to a shared plan
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, serving as a reliable, consultative partner throughout the engagement
  • Communicate complex findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead prioritization and scoping decisions by balancing business value, feasibility, risk, and delivery timelines
  • Frame every engagement in terms of outcomes and impact, pushing back on solution-first thinking where needed
  • Begin mentoring junior analysts, sharing knowledge and supporting their growth in craft and client skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, product strategy, or a related role
  • Deep understanding of AI concepts including LLMs, RAG, copilots, agents, evaluation frameworks, and responsible AI principles
  • Demonstrated ability to lead discovery and strategy end-to-end including stakeholder interviews, journey mapping, opportunity sizing, prioritization, and roadmap creation
  • Experience creating executive-ready narratives and aligning senior stakeholders across business and IT
  • Strong applied experience with AI tools for strategy, prototyping, and productivity (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI)
  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, agent workflows, and lightweight AI prototyping
  • Experience independently facilitating workshops and working sessions that move groups to clarity quickly
  • Practical understanding of what it takes to move from pilot to scale including data readiness, change management, adoption, and governance
  • Familiarity with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, AWS Strands)
  • Experience in a consulting or client-facing environment is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

  • Define best practices for version-controlled data transformations, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, code review, automated testing, and environment promotion.
  • Build a culture of data reliability by implementing standards for data contracts, schema management, lineage, observability, freshness, completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation.
  • Champion security, privacy, access control, governance, retention, and compliance requirements throughout the data lifecycle.

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

About the Team

CircleCI’s Talent Acquisition team is a high-performing team supporting a dynamic, high-growth technology environment. We partner closely with leaders across the business to attract exceptional talent, solve complex hiring challenges, and build the teams that drive CircleCI forward.

Our team values autonomy, ownership, continuous improvement, and meaningful impact. We operate with a high degree of trust and expect each person to take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and bring practical solutions to the business.

About the Role

As a GTM Recruiter, you’ll lead full-cycle recruiting across Sales, Support/Field Engineering, Marketing, and some G&A functions. You’ll partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to hire talent across a broad range of roles and levels.

This is a highly visible role that requires hands-on recruiting with business partnership. You’ll apply proven recruiting strategies, build strong talent pipelines, advise stakeholders on market realities, and keep searches moving through shifting priorities and competing demands.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting process across GTM with a focus on Sales, spanning individual contributors through management.
  • Execute targeted recruiting strategies, including proactive sourcing, market mapping, and talent pipeline development, using AI-assisted research and sourcing tools to expand reach and move faster.
  • Build trusted partnerships with hiring managers and senior leaders, translating business priorities into actionable recruiting plans and informed hiring recommendations.
  • Keep searches moving by setting clear expectations with hiring teams, navigating competing priorities, and following up for timely decisions.
  • Advise hiring teams on talent availability, market dynamics, compensation expectations, and the trade-offs between speed, quality, and business needs.
  • Use recruiting and AI-powered market insights consistently to evaluate funnel performance, identify bottlenecks, and continuously improve recruiting processes and outcomes.
  • Independently prioritize a dynamic portfolio of searches, taking ownership of challenges and implementing practical solutions with minimal oversight.
  • Leverage AI and automation to streamline recruiting workflows, reduce manual work, and improve efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight and responsible data practices.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4-6 years of recruiting experience, with a strong track record across Sales and broader Go-to-Market functions.
  • Experience recruiting commercial talent and assessing candidates across different roles and levels.
  • Strong negotiation skills and experience navigating complex compensation packages, including commission-based structures and sales incentives.
  • Ability to build credibility with senior stakeholders, offer candid input constructively, and keep searches accountable without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong business awareness and an understanding of how recruiting supports organizational goals, market realities, and commercial priorities.
  • A high degree of ownership, initiative, and adaptability, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing demands, and drive outcomes independently.
  • Strong communication, prioritization, and analytical skills, including the ability to use recruiting metrics and market insights to guide decisions.
  • Practical AI fluency, including experience applying AI tools to improve recruiting effectiveness, automate repetitive tasks, and build more efficient workflows.

Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience recruiting within B2B SaaS, developer tools, infrastructure, DevOps, or adjacent technology markets.
  • Experience supporting rapidly evolving Go-to-Market organizations in a lean or high-growth environment.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

About CircleCI

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI

  • Job descriptions and messaging: AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.
  • Application review: For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.
  • Interview notes: With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.
  • Outreach: AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About Engine

At Engine, we're transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we're here to change that.

We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That's why we're building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we're looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In's Best Places to Work.

About the Role

As Partner Success Manager, Technology Partners, you will own a portfolio of Engine's technology and distribution partner relationships: OTAs, GDS partners, connectivity and channel partners. You will be the day-to-day technical and commercial point of contact responsible for partner health, integration performance, and revenue growth across your book.

This is a technical account management role. You will run the operating rhythm of your accounts: keeping integrations healthy and content accurate, resolving issues at the root cause with partner and Engine engineering teams, bringing newly signed connections live, and growing the revenue that flows through each partner. Your mandate is to grow and operate the partnerships in your book.

The role needs technical fluency, commercial awareness, and strong organizational discipline. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Connectivity, Pricing, Operations, and Finance to turn partner issues and opportunities into delivered outcomes.

You will work with both engineering and commercial leaders at partner companies. We're looking for someone who can debug a failing booking flow with a partner's engineers in the morning and run a business review with their commercial team in the afternoon.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of technology and distribution partner accounts, including OTAs, GDS partners, connectivity and channel partners, as the primary relationship owner and day-to-day technical and commercial point of contact
  • Monitor integration and API health across your book (availability and response times, error rates, throughput against rate limits, look-to-book, booking success) and act before degradation reaches travelers
  • Own content quality with each partner: availability and rate accuracy, property and room mapping, and data quality. Find where content is missing, stale, and drive the fix
  • Lead incident escalation for partner-related issues. Triage severity and blast radius, coordinate with partner and Engine engineering teams, work out whether the fault sits with Engine or the partner, and see root-cause analysis and corrective actions through to closure
  • Onboard and activate new connectivity sources and expanded scopes once signed: requirements, credentials and access, certification and testing, go-live, and early monitoring. Hand off to steady state with clear success criteria
  • Grow revenue through your partners by improving conversion and booking reliability, expanding content coverage and use cases, and making sure connected content is live, competitive, and actually booked
  • Run the partner cadence: QBRs, technical and performance reviews, working sessions, and escalation paths. Hold both sides to agreed commitments
  • Translate partner capabilities, roadmap changes, and API version updates into clear technical requirements for Engine Product and Engineering, and represent Engine's needs in partners' roadmaps
  • Support leadership on commercial terms and renewals: prepare performance and volume analysis, model incentive and tier programs, track terms and obligations, and manage follow-through
  • Maintain accurate partner records, integration documentation, contacts, contract terms, and issue logs
  • Track developments in travel distribution and connectivity (API standards, distribution models, and partner platform changes) to inform partner conversations and internal priorities

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in technical account management, partner or integration management, solutions or implementation roles, or a similar partner-facing role at a travel technology, API, or platform business
  • Working technical fluency: comfortable reading API documentation, inspecting XML and JSON requests and responses, reviewing logs, and testing calls with tools like Postman. SQL, or comfort pulling and analyzing your own data, is strongly preferred
  • A working understanding of travel distribution architecture: how content moves between suppliers, CRS, channel managers, switches, GDSs, OTAs, and aggregators, and where it tends to break
  • Commercial account management instincts: you connect integration performance to revenue, find growth opportunities, and make a data-backed case for them
  • A track record of resolving complex, multi-party technical issues through structured triage, clear ownership, and disciplined follow-through
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, so you can manage several partner workstreams, incidents, and onboardings at the same time without dropping anything
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication with both technical and commercial audiences, including partner executives
  • Comfortable using AI and modern tools to streamline workflows, speed up diagnosis, and operate well in a fast-moving environment

jobs.title: AI Agent Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOrbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Orbis is building the agentic AI capability its mission support operations run on, and the AI Agent Engineer builds and operates it. Sixty percent of this role is common to every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis: designing, building, and deploying the multi-agent workflows behind triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing. The remaining forty percent is this role's focus — the cloud platform those workflows run on. This engineer owns the footprint across GCP, Cloudflare, and Azure, manages it as code, and holds its networking, security posture, and run cost to a standard that survives scrutiny as volume grows.

Travel: Occasional (up to 10%) to McLean, VA or team offsites as needed

Key Responsibilities — Common Core (60% of the Role)

Every AI Agent Engineer at Orbis, regardless of focus area, owns the following:

  • Design, build, and deploy agentic AI workflows. Architect and ship the multi-agent and automated workflows that run in production: triage, data retrieval, summarization, reporting, and escalation routing.
  • Translate in both directions. Explain to non-technical stakeholders what the systems do, where they are reliable, and where they are not, in terms those stakeholders can act on. Equally, take a process owner's plain-language description of how their work happens and turn it into a workflow specification that holds up.
  • Partner with process owners to build what they actually need. Work directly and iteratively with the colleagues who own a process so the resulting capability fits their operation rather than forcing them to fit it. Push back constructively when a stated requirement will not survive contact with production.
  • Keep the workflows reliable. Monitor what is running in production, diagnose failures across prompts, tools, data, and orchestration, and resolve them. Know which problems are yours to solve and when to bring in engineering.
  • Own the cost of execution. Track what your AI workloads cost to run. Identify where a tighter prompt, a caching layer, or a simple deterministic step delivers the same outcome, and keep those costs defensible as volume grows.
  • Set the quality bar for AI-assisted output. Define accuracy standards, human review checkpoints, and escalation criteria for the automated workflows, and build the checks that prove those standards are being met.
  • Document what you build. Author and maintain the runbooks and SOPs that allow others to operate and troubleshoot these workflows without you. Nothing lives only in one person's head.
  • Integrate across Orbis products. Work across Catalyst, Pulse, and Discovery, with engineering support where needed, so workflows can access and act on the data they require.
  • Deliver the reporting leadership and the team depend on. Build and maintain the outputs behind resolution rate, escalation rate, output accuracy, response time, and employee satisfaction, and turn the Senior Operations Manager's requirements into structured, recurring reports and data exports.
  • Close capability gaps and keep the practice current. Recognize when a need is not served by existing tooling, scope the gap clearly, and either build it or bring it to engineering and product with enough detail to act on. Track developments in agentic AI tooling and enterprise automation platforms, and form a defensible view on what is worth adopting, at what pace, and for which use cases.

Focus Area — Cloud Infrastructure (40% of the Role)

In addition to the common core above, this role owns the cloud infrastructure Orbis depends on — both the enterprise platform behind internal operations and the environments that support client delivery:

  • Design, deploy, and maintain the Orbis cloud footprint across GCP, AWS, Cloudflare, and Azure, spanning both enterprise workloads and client delivery environments.
  • Define and manage that footprint as infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible, reviewable, and recoverable.
  • Own networking, identity, and secrets handling for agent workloads, including the boundaries between environments and the audit of access.
  • Hold the security posture of the platform and keep it evidenced rather than asserted.
  • Track and control platform run cost across compute, inference, storage, and egress, and report it in terms leadership can act on.
  • Build and maintain the deployment and release path — CI/CD, environment promotion, rollback — so shipping an agent workflow is routine rather than an event.

Required Qualifications

Orbis weighs what a candidate has built over tenure or credentials. The following are true minimum requirements for this role:

  • Must have 5 years of proven experience translating user requirements into wireframes, workflows and such.
  • Must have 1-year proven experience utilizing Claude or similar commercial offering to build AI agents.
  • Demonstrated experience building a functioning multi-agent workflow, with the ability to walk through the design rationale, how the agents hand off work and share context, what broke, and how it was fixed
  • Practical command of prompt engineering, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool or function calling
  • Proven ability to explain technical work to non-technical audiences — describing a system's behavior, limits, and failure modes to a process owner or executive without hedging or retreating into jargon
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit requirements from stakeholders who cannot hand over a specification, and to reach a working solution regardless
  • Ability to troubleshoot agent workflows built on platforms such as Claude, GPT-class models, LangChain, AutoGen, or CrewAI, and to isolate whether a failure originates in the prompt, the tool, the data, or the orchestration
  • Working proficiency with APIs and sufficient scripting ability to build and debug workflows independently; software engineering experience is not required, but a JSON payload or a Python script must not be a blocker
  • Sound judgment about model output, including the discipline to state plainly when an output should not be trusted
  • Strong written communication. This role produces documentation, runbooks, and reports that program leads and executives rely on
  • Hands-on production experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or Cloudflare) and working familiarity with a second
  • Practical experience managing infrastructure as code using Terraform, Pulumi, or an equivalent
  • Working command of cloud networking, identity, and secrets management, and the ability to treat security posture and run cost as design constraints rather than afterthoughts

Desired Qualifications

Strong candidates will bring depth in one or more of the following. Do not screen yourself out for lacking items on this list.

  • 5-7 years experience in software development
  • Experience coding using Python
  • Cloud depth: Kubernetes or serverless runtimes at production scale; multi-cloud or cross-boundary deployment; cloud migration or consolidation work
  • Cost and governance: FinOps or formal cloud cost management practice; zero-trust architectures; federated access control models
  • Delivery and observability: owning CI/CD pipelines end to end; infrastructure monitoring, logging, and alerting for production workloads
  • Bridging technical and operational teams: prior work as a solutions consultant, technical program manager, forward-deployed engineer, or in a product-adjacent role
  • AI reliability practice: monitoring, evaluation, or observability tooling for AI systems in production; automated evaluations or regression checks for LLM-based workflows; human-in-the-loop review steps that maintain quality without creating bottlenecks
  • Process design: designing SOPs or escalation frameworks that hold up across multiple stakeholders
  • AI-assisted development tooling: working fluency with Claude, Copilot, or Cursor
  • Mission environment: operating within or supporting a government or defense program; OSINT, DIGINT, or intelligence analysis workflows and tradecraft; data governance concepts, federated access control models, or zero-trust architectures
  • Operating range: a track record of coming up to speed quickly on unfamiliar systems, and effectiveness in a distributed, multi-program environment with competing priorities

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
  • Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
  • Travel: Occasional (up to 10%) to McLean, VA or team offsites as needed

Orbis Benefits

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

Orbis Locations

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,

qualifications, and business need. Orbis does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Orbis complies with all applicable equal opportunity and non-discrimination laws in every jurisdiction in which we operate. Reasonable accommodation is available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.
