  • Automation and employee lifecycle: Design and improve onboarding, role changes, and offboarding across identity, devices, and SaaS tools. Use tools such as Okta Workflows, n8n, Python, and APIs to reduce manual work and make processes more reliable.

  • Continuous improvement: Assess our current systems, identify gaps, and turn findings into practical improvements. Investigate complex issues across connected services, address root causes, and follow through until changes are working well.

  • SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Establish clear practices for application setup, integrations, access requests, approvals, and access reviews.

  • Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Automate evidence collection where practical to support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2.

  • Project delivery and mentoring: Lead projects from scoping and technical design through rollout and handover. Coordinate dependencies, communicate risks and progress, and help colleagues grow through documentation, reviews, and knowledge sharing.

What you bring

  • Broad IT engineering experience: You have hands-on experience across identity, collaboration tools, endpoint management, and SaaS administration. You understand how these systems connect and can troubleshoot problems across them.

  • Depth in a core area: You bring strong expertise in at least one of Okta, Google Workspace, or JumpCloud, along with the ability to work across the others. We welcome different strengths; you do not need to be equally expert in all three.

  • Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption.

  • Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. You consider error handling, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

  • A track record of improvement: You can share examples of systems or processes you assessed, improved, and delivered, with clear results for employees or the IT team.

  • Proactive judgment and ownership: You work independently, make sound technical decisions, and know when to involve others. You can turn an unclear problem into a practical plan, explain trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome.

  • Security and compliance awareness: You have implemented controls such as access reviews, secure configurations, or device policies, and understand how to document and demonstrate that they work. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 is valuable.

  • Clear communication and collaboration: You work effectively in a fully remote team and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues across cultures. You share knowledge and help others become more effective.

  • Experience: Typically six or more years in IT engineering, systems administration, identity, or endpoint management, with increasing responsibility for technical decisions and project delivery. Equivalent experience matters more than a specific number of years.

Bonus points

  • Experience supporting both ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2, including automated evidence collection.

Where we hire

At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

How we hire

You can expect 4 interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. jobs.title: Senior Product Content Manager
jobs.excerpt: Taking part in a clinical trial can ask a lot of people, especially as trials become more complex.
jobs.description:
Taking part in a clinical trial can ask a lot of people, especially as trials become more complex. At Little Journey, we’re building Trial Flow, a participant support platform that makes that experience simpler, clearer and more supportive, helping participants and caregivers around the world feel prepared for what comes next. We work collaboratively, challenge our thinking and value people who can turn ideas into action. The Senior Product Content Manager will play a key role in ensuring our content supports the growth of the platform.

The Role

Content is a critical part of the Trial Flow experience. It helps participants understand what to expect, complete key actions and engage confidently throughout their clinical trial journey. Our content spans written, audio, video and product UI experiences for children, teenagers, caregivers and adult participants around the world.

In your role, you will lead our approach to content across the product, developing the strategy, standards and guardrails that enable us to deliver high-quality, effective content at scale, on time and on budget. You will work closely with Product, Delivery, Clinical, Design and other teams to align content priorities and approaches with participant needs, product goals and business priorities.

You will be accountable for the effectiveness of our end-to-end content capability, from how content is designed and generated through to clinical review, publishing and localisation. You will line manage the Content Co-ordination Manager and Localisation Manager, oversee the outputs of freelancers and other contributors, and work with internal subject matter experts to ensure content is accurate and effective.

This role is right for someone who enjoys setting direction and creating effective ways of working, but is equally comfortable getting stuck in when needed. You might experiment with AI prompts and workflows, shape product UI content, improve a process or tackle a complex content challenge yourself.

If you are looking for a primarily editorial or copywriting role where most of your time is spent creating content yourself or your background is primarily in Marketing content roles, this is unlikely to be the right role for you.

The role reports to the CPO and sits within the Product team. You will need to be hands on, and work closely with your direct reports in a small team.

This is a full-time role, either hybrid in Leeds or fully remote within the UK. We cannot sponsor visas to work in the UK.

Responsibilities

Content strategy and content experience

  • Develop and evolve our content strategy in collaboration with Product, Clinical, Discovery, Design, Commercial and other stakeholders, aligning participant needs, product strategy and business priorities.
  • Drive a commercially sustainable approach to content, maximising reuse and efficient adaptation while ensuring costs and margins inform pricing decisions.
  • Refine the principles, guidelines and guardrails to enable consistent, high-quality content decisions.
  • Evolve the content experience across Little Journey and Trial Flow, including educational, support, coping and product UI content.
  • Identify opportunities for content to improve participant outcomes, product engagement and customer value, working with Product and Design to incorporate these into product discovery and development.
  • Develop how we use AI alongside human expertise to generate and iterate high-quality content, experimenting with prompts, models and workflows while putting appropriate guardrails and clinical validation in place.

Content quality and delivery

  • Own Content Delivery, working closely with Delivery to ensure content is delivered on time, on budget and to our quality benchmarks.
  • Establish and maintain proportionate standards, governance and approval processes that ensure content is accurate, appropriate and consistent without creating unnecessary barriers to delivery.
  • Manage complex content lifecycles, ensuring content moves effectively from identified need through generation, expert review, publishing, delivery, versioning, and archival .
  • Provide content judgement where participant, clinical, product or commercial requirements need to be balanced.
  • Continuously improve how content is structured and delivered, using better processes, tooling, automation and reuse to increase efficiency and scalability.

Localisation

  • Be accountable for the effectiveness of our localisation capability and strategy, ensuring it delivers the required quality, scalability and cost-effectiveness as Little Journey grows internationally.
  • Set clear outcomes and priorities for localisation and support the Localisation Manager to deliver them.

Influencing and Collaboration

  • Line manage and develop your team, setting clear outcomes and enabling them to take ownership of delivery.
  • Work directly with client stakeholders where needed to align content plans, manage feedback and resolve content-related issues.
  • Commission and oversee freelancers and external contributors, ensuring clear briefs, expectations and quality of outputs.
  • Work closely with key internal stakeholders to create alignment around content priorities and decisions, ensuring content is championed across roadmaps, projects, engagements and company priorities.

Measurement and continuous improvement

  • Define appropriate measures of content effectiveness and operational metrics within Little Journey's existing data framework, connecting content performance to relevant company and product metrics.
  • Use participant feedback, product and behavioural data, operational insights and stakeholder input to identify and prioritise improvements.
  • Measure whether changes to content, localisation, tooling and ways of working are improving outcomes, quality, efficiency or cost.

Requirements

Required:

  • Significant and demonstrable experience developing and implementing content strategy for digital products or platforms.
  • Experience establishing content governance, standards and scalable content processes within the product function.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Design and subject matter experts to deliver high-quality content.
  • Practical experience using generative AI to create or iterate content, with the curiosity and confidence to experiment with prompts, models and workflows while applying appropriate quality controls.
  • Strong understanding of content lifecycle management.
  • Experience using user insights and data to improve content effectiveness.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and organisational skills.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience leading work through others, including setting direction, giving high-quality feedback and holding internal or external contributors accountable for outcomes.
  • Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive content principles.

Desirable:

  • Experience managing multilingual content and localisation.
  • Experience in clinical trials or another regulated industry.
  • Financial understanding of content creation or previous P&L or cost ownership
  • Experience with UX writing or information architecture.
  • Experience managing or configuring a Content Management System.
  • Experience designing content across broad age groups.
  • Understanding of behaviour change, patient education or health literacy principles.

Benefits

  • 28 days annual leave per year (plus public holidays)
  • £500 annual training budget  
  • £200 home working budget (one-off) 
  • Up to 6% pension match (salary sacrifice) 
  • EMI share options
  • Enhanced (family & parental) leave policies  

About Little Journey 

Little Journey was founded by Dr Chris Evans, a paediatric anaesthetist and researcher, and Sophie Copley, a human-centred product designer, with a shared ambition to improve how people are supported through complex experiences. What began by supporting children and families through healthcare has evolved into Trial Flow, our platform focused entirely on participant support in clinical trials.

Our mission is to make patient-centric participation the foundation of better research. We believe better support leads to better participation, and better participation leads to better research. As clinical trials become more complex, Trial Flow helps participants, families and sites navigate what is being asked of them, reducing avoidable burden and supporting better adherence, retention and trial outcomes.

Today, Little Journey is a Series A company with a team of around 30 to 40 people, working with pharmaceutical companies on clinical trials around the world. We care deeply about the people our work ultimately supports, and that shapes how we work together. We value honesty and integrity, trust people to take accountability, and make time to reflect, learn and improve.

Diversity & Inclusion 

We encourage people from all walks of life to apply and strive to eliminate unconscious bias in our recruitment process. We do not discriminate on ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or parental status or disability. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. If you need adjustments made to our application process, to help accommodate any disabilities, please let us know on

Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar, et bien d’autres.

Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.

En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

  1. Vous créez votre compte sur

  2. Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

  3. Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

  4. Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

  5. Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

  6. Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

  • Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?

Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.

Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.

About Sunrise Group

Sunrise Group is building the future of sleep health by combining breakthrough technology with expert care. We started in 2015 with a straightforward idea: sleep diagnosis should happen in the comfort of your own home, not in a hospital. To make that possible, we created a first-of-its-kind chin sensor, carefully validated through clinical research, reviewed by leading sleep experts, and cleared by the FDA.

Since then, Sunrise Group has grown from a single innovation into a complete sleep health company. We now design advanced diagnostic and treatment solutions, and we deliver care directly to patients through Dreem Health, our digital sleep clinic. By serving patients in all 50 states with reimbursed care, we are making sleep treatment more accessible, more personal, and much simpler than it has ever been.

Sunrise (Dreem Health) is a ~170-person digital health company building the best online sleep clinic. We help patients get diagnosed and treated for sleep apnea entirely from home: a medically certified at-home sleep test, teleconsultations with sleep physicians, and physician-supervised treatment and follow-up. Our engineering team builds the products that make this possible, from patient-facing web apps to the clinical tools our care teams use every day.

You will join at a moment where the engineering organization is scaling and needs a second Engineering Manager. You will lead 6 to 10 engineers across 2 to 3 product squads, reporting directly to the CTO. You own your squads: the people, the staffing, and the delivery, and you share product outcomes with your Product counterparts. Each squad has a Tech Lead who owns technical feasibility and task breakdown, supported by a transverse Principal Engineer. You are a technical manager: you stay close enough to the code and the designs to ask the right questions, push great engineering, and help your squads keep raising the bar.

What you will do :

  • Lead and develop a team of 6 to 10 engineers across 2 to 3 product squads. Run 1:1s, give honest feedback, own performance and promotion decisions, and build development plans against our engineering ladder
  • Own delivery for your squads: what gets committed, who works on what, and whether it lands. Challenge scope and dates with Product, with an explicit mandate to refuse commitments the team cannot sustainably meet
  • Protect long-term velocity: own the capacity allocation for tech health and platform quality
  • Hire: partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close engineers. Run technical interviews yourself and hold the hiring bar.
  • Raise the technical bar: stay close to the code and designs where it matters most (high-risk changes, new patterns, design docs, review quality), using AI tooling to navigate the codebase efficiently, and help your squads turn good engineering into great engineering.
  • Work closely with Tech Leads and the Principal Engineer, who own technical feasibility and task breakdown in their scope. Challenge them on ambition and approach, unblock them, and escalate structural risks early
  • Champion modern, AI-augmented engineering practices and continuous improvement of how the team works
  • Stay deeply immersed in product and business context: direct stakeholder relationships, presence in squad rituals, and manage cross-squad dependencies

What you will bring :

  • At least 3 years managing software engineers in a dedicated management role
  • 5+ years as a software engineer before moving into management, including senior-level ownership of production systems
  • Track record of shipping and operating production web products, with enough technical depth to challenge designs and estimates credibly (our stack: React, Django, GCP)
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Design in an empowered-squad model
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted engineering tooling, and opinionated about where it helps and where it does not
  • Fluent English (working language); French is a plus
  • Genuine interest in sleep, health, and helping people better understand and improve their well-being

Dreem Health / Sunrise is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds and are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels included and respected. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Our next chapter is the transition from email security to the Abnormal Behavioral AI platform, with multiple products across email, identity, and AI security. Kinesis, IAM

Proven real-time streaming experience with Apache Flink in

production

architectures

consistency

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Role summaryWe are looking for a Deployment DevOps Engineer to own and improve application deployment processes across environments. You will build and maintain deployment pipelines primarily using Octopus Deploy, GitHub, and Ansible, ensuring releases are automated, repeatable, secure, and reliable for production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end release and deployment lifecycle: build → package → deploy → verify → rollback
  • Develop and support Octopus Deploy projects, lifecycles, channels, variables, and deployment processes
  • Implement deployment automation with Ansible (playbooks/roles, inventories, idempotent changes)
  • Maintain Git-based release workflows in GitHub (branching, tagging, versioning, release notes)
  • Build/maintain CI pipelines in GitHub Actions (or existing tooling) to produce artifacts and trigger Octopus releases
  • Standardize deployment patterns across applications (templates, shared steps, reusable Ansible roles)
  • Manage environment configuration and secrets in a controlled way (variable sets, permissions, auditing)
  • Improve deployment safety: approvals, health checks, smoke tests, automated validation, and rollback strategies
  • Support production releases, troubleshoot deployment failures, and drive root-cause analysis
  • Maintain release documentation, runbooks, and change management practices
  • Collaborate with developers, QA, and operations to plan releases and reduce downtime

Required skills and experience
  • Experience as DevOps / Release / Deployment Engineer supporting production deployments

  • Strong working knowledge of GitHub (PR workflows, tagging/releases, permissions)
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts (artifact management, versioning, promotion between environments)
  • Administration and troubleshooting skills on Windows and/or Linux hosts used for deployments
  • Ability to diagnose deployment issues across app, OS, network, and configuration layers

Nice to have
  • Experience with Terraform and infrastructure provisioning
  • Scripting: PowerShell and/or Bash
  • Monitoring/observability basics (Prometheus/Grafana, logs) to validate releases
  • Experience with IIS/.NET deployments, Nginx, or reverse proxies (depending on stack)
  • Familiarity with container-based deployments (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Experience in managing VOIP components and protocols (SIP , FreeSwitch, OpenSIP, session border controllers)
  • Experience with load balancing components ( F5 LTM, F5 GTM)
  • Experience with administering AWS or Azure tenants
  • Experience with Virtualization platforms such as VMWare or HyperV

Bitmovin is a global Series-C SaaS scale-up that provides award-winning video streaming technology to world-renowned brands including Warner Bros. Discovery, BBC, Red Bull Media House, Hulu, and The New York Times, among many others.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive, flexible work environment where every team member can thrive. We move fast, try new things, and care deeply about the impact our work creates.

Why us?

Ready to roll up your sleeves and redefine what field marketing can do? We’re looking for a proactive Campaign & Field Marketing Manager to join our dynamic team and report directly to the VP Marketing. In this high-impact role, you’ll step up with full ownership - turning high-level strategy into standout campaigns, high-energy field activations, and truly unforgettable customer experiences that deliver real, measurable outcomes.

This role offers:

  • Strategic Impact: Own campaigns and field activations from concept to execution, directly influencing sales pipeline generation, customer engagement, and strategic account growth.
  • Global Event Ownership: Drive the marketing strategy and activation for up to five Tier 1 strategic global events per year across key hubs like the US, the Middle East, and Amsterdam - focusing on meaningful commercial outcomes and strategic impact without getting bogged down in logistical micro-management.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Marketing Operations to drive key initiatives and bring projects to life through authentic influence and project ownership.
  • Autonomy & Travel: Enjoy flexible working, a collaborative culture, and international travel opportunities to connect with teams, clients, and partners worldwide.

Your Impact

Forget traditional event management - this role is about rolling up your sleeves and making big things happen. You will raise the bar for our global campaigns and field marketing, taking end-to-end ownership of regional activations, Tier 1 events, and cross-functional execution.

You will make an impact that matters by:

  • Setting Objectives & Strategy: Partnering directly with the VP Marketing to lock in clear goals, lean execution strategies, and commercial outcomes for every event.
  • Developing Activation Plans: Building end-to-end event activation plans that seamlessly align with broader marketing campaigns and core business goals.
  • End-to-End Activity Execution: Drive comprehensive pre-event, on-site, and post-event marketing initiatives to maximize impact and engagement.
  • Partnering with Sales: Working closely with Sales teams to identify target accounts, key customers, and high-value prospects, crafting targeted engagement plans for every activation.
  • Orchestrating Experiences & Content: Align top-tier event speakers, high-impact content streams, executive meetings, unique customer experiences, and multi-channel supporting campaigns.
  • Managing External Partners: Briefing and directing external agencies, event organizers, and suppliers to deliver seamless activations on time and within budget.
  • Asset & Messaging Readiness: Ensuring high-quality content, targeted messaging, and necessary marketing assets are fully prepared and accessible before and during each event.
  • On-Site Execution: Overseeing on-site activations directly and serving as the primary marketing point of contact during live events.
  • Driving ROI & Reporting: Leading post-event follow-up strategies, tracking results, measuring campaign performance, and reporting key pipeline metrics.
  • Continuous Improvement: Capturing key learnings and insights from each activation to refine and elevate our strategy for flagship Tier 1 events.

What can you bring

  • Experience in the Media & Entertainment space.
  • Demonstrable experience in event management, field marketing, campaign management, or experiential/event marketing within a B2B environment (ideally SaaS or technology).
  • Demonstrated success in delivering end-to-end integrated campaigns from initial brief through to execution and measurement.
  • Proactive mindset with strong project management capabilities, a focus to measure outcomes (not tasks), and a proven record of driving projects across teams and external partners.
  • Commercial awareness and analytical capability, with a focus on aligning marketing initiatives with sales pipeline and ROI metrics.
  • Experience planning and activating regional and international events.
  • Technical familiarity with marketing and collaboration tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, and Canva (or similar platforms).
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to drive progress independently while building strong cross-functional relationships.
  • Willingness to travel internationally for up to five Tier 1 events per year.

You don't have experience with all the points above? Don't worry, we foster an environment of continuous learning and will support you with onboarding, coaching, and growth on the job. If you are driven, collaborative, and excited about shaping the future of video technology, we encourage you to apply!

    • A positive attitude, enthusiastic, flexible, energetic and highly motivated

jobs.excerpt: Company Summary:Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient.
jobs.description:
Company Summary:

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang AI, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact.

What Your Experience Will Be:

As a Client Experience Manager at Slang AI, you’ll own the end-to-end customer journey for our SMB clients — from onboarding through long-term success and day-to-day support. You’ll guide customers through their initial rollout, transition seamlessly into serving as their long-term success manager, and directly manage the support inbox during business hours, where many of their most important interactions occur.
Because support volume is currently low (fewer than 60 inquiries per month across 1,500+ customers), this role offers the opportunity to both deliver excellent frontline support and help design how support scales as we grow. You’ll gain unique visibility into customer needs in real time while influencing the tools, processes, and standards that will shape support as the business expands.
This unique scope means you’ll be both a strategic advisor and a hands-on partner, ensuring customers launch smoothly, adopt key features, resolve challenges quickly, and realize the full value of Slang. By owning these critical touch points, you’ll have a large sphere of influence over customer outcomes, shaping retention, adoption, and satisfaction across a significant segment of the business.
In addition, you’ll play a key role in our digital customer success program — helping define and refine automated success sequences to ensure accuracy, consistency, and strong adoption results. This work ensures customers experience the same hospitality-first service at scale, while giving you a direct impact on how Slang drives measurable results for our clients.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang, we believe success starts with great execution and great service. In this role, you’ll gain valuable experience managing full customer lifecycles and working with hospitality operators in a fast-paced environment. You’ll learn how to onboard, support, and grow a book of business with autonomy, while contributing to scalable processes that improve outcomes across the team. We offer training, feedback, and growth opportunities to help you level up in customer success, technical product fluency, and strategic account management.

What Success Looks Like

  • Driving Long-Term Success: You are responsible for the health and success of your assigned accounts. You ensure customers are seeing clear outcomes, meeting their goals, and staying on track for renewal.
  • Building Trusted Relationship: You build strong relationships with a range of customer stakeholders — from General Managers to Operations Leaders — and know how to tailor your approach depending on their needs.
  • Renewals & Retention: You own the renewal process and are accountable for maintaining and growing account revenue. You identify risks early, take action to resolve issues, and keep customers satisfied and committed.
  • Surfacing Growth Opportunity: You surface expansion opportunities (e.g. additional locations or use cases) and work with Sales to execute. You contribute to the team’s Net Revenue Retention (NRR) goal.
  • Feature Adoption & Product Fluency: You guide customers through product updates, encourage usage of key features, and tie adoption back to business outcomes. You’re expected to understand and explain Slang’s value.
  • Onboarding and Success Planning: You create simple account plans to track customer goals, key contacts, risks, and growth potential. You align internal teams around each plan to support execution.
  • Voice of the Customer: You escalate customer feedback internally and contribute insights that improve product and service. You partner with Product and Support to advocate for customer needs.
  • Hospitality-First Service: You respond quickly, handle challenges with professionalism, and make interactions easy for customers. You aim to create a positive experience in every conversation.

What You Will Bring

  • Customer Focus: You care about helping customers succeed. You’re responsive, thoughtful, and proactive.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing roles. Background in restaurants or hospitality tech is strongly preferred.
  • Business Acumen: You understand restaurant operations and how to align Slang’s value with business goals. You’re comfortable working with executives and frontline staff alike.
  • Communication: You’re clear and concise in both written and verbal communication. You know how to explain ideas, give updates, and lead customer conversations.
  • Ownership: You manage your book of business with attention to detail. You’re accountable for renewals, engagement, and outcomes.
  • Adaptability: You’re comfortable in a fast-changing environment and open to feedback. You handle ambiguity and know how to prioritize.
  • Preferred: Experience with restaurant operations, phone systems, or reservation platforms is a plus.

How Work Affects My Life:

As a Client Experience Manager for SMBs, you’ll directly contribute to the success of hospitality teams. Your work helps restaurant staff be more productive, improve guest service, and hit their business goals. In return, Slang supports you with competitive pay, benefits, and a culture that values performance and teamwork. You’ll have clear goals, a meaningful role, and the opportunity to grow.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai. We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).
We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)
Learner Fervor. We take every opportunity to learn (especially when it’s hard)
Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)
SMB MVP. We’re an expert member of our customers’ teams (we earn their trust)

Vision

We aspire to be the definitive home for next-generation superfans of music & culture. The future is a world where we’re undeniably the leader in social-first brand building. Obsession has driven perfection in tailoring our content to audience passion points and we’ve transformed followers into fiercely loyal community members. We’ve bridged the gap from the digital to the physical world, providing our communities with unforgettable experiences and products that define culture. We’ve become the go-to platform for artists to amplify their stories, distribute their music, and partner with brands.

About Us

Low Battery is a network of nine social-first brands with an audience of over 50 million. We’re where the next generation of superfans comes for entertainment related to music and culturally relevant content. Our brands span music, fashion, gaming, news, and more.
@rap | What’s Next in Hip Hop & Culture.
@bars | The Next Generation of Hip Hop.
@concert | Live Hip Hop Performance & New Music Discovery.
@reggaetontv | Representing Latin Music & Culture. Based in Medellin, Colombia.

@controller | The Home of Gaming.
@pophive | The Buzz on All Things Pop Culture.
@countryhub | The Next Generation of Country Music.
@uncut | Your Daily Dose of Internet News.

Our Culture

Making our ambitious vision a reality will not be easy. So we don’t hide the truth…it’s not easy to work here. We’re bringing together a special team obsessed with their work and cultivating a culture characterized by many things, including but not limited to:
- Uncommon hard work and commitment;
-Unusual levels of autonomy and a builders mindset: solving > complaining;
- Obsession over our audiences;
- Refusal to compromise on standards for quality;
- Relentless accountability & ownership;
- Radical transparency + direct communication & feedback;
- Low ego and pursuit of truth (and goals), not looking good.
Our company culture will evolve over time, but many of these ideas are fundamental to what we do and who we are and, therefore, will not change. Every day, we strive to live as closely to these values as we can, and of course, it doesn’t always happen.
We’re early in the journey, paddling out to catch the big wave. So it’s an exciting time balanced by the reality that creating something special is uncommon and requires uncommon commitment. For those with similar ideals — come be uncommon with us!

The Opportunity

We're early and brand partnerships is the most important focus at the company. If you're not comfortable with ambiguity, hunting down opportunities and building from scratch in a competitive environment, this won't be the right role for you. If you're looking to inherit a book of business and be more of an Account Manager, this won't be the right role for you.

  • Generate 5 new business pitches per week

  • Pre-sales: You’ll collaborate internally to ideate on proactive client opportunities, respond to RFPs, create pitch decks, rate cards and media plans. You’ll be required to draft narrative-driven pitch decks that convey our network, capabilities and value propositions effectively.
  • Pitching. You’ll be required to quickly get up to speed on our network positioning, pitch messaging and conveying value propositions to be able to lead sales calls on your own and drive revenue.
  • Post-sales: close a deal? You’ll own invoicing, client communications and collaborating across departments to oversee campaign execution, delivery and performance reporting.
  • Reporting: we can’t manage what we don’t measure. You’ll leverage spreadsheets and/or a CRM to track prospecting, meeting notes, pipeline & deal flow, etc.
  • Content & Product: you'll work closely with our product (content) teams to respond to RFPs and put together pitches. You'll also be on the front lines communicating our network & advertising products to the marketplace. You'll rapidly become an expert in our content & product offering and bring intelligence & feedback back to the organization.

What We're Looking for

  • 4+ years of direct sales experience in digital and social media.
  • Track record of success driving revenue through discovering, prospecting and closing NEW business.
  • Authentic & deep understanding of the social media landscape and a history of selling social.

  • Data-driven and comfortable with the latest technologies for lead sourcing, outreach and CRM reporting.

  • Passionate about music, fashion, gaming and popular culture.

  • Annual team summits

Location: Remote

Position Description

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Help Desk Support Agent (Mid-Level) to provide Tier 2 identity and access management (IAM) help desk support for a complex, mission-critical federal program supporting the U.S. Department of Education's Federal Student Aid (FSA) office. The ideal candidate brings solid experience in federal help desk operations, user account management, and identity verification support within a structured, high-volume service environment.

Responsibilities

This position plays a pivotal role in ensuring FSA's internal and external users receive timely, accurate, and professional support for account access, authentication, and identity recovery issues across the PAS and AIMS platforms. The Help Desk Support Agent operates as a key point of contact between end users, Tier 1 help desk teams, and IAM subject matter experts — maintaining high service quality standards while supporting the integrity and security of FSA's identity management ecosystem.

Required Qualifications

  • Respond to inbound calls and written inquiries from FSA internal and external users experiencing account access, authentication, and identity management issues.
    - Support users in attaining access to their authorized accounts and systems, including account lookup by mobile phone, email address, or PII; password resets; account unlocks; and delivery of verification codes.
    - Provide Tier 2 help desk support across PAS and AIMS platforms, including PAS Identity Account Recovery (IDAR), ID Verification Help Desk, and AIMS Two-Factor Authentication (TFA) Help Desk services.
    - Deliver help desk support for integrated FSA applications and services, troubleshooting incidents and problems in coordination with FSA and FSA Data Center teams.
    - Perform analysis and troubleshooting of IAM solution issues, engaging relevant subject matter experts (SMEs) and vendors as needed to drive resolution.
    - Support warm/soft handoffs from FSA Tier 1 Help Desk teams, providing next level Tier 2 support for issues that cannot be resolved quickly at the Tier 1 level.
    - Develop and share written troubleshooting guidelines with FSA Tier 1 Help Desk teams and FSA Data Center staff to improve first-contact resolution and reduce erroneous escalations.
    - Administer automated customer satisfaction surveys following Tier 2 interactions, maintaining a customer satisfaction (CSAT) rating of 85% or better.
    - Meet or exceed established service level targets: live answer rate of at least 97%, call abandonment rate below 3%, and average speed of answer (ASA) within 60 seconds.
    - Resolve all Identity Account Recovery (IDAR) and ID Verification cases within three (3) business days of receiving required customer documentation.
    - Respond to email inquiries within two (2) business days of initial receipt.
    - Facilitate handoffs to the IAM Help Desk for users requiring updates to critical account identifiers, ensuring identity is validated and verified prior to any updates and that supporting documentation is properly stored.
    - Support updates to user phone numbers and email addresses, including triggering account revalidation workflows and maintaining documentation.
    - Support Partner Participation Oversight (PPO) CSRs, Business Process Operations (BPO) CSRs, DCC, COD Web, and NSLDS CSR Helpdesks in performing AIMS user account lookups and password resets.
    - Maintain accurate counts of all inbound and outbound calls and provide weekly help desk statistics including calls offered, calls answered, abandoned calls, live answer rate, and ASA to FSA via IAM SharePoint.
    - Track and report accurate call categorization data by major topic and sub-topic to support FSA program reporting.
    - Participate in quality monitoring activities; all help desk calls are subject to recording and a 2% quality monitoring review.

PingWind is focused on delivering outstanding services to the federal government. About Willow

Willow is building the leading Operational AI platform for the built world. We help owners and operators of large, complex environments better understand, manage, and optimize their buildings and infrastructure by connecting physical, operational, and human data into a unified digital foundation. Our platform enables customers to move from fragmented systems and reactive workflows to smarter operations, better decision-making, and meaningful financial and operational outcomes.

We are at an important stage of company growth: scaling commercial momentum, increasing operating rigor, and building the foundation for long-term category leadership.

About the Role

This role plays a critical part in delivering Willow's Digital Twin platform to customers.Working closely with project and team leads, you will help drive successful deployments, coordinate cross-functional activities, and ensure high-quality outcomes.This role offers the opportunity to grow and nurture strategic customer accounts and directly contributing to Willow's long-term growth and expansion.

Our ideal candidate is a self-starter with a demonstrated record of successfully coordinating complex, cross-functional projects to achieve desired outcomes. Previous experience working across subject matter areas where you may or may not be an expert will also be key to success.

Standout candidates will have a proven ability to understand and explain complex technical content to enable internal and external teams to arrive at appropriate decisions. This is an individual contributor role (not a people-management position) that sits within our Customer Engineering (CE) department, and it will require the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams to support deployment efforts, build strong internal working relationships, and manage stakeholder expectations.

Responsibilities:

    • Help build and set up Digital Twins for our clients by working directly on live deployment projects
    • Use your knowledge of building systems (HVAC, BMS, electrical, and mechanical) to help process and validate data
    • Work with 3D building models (such as Revit or Navisworks) to understand building layouts and support accurate Digital Twin creation, while analysing large datasets using tools like Excel to identify issues and ensure data accuracy
    • Work closely with teammates across different departments to help set up and support system integrations.
    • Use AI tools to speed up data processing, documentation, and problem-solving, while staying open to learning and adopting new tools and technologies as they become available.
    • Ensure the Team Leader is informed on progress, issues, risks and blockers on a daily basis to enable accurate deliverable management
    • Engage with Willow’s Product and Engineering team to improve product capabilities and roadmap

What we are looking for:

    • 3+ years’ experience in MEP / building services engineering, Building Automation Services, or project/program coordination, ideally in a SaaS or technology-enabled services business
    • An MEP engineering background (mechanical, electrical and/or plumbing), specifically control and monitoring within the built environment, is highly valued
    • A solid understanding of typical building technology systems such as HVAC controls, Building Management Systems (BMS), lighting controls, energy metering networks, IT/OT/IoT devices and networks, and access control and security technologies
    • 3D modeling / BIM experience is highly regarded and a significant plus — exposure to authoring or review tools such as Revit, Navisworks or Archicad.
    • Comfortable using or learning AI tools like Claude to improve productivity
    • Strong communication skills — able to explain things clearly and simply to teammates
    • Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret and work across large, disparate datasets (e.g. using Excel, SQL or similar tools) to draw out insights and inform decisions
    • A positive attitude, enthusiastic, flexible, energetic and highly motivated

Company Summary:

Slang is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact

What Your Experience Will Be:

As an Account Executive at Slang, you will play a pivotal role in driving our business forward. Collaborating closely with the Head of Sales and your manager, you will be integral to our rapid growth phase. You will work within the Sales department, engaging with various internal teams, such as Product and Customer Experience, to ensure a cohesive customer journey. Occasional travel may be required for attending conferences or company offsite meetings. Additionally, you will leverage sales technology to enhance productivity and connectivity with prospects and with your teammates.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang , ou believe that trust is a foundational layer to any relationship starting internally as a slangsta through your touch points with each prospect. We cultivate a culture where every Slangster has a deep sense of pride in their achievements with humility. Our team is collaborative, supportive, and driven by shared goals fostering an abundance mindset in addition to belonging and inclusivity. Learner Fervor represents our strongest attribute for growth, as we challenge each employee to take every opportunity to learn especially when it's hard. You will grow not only as a professional but also as an individual. We support and foster opportunities for learning and development, aligning with your career aspirations. From weekly team trainings to 1:1 coaching sessions with your manager or peers, company wide workshops, we will help your journey in finding purpose in your work and achieving your fullest potential.

  • Hunting and Closing: Proactively prospecting and closing new business opportunities.
  • Value Based Discovery and Demos: Actively listening to expertly uncover business impact, quantify value, and position Slang as uniquely qualified to deliver those outcomes.
  • Growing Key Markets: Expanding both existing and new market segments strategically.
  • Pipeline Management: Managing your sales pipeline to ensure quality multi-threading with key stakeholders, driving urgency of purchase, and navigating the buying process to ensure a predictable and steady flow of closed deals.
  • Leverage AI to innovate and drive process efficiency and achieve business objectives.
  • Collaborative Support: Working closely with the Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and expansion of existing accounts you have worked with.
  • Exceeding Targets: Consistently achieving and surpassing monthly sales quotas and weekly top-of-funnel metrics.

What You Will Bring:

  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced and ever-evolving startup environment and excels under pressure.
  • Coachability: Open to feedback, self-motivated, and innovative in your approach.
  • Communication Skills: Strong in both written and verbal communication, a good listener, assertive, persistent, and persuasive, with a high EQ.
  • Preferred Experience: Experience in SaaS or hospitality (Hotels or restaurants) is a plus.

How Work Affects My Life:

At Slang, your role as an Account Executive will not only shape your professional trajectory but also enhance your personal well-being. We offer competitive compensation, including various rewards and benefits, to reflect your value to the company. By joining Slang.ai, you’ll find your work meaningful and aligned with your personal goals, shaping a positive worldview and reinforcing your sense of worth by helping businesses more efficiently serve their customers and alleviate pain for their staff while developing your business and hospitality ai acumen and skills.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai. We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).
We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)
Learner Fervor. We take every opportunity to learn (especially when it’s hard)
Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)
SMB MVP. We’re an expert member of our customers’ teams (we earn their trust)

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

AHEAD is on the hunt for an exceptional Senior Software Engineer to help build Hatch, our flagship platform. We’re a leading IT services provider, trusted by some of the world’s largest companies to design, build, run, and modernize their most important technology across cloud, data, AI, and security.

Hatch is an advanced platform for IT lifecycle management, renewal, procurement, and logistics, giving enterprises real-time visibility and control over their IT assets, orders, contracts, and inventory across thousands of sites. Unity, its sibling platform, extends those capabilities to streamline our own operations and service delivery. You’ll join a progressive engineering team that lives on the forefront of technology. We build real products, adopt new tools early, sweat the details, and trade ideas constantly. You will learn here, and you’ll have the autonomy to make a visible impact fast.

We’re far less interested in the languages on your résumé than in how you think. You’ll own meaningful problems end to end, starting from the user and the business outcome. You’ll design, build, and ship full-stack solutions, make sound architectural calls, and stay accountable for quality from first commit to production. Our stack today is Elixir and Phoenix, but we care far more that you can pick up whatever a problem demands and bring strong engineering judgment to it.

Building in the Age of AI

    AI has changed what great engineering looks like, and we’ve leaned in. We expect engineers to use AI tools and coding agents fluently to prototype, explore, and accelerate the routine, so that human time goes to what matters: framing the right problem, designing the system, exercising judgment, and verifying that what ships is correct and secure. We’re not looking for people who fear the tools, or who trust them blindly. We’re looking for engineers who wield them with taste.

    • Reach for AI to move faster on scaffolding, refactors, tests, and research, then review every line like you own it, because you do.
    • Spend your judgment where it counts: architecture, product decisions, edge cases, security, and correctness.
    • Help push the practice forward with better tooling, prompts, and workflows that make the whole team more effective.

What will you be doing?

    • Own features and problems end to end, from understanding the user’s need through design, delivery, and support.
    • Design and build full-stack solutions for internal and public web applications, making pragmatic architectural decisions along the way.
    • Work at high leverage with AI tools and agents, then review, test, and harden everything you ship.
    • Engage across the full development life cycle: analysis, implementation, integration, testing, debugging, and support.
    • Lead code reviews and raise the bar on quality, mentoring other engineers as you go.
    • Work directly with end users and stakeholders to understand the business problem behind each request.
    • Help set estimates and milestones, balance technical risk against cost and deadlines, and keep work on track.
    • Help drive the future roadmap of the engineering team and AHEAD.

What does the ideal candidate look like?

    • 5+ years building and shipping software (7+ preferred), with a track record of owning significant work end to end.
    • Strong engineering judgment. You know what “good” looks like and can tell solid solutions from shaky ones, including code an AI wrote.
    • A product mindset: you start from the user and the outcome, and you sweat the details that make software useful.
    • Fluency with modern AI development tools and coding agents, paired with the discipline to verify, test, and own everything you ship.
    • Stack-agnostic adaptability, so you pick up new languages and frameworks quickly. (Our stack today is Elixir and Phoenix; prior experience is welcome but not required.)
    • A strong foundation in software design, architecture, and the practices that keep systems reliable, including testing, continuous integration, code review, and containerization.
    • Clear, direct communication, so you can express intent precisely to both teammates and the tools you work with.
    • The instincts of a senior engineer: you lead projects, mentor others, and raise the level of the people around you.
    • A drive to keep learning and to help shape how the team builds.

Why you'll love it here

    • Join a progressive team that lives on the forefront of technology, where innovation and curiosity are the norm.
    • We invest seriously in modern tooling, including the best AI tools, and we’re always looking for the next approach that makes the team better.
    • Competitive salary, benefits, and an environment where work-life balance is more than just a catchphrase.
    • You’ll play a crucial role in a platform that enterprises rely on to manage their IT, working alongside a talented and motivated team.

Make your voice heard

    AHEAD recognizes the value of diverse perspectives. In our ever-evolving tech landscape, the insights you bring from your own journey can reshape our collective experience. If you’ve had experiences, both good and challenging, with other platforms, technologies, or ways of working, they’ll become an asset here. Your voice will help refine our products and the way we build them, keeping both innovative, intuitive, and industry-leading.

    Please include links to anything that shows how you build, whether that’s repositories, projects you led, or pull requests that reflect the breadth of your work. If you’ve built something interesting with AI tools or agents, we’d love to see that too.

The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

  • Write the ads. You'll sit with the ad account, see which ads are doing well, and write the next batch. You won't control the budget. You'll be the one who knows why the winner won.
  • Watch the numbers. Views, saves, Discord joins, replies, signups. Not for a report. Because you can't get better at this without knowing which of your posts worked and which died.

What you'll bring

  • Taste you can explain. Show you two thumbnails and you can say which one wins and why, in a sentence. "It just feels better" is where you start, not where you stop.
  • You already build things with AI. Not a chat tab you ask questions in. Actual work. You've had a model rename two hundred clips at once, pull a week of numbers into one place, write thirty versions of a caption so you could pick the best one, or make some small thing that saves you an hour every day. You'll do a lot of that here, including in Claude Code, which is Claude running on your computer where it can work on your files directly. You don't need to know it already. You do need to have used AI to save yourself real time, and be able to show us what you made.
  • Short, clear writing. Most of what you make is a few words a stranger reads once and judges us on.
  • You're properly online. You knew what happened on Instagram this week before anyone told you. You can name a format that died and say what killed it.

This role also plays a meaningful part in Abnormal's public-company readiness work. You'll thrive here if you move fluidly between granular financial detail and executive-level synthesis, and if you like building structure rather than inheriting it.

What You'll Do

  • Own the annual plan and forecast cadence across the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow — with particular ownership of revenue and free cash flow forecasting — using driver-based models to continuously improve accuracy.
  • Build scenario and sensitivity modeling into a core FP&A capability that informs key leadership decisions.
  • Oversee the team’s ownership of the monthly CFO review package — budget vs actual variance analysis, forecast, and supporting analytics — partnering with Accounting on the close, while staying hands-on in building Board and investor reporting materials.
  • Turn financial and operating data into clear, actionable insight for leadership through recurring reporting, dashboards, and ad hoc analysis.
  • Oversee the team's ownership of Pigment systems, and direct AI-enabled automation and process/controls improvement across FP&A.
  • Support SOX controls, audit committee materials, and other IPO-readiness work, partnering with Legal, Accounting, Investor Relations, and the CFO's office.
  • Partner with Accounting, Tax, and People on specialized, cross-functional forecast items such as equity, payroll taxes, and benefits.
  • Manage and grow a team of corporate finance analysts/managers, including coaching and career development.

Must Haves

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or CPA a plus.
  • 6-9+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally within high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity, including experience managing or developing direct reports.
  • Demonstrated track record of improving forecast accuracy and building driver-based financial models from scratch.
  • Highly analytical, with strong fluency in modern FP&A systems (Pigment, Snowflake, or similar) — comfortable using data to independently uncover key insights.
  • Strong command of the three financial statements and core SaaS operating metrics (e.g., gross margin, ARR, contribution margin).
  • Direct experience supporting public-company readiness workstreams (e.g., SOX controls, audit committee/board materials).
  • Proven ability to move fluidly between granular financial detail and executive-level synthesis, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High affinity for AI tools, with a track record of leading automation or efficiency initiatives within FP&A.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a company through an actual IPO, or in its first year as a newly public company.
  • Familiarity with NetSuite, Maxio, Workday, or Sigma.
  • Experience with AI-assisted forecasting/reporting tools or agentic workflows (e.g., Claude, Pigment AI Analyst).
  • Prior experience in investment banking, strategy consulting, or equity research.
  • Cybersecurity or infrastructure software industry background.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Rewards
jobs.excerpt: Who we areMoniepoint Inc.  is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About The Role

Rewards is one of the most strategically important platforms at Moniepoint, and it is being built into a dedicated charter with its own engineering and product leadership. The platform sits at the centre of our retention strategy across a user base of approximately 23 million people.

Today the platform does one thing: cashback. It works, but it has barely scratched the surface of what rewards can be, and the cashback product itself is not yet built to the depth it deserves. The ambition is to evolve it into a full rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform — and to do that across the full 360 degrees of our network. That means rewards for our business customers, rewards for our consumer customers, and rewards for the sales agents who drive our distribution. Very few companies get to design this from close to a blank page at this scale.

The Head of Engineering owns that platform end to end. You will inherit a team of nine engineers, including an Engineering Manager, and build the organisation out from there — the current expectation is a minimum of three product units and upwards of 25 people, though the eventual shape is genuinely yours to define. Your first objective is to get the best possible performance out of the cashback product we already have. From there, you will work with Growth, Sales and Marketing to determine what we build for acquisition and retention, and roll it out across every customer we serve.

This is a consumer-facing product engineering role, and that is the most important thing to understand about it. Rewards is won or lost on experimentation, personalisation, and the quality of the experience in a customer's hands. We are looking for a leader who has built and shipped direct-to-consumer products at scale, who is fluent in experimentation and A/B testing, and who has real depth in front-end and mobile engineering — not a purely backend platform leader.

Moniepoint runs a Domain CTO model. We view our Heads of Engineering as the CTO of their domain: you own the technical roadmap, the architecture, the delivery, and the organisation beneath you. You will have full autonomy over engineering strategy, architecture, hiring, operating cadence and roadmap trade-offs.

You will report functionally to our Group CTO, with a dual reporting line into the Product leader for Rewards. That second line is a delivery relationship rather than a seniority one — engineering and product are peers here, and you will build the team to full capacity together. Your responsibilities as Head of Engineering, Rewards includes:

  • Owning the technical strategy, architecture and roadmap for the Rewards Platform end to end.
  • Improving the performance, reliability and depth of the existing cashback product as an immediate first priority.
  • Evolving cashback into a broader rewards, retention, engagement and personalisation platform serving business customers, consumer customers and sales agents.
  • Building the engineering organisation from its current base - structuring product units, hiring engineers and Engineering Managers, and leading through those managers as the team scales.
  • Establishing a strong experimentation culture: A/B testing, cohort analysis, and measurement that lets the team learn quickly what actually changes customer behaviour.
  • Working closely with Growth, Sales and Marketing to translate acquisition and retention objectives into product and engineering initiatives.
  • Owning the customer-facing experience of rewards across mobile and web, including how quickly and reliably customers receive what they have earned.
  • Define architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics, and own the engineering health of the domain — incidents, production defects, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and developer experience.
  • Build the platform to serve customers across multiple geographies as Moniepoint expands.
  • Partner with Product to define the rewards-specific metrics and OKRs that do not yet exist, and hold the team to them.

Who You Are

  • Direct-to-consumer product engineering at scale. You have built and shipped products used directly by large consumer audiences, and you understand what moves engagement and retention. This is the defining requirement of the role.
  • Genuine front-end and mobile depth. You have led or personally built consumer-facing mobile and web experiences. A backend-only background, however strong, is not what this role needs.
  • Experimentation and growth engineering. Hands-on experience running A/B tests, feature flagging, and measurement frameworks, and using the results to drive product decisions rather than to justify them.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers — leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, not a single team.
  • Hands-on technical leadership. You are still close to the code. We expect a meaningful proportion of hands-on engineering time and technical credibility with the engineers you lead.
  • 10+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • Comfort with our backend environment — Java and Spring Boot — and the ability to lead backend engineers credibly, even if it is not where your own depth sits.
  • Experience building and scaling an engineering organisation from a small base, including hiring and developing Engineering Managers.
  • Strong collaboration with commercial stakeholders — growth, marketing and sales — and the ability to translate business objectives into engineering work.
  • Rewards, loyalty, gamification, personalisation or growth platform experience is a strong advantage but is not required.
  • Fintech or payments experience is an advantage, not a requirement.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • The existing cashback product performing measurably better — faster, more reliable, and more compelling to customers.
  • A credible rewards platform roadmap defined with Product, and the first initiatives beyond cashback shipped.
  • A functioning experimentation practice, where the team ships, measures and learns on a short cycle.
  • An engineering organisation built out from its current base, with a strong bench of Engineering Managers and senior engineers.
  • Rewards established as a measurable contributor to retention and engagement across the customer base.
  • Clear architecture standards and engineering processes in place across the product units.

Why Join Us

  • A rare blank page. The platform exists, but almost everything it could become is still ahead of it, and you will define what that is.
  • Direct influence on retention across a base of roughly 23 million users, at one of the largest and fastest-growing digital banks in Africa.
  • Full autonomy as the CTO of your domain, with the backing to build the organisation you think the problem needs.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company expanding access to financial services for millions of businesses and individuals.

What To Expect In The Hiring Process

  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders. 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project or system you built in the past. 30 minutes focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management and collaboration skills with product and business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Zuma is pioneering the future of agentic AI and our focus is to transform the rental market experience for consumers and property manager alike.
