jobs.title: Senior SAP S4 MM Consultant
jobs.excerpt: VistaVu Solutions is an employee-owned tech company on a high growth curve.
jobs.description:
VistaVu Solutions is an employee-owned tech company on a high growth curve. We deliver full lifecycle ERP implementations, transformation projects, and responsive support through our partnerships with SAP S/4Hana Cloud, SAP Business One, SAP Business ByDesign, Boomi, and Amazon Web Services to mid-market companies in a broad range of industries primarily within the United States and Canada. Our industry specific expertise, product extensions, and award-winning services help our customersRUN GREAT!

It’s our people that make VistaVu unique and different from other technology solution providers. We are intelligent, caring, driven and committed to the vision. We advocate for our customers and earn their trust by understanding their business, using proven processes to serve their needs, and delivering a high return on investment. Our core values shape our culture, define our character, and guide how to make decisions across every level of our organization.

Our Core Values

  • Results: You want to work in a company based on meritocracy where your results determine your trajectory (not time served).
  • Trust:When your manager gives you something you use your critical thinking and proactive mindset to find a way to get it done and done well.
  • User Experience: You appreciate what good customer experience looks like and are driven to consistently go above and beyond for the customer.
  • Embrace Change:You thrive within a dynamic and evolving organization.
  • Growth: You are consistently investing into and upgrading your skills and experiences.
  • Gratitude:You want to feel appreciated, and you look to say thank you loudly and often to others on the team.

The Opportunity

VistaVu is seeking a seasoned Consultant to join our dynamic S/4Hana Cloud Public Team as an SAP S4 MM Consultant. This opportunity is worth considering if you are looking for a rapidly growing business and an exciting workplace. The successful candidate will be responsible for configuring and delivering ERP solutions that meet client business requirements using standard SAP best practices. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and the SAP system, this role analyzes the client’s processes and translates them into system configurations or functional specifications, emphasizing fit-to-standard processes to minimize customizations. The Senior Consultant ensures the implemented S/4HANA Cloud solution is effective, efficient, and aligned with business needs through proper configuration, testing, and user training. Ultimately, this role helps clients optimize their processes in S/4HANA Cloud while adhering to SAP’s clean core principles for maintainability and upgradability.

This is a remote role based in the United States with preference for a resident of Texas. Because of client requirements U.S. citizenship is required for this role.

What will you be doing?

  • Business Process Guidance & Fit-to-Standard Analysis: Collaborate with clients during the Explore phase to understand business processes, identify gaps with SAP S/4HANA Cloud standards, and recommend in-scope solutions within a line of business. Advise on process improvements using standard SAP options, document current vs. future processes, and perform gap analysis against best practices.
  • Solution Configuration & Realization: Configure S/4HANA Cloud via SAP Central Business Configuration and in-app settings to fulfil approved business needs across modules such as Finance, Procurement, and Sales, following SAP standards. Conduct unit testing to confirm system behavior meets requirements, and refine configurations as needed from test results and client feedback, ensuring a clean core with minimal custom code.
  • Functional Specification & Documentation: Convert business requirements for system enhancements (FRICEW objects) into functional specification documents for technical teams. Clearly outline any custom development or integration needs and verify that technical designs align with functional goals. Maintain updated configuration workbooks, process flows, and decision logs. Secure stakeholder approval on design documents before development begins.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Create and execute test plans for functional and integration testing. Collaborate with technical teams to resolve defects or misconfigurations, ensuring all business processes are covered in System Integration Testing (SIT). Support clients during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and address issues promptly to meet requirements and quality standards.
  • User Training & Knowledge Transfer: Develop targeted training materials and documentation for the client’s processes. Lead user training to ensure effective use of S/4HANA Cloud and transfer knowledge to Business Process Owners and Subject Matter Experts. Support users’ understanding and self-sufficiency by addressing their questions and clarifying system workflows.
  • Cutover Planning & Go-Live Support: Participate in cutover planning to ensure all configuration, data loading, and validation are completed for a successful production launch. During go-live, provide support to quickly address functional issues, verify system transactions, and build user confidence. After go-live, monitor system usage, resolve defects, and maintain solution stability during the hypercare period.
  • Client Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with Project Managers, Solution Architects, and Technical Consultants to deliver projects. Proactively communicate progress and risks, adapting solutions as business needs change. Maintain client feedback loops to identify enhancements achievable via SAP updates or minor configurations. Support quarterly release management by assessing and enabling relevant new S/4HANA Cloud features to maximize system value.

What experience do you need?

ERP & SAP Implementation Background

  • 5+ years of ERP implementation experience, with strong emphasis on SAP platforms.
  • Minimum 1–2+ years of hands-on SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public Edition) experience, including quarterly release management and fit to standard delivery practices.
  • Background in a consulting or systems integrator environment, accustomed to fast paced delivery and client-facing work.
    Experience with global or multi country rollouts (e.g., localizations, multi currency, distributed teams) is a strong plus.

Full Lifecycle Project Delivery

  • Demonstrated success leading or contributing significantly to 2+ full lifecycle ERP projects, from planning through post go live.

Consulting & Multi Country Deployment Experience

  • Background in a consulting or systems integrator environment, accustomed to fast paced delivery and client-facing work.
    Experience with global or multi country rollouts (e.g., localizations, multi currency, distributed teams) is a strong plus.

Industry & Domain Expertise

  • Practical experience in sectors common to mid‑market ERP such as manufacturing, distribution, or professional services.
  • Ability to reuse industry patterns—e.g., project systems/time & billing, production/inventory flows—to shape scalable SAP Cloud ERP solutions.

Additional experience

  • SAP S/4HANA Cloud Expertise: In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public Edition) configuration for multiple business processes (e.g., Record-to-Report, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay). Consultant understands system features, keeps up with quarterly updates, and is familiar with SAP Best Practices and CBC tools to implement pre-delivered solutions.
  • SAP Activate Methodology & Project Delivery: Proficient in SAP Activate phases, especially Explore (Fit-to-Standard), Realize (configuration/testing), and Deploy (cutover). Experience with Agile practices and tools like SAP Cloud ALM or Solution Manager for tracking requirements and testing is preferred.
    Professional Certifications: Relevant SAP certifications (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certifications).
    Documentation & Communication Proficiency: Ability to produce clear, high quality architectural documentation including solution designs, blueprints, and technical specs.

What’s in it for you?

  • Influence the financial management, structure, and direction of our rapidly growing mid-market business.
  • Competitive remuneration
    • Flexible Health and wellness spending account.
    • Bonus program.
    • STD, LTD, Life and Critical Illness benefit program.
  • Work with great people in an environment where we live our core values.
  • Growth as we provide you challenges and opportunities to advance your career development and training.

At VistaVu Solutions, we are committed to an inclusive and equitable workforce that values, represents and supports the communities in which we work and live. We welcome people from all backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences and are committed to maintaining a respectful work environment that also supports the diverse needs of our employees. We encourage applications from all individuals including those who are Indigenous, members of visible minority groups, of varied abilities, persons of any sexual orientation or gender identity and expression, as well as with any other dimension of diversity.

VistaVu will make reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants who would require accommodation in applying for this role or throughout our hiring process unless undue hardship would result. The applicant should advise VistaVu what accommodations they need to participate in the process.

jobs.description:
At Pesa, we are making cross-border payments simple, fast & reliable for individuals & businesses across emerging markets; providing tools that power economic freedom. We are on a mission to localize the global money transfer experience and are currently seeking an intelligent Backend Developer with a strong sense of ownership and drive for continuous improvement.

If you are driven to create mission-critical, cloud-based services, possess a thorough understanding of handling high volumes of customer requests, and are committed to achieving excellence through simplicity, we would love to connect with you!

We’re looking for a Backend Developer with deep experience in Golang and modern banking systems to help architect, build, and scale our next-generation neobank infrastructure. You’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our core banking, payments, and multi-currency systems that power the financial experiences of thousands of customers across the globe.

As a Backend Developer, you’ll work cross-functionally with our Product, Compliance, and Infrastructure teams to ensure our systems are reliable, secure, and capable of supporting rapid product innovation in regulated financial environments.

How you'll be contributing

  • Lead architecture and development of scalable backend systems using Golang, with a focus on performance, fault-tolerance, and regulatory-grade reliability.

  • Design and implement microservices that power multi-currency accounts, card issuance, and cross-border payments.

  • Collaborate with product and compliance teams to embed KYC, AML, and transaction monitoring logic into core systems.

  • Drive API design standards for internal and third-party integrations (e.g., card processors, open banking APIs, FX providers, ledger systems).

  • Mentor and coach mid/senior engineers; establish and enforce engineering best practices, CI/CD workflows, and testing frameworks.

  • Partner with SRE and DevOps teams to implement observability, monitoring, and fault isolation strategies for financial-grade uptime.

  • Evaluate and integrate modern banking-as-a-service and ledger solutions while maintaining strong control over data integrity and performance.

  • Lead technical design reviews, influence the product roadmap, and guide strategic technical decisions across the engineering organization.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 3+ years building systems in Golang.

  • Experience working in a Neobank, fintech, or regulated financial services environment (ideally EMI or payments).

  • Proven experience architecting distributed systems, payment gateways, or transaction-ledger platforms.

  • Working knowledge of observability stack (logging, metrics, tracing).

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices & RESTful API design, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub).

  • Experience working with relational databases, NoSQL & understanding catching patterns (PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar).

  • Deep understanding of financial data integrity, idempotency, concurrency control, and security standards (PCI DSS, ISO 27001).

  • Experience with cloud-native infrastructure (Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

  • Strong familiarity with DevOps pipelines, GitOps, and automated testing in production-grade environments.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work closely with product, design, and compliance counterparts in a fast-moving, global team.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Core Banking Systems or Ledger Platforms (e.g., Mambu, Thought Machine, Solaris, or in-house ledgers).

  • Familiarity with FX, remittance, or multi-currency wallets.

  • Contributions to open-source Golang projects or fintech SDKs.

  • Exposure to security and compliance tooling (Vault, HashiCorp, Terraform, etc.).

  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces web responsivas, acessíveis e de alta performance, garantindo uma experiência de usuário (UX) fluida e consistente em diferentes dispositivos e navegadores;
  • Implementar componentes reutilizáveis e escaláveis utilizando frameworks modernos como React, ou , seguindo padrões de Design System e Component-Driven Development;

  • Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias de código, padrões e boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar em melhorias contínuas de performance frontend, acessibilidade, entre outros;
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes em produção, análise de causa raiz e implementação de correções para evitar recorrências;
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica das soluções implementadas (Storybook, README, wikis internas);

  • Experiência com (hooks, context API, gerenciamento de estado com Redux, Zustand ou Recoil) ou (Composition API, Vuex/Pinia);
  • Experiência com frameworks fullstack/SSR como ou ;
  • Conhecimento em estilização moderna: CSS Modules, Styled Components, Tailwind CSS, SASS/SCSS ou Material UI / Ant Design / Chakra UI;
  • Experiência com consumo e integração de APIs RESTful e/ou GraphQL (Apollo Client, React Query / TanStack Query, Axios, Fetch API);
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento backend com (Express, NestJS) ou Python (FastAPI, Django), incluindo criação de endpoints, autenticação (JWT, OAuth2) e modelagem de dados;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, SQL Server) e/ou não-relacionais (MongoDB, Redis);
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de versionamento (Git, GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket), incluindo estratégias de branching (Git Flow, Trunk-based);
  • Conhecimento em containerização com Docker e noções de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins);
  • Experiência com tecnologias em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS/Azure);
  • Familiaridade com testes automatizados: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright ou Vitest;
  • Superior completo em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando em projetos aplicados a casos reais de desenvolvimento frontend/fullstack;

  • Experiência com agentes para desenvolvimento de front (Lovable);
  • Experiência com Storybook para documentação e desenvolvimento isolado de componentes;
  • Familiaridade com Web Sockets e comunicação em tempo real (, Server-Sent Events);

  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD, infraestrutura como código);

jobs.description:
About Us

Zoo is building the next generation of hardware design tools redefining how hardware products are designed, developed, and built. Our platform combines a modern, cloud-native CAD environment with AI-powered engineering workflows, helping teams design, iterate, and manufacture products faster than ever before. We are headquartered in Los Angeles, CA with both a local and remote team. We were founded and incubated by Embedded Ventures in 2021.

About You

We’re looking for curious, innovative, and ambitious self-starters to join our growing team to help us bring our mission to life. We think you’ll thrive on our team if you’re:

  • Curious at your core, with an eagerness to learn and do things differently
  • Customer-focused, always thinking about ways to improve the user experience
  • Able to operate autonomously and work asynchronously, while also being an effective team player

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, CAD Interoperability, who can help build the systems that convert native and proprietary CAD formats into Zoo's KCL,our new programming language for 3D design. You'll work at the intersection of CAD data extraction, geometry processing, and code generation, turning models from third-party CAD systems into structured KCL representations. This role is for someone who enjoys digging into complex CAD systems, working with CAD SDKs and APIs, and building robust import pipelines that preserve model structure and design intent as much as possible.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, implement, and maintain import pipelines that convert native and proprietary CAD formats into Zoo's KCL.
  • Build systems for extracting feature information from CAD files and applications, including sketches, dimensions, constraints, parameters, feature trees, assemblies, metadata, PMI, and related design intent.
  • Develop extractors using native CAD application APIs and toolkits where interoperability SDKs are insufficient.
  • Translate extracted CAD structure, geometry, parameters, and feature information into KCL that faithfully represents the original model.
  • Build validation, testing, and comparison tools to measure conversion quality across geometry, topology, feature information, assemblies, and generated KCL output.
  • Handle edge cases across proprietary formats, CAD versions, modeling kernels, malformed files, incomplete metadata, and inconsistent vendor API behavior.
  • Collaborate with the file format, modeling, and product teams to improve Zoo's CAD import experience and expand support for real-world customer files.

What You’ll Need

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong professional experience in software engineering, ideally involving CAD, geometry, file formats, code generation, or data extraction systems.
  • Experience working with complex technical data formats, application APIs, SDKs, or translation pipelines.
  • Proficiency in a systems programming language such as Rust or C++, with comfort working across language boundaries and vendor SDKs.
  • Experience building automated tests, validation tools, and debugging workflows for complex technical systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously, investigate unfamiliar systems, and make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving environment.

Nice to Have

  • Strong understanding of CAD model structure, including parts, assemblies, sketches, constraints, dimensions, features, parameters, B-rep geometry, and tessellated representations.
  • Experience with CAD interoperability SDKs such as HOOPS Exchange, CoreTechnologie 3D_Kernel_IO, Open Design Alliance, CAD Exchanger, Datakit, or similar tools.
  • Experience with native CAD APIs such as SOLIDWORKS API, Creo TOOLKIT, NX Open, CATIA CAA/API, Inventor API, or similar.
  • Experience with STEP, IGES, Parasolid, ACIS, JT, glTF, STL, or other CAD and 3D exchange formats.
  • Experience generating structured source code from model data, especially for DSLs or domain-specific modeling languages.
  • Familiarity with KCL or other programmatic CAD workflows.

In addition to salary, we offer competitive equity as well as a full benefits package which may vary by geography as well.

jobs.title: Arbeidsdeskundige
jobs.excerpt: Dat jij alles op alles zet om alle mogelijkheden voor zowel de werknemer als de werkgever bij verzuim op een rijtje te zetten, vinden wij bewonderingswaardig.
jobs.description:
Dat jij alles op alles zet om alle mogelijkheden voor zowel de werknemer als de werkgever bij verzuim op een rijtje te zetten, vinden wij bewonderingswaardig. Samen met jouw mensgerichtheid, sterke luistervaardigheden en duidelijke rapportages kunnen wij onze klanten en hun werknemers écht verder helpen.

Aan de slag als Arbeidsdeskundige!

Als Arbeidsdeskundige ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten van het arbeidsdeskundig onderzoek en/of werkplekonderzoeken op de werklocatie, inclusief het opmaken van de rapportage. Dit houdt in dat je middels een bedrijfsbezoek in gesprek gaat met de klant (werkgever) en zijn medewerker (werknemer). Met de werkgever stem je de verwachtingen af (op basis van de bevindingen van de bedrijfsarts) en met de werknemer ga je uitgebreid in gesprek over de mogelijkheden van werk. Indien mogelijk ga je bij voorkeur ook op bezoek bij de klant om de werksituatie te bekijken en te analyseren. Soms ligt een oplossing in een kleine verandering, maar soms adviseer je ook om de werknemer ander werk te laten doen. Jouw expertise is hierin het belangrijkste, want jij bent verantwoordelijk voor hoe en op wat voor tempo de werknemer weer aan het werk kan. Al dan niet bij de huidige werkgever.

Als schakel tussen werkgever en werknemer weet jij van nature hoe je boven beide partijen komt te staan. Een goede voorbereiding wordt daarom van je gevraagd voordat je met beiden in gesprek gaat. Tijdens jouw onderzoek zet je jouw sterke vaardigheden in: je luistert, vraagt door, analyseert en benoemt de pijnpunten die je opmerkt. Hierna deel je jouw advies met werknemer en werkgever en stel je hierover een rapport op. Ook is het belangrijk dat je nauw in contact bent met jouw collega’s op kantoor. De casemanagers horen graag jouw bevindingen omtrent de casus en zullen met je sparren over de situatie. Wat raad jij aan? Waar liggen de mogelijkheden? Hebben we voldaan aan de regel- en wetgeving en ligt de juiste informatie bij het UWV? Als sparringpartner weet jij met raad en daad hierin jouw collega’s, de klant en de werknemers bij te staan.

Ons arbeidsdeskundig team werkt vanuit de standplaats Utrecht, maar je collega’s wonen en werken door het hele land.

Wie zijn we?

Bij Assist Verzuim, de actieve Arbodienst, zetten we ons al twintig jaar in om kleine en grote bedrijven in uiteenlopende branches te verrassen met onze persoonlijke en doordachte aanpak. Als gecertificeerde, landelijk opererende arbodienst met sterke regionale wortels, combineren we gezond verstand met een persoonlijke benadering. Dit stelt ons in staat om maatwerk te leveren voor zowel werkgevers als werknemers. Onze betrokken en gemotiveerde medewerkers zijn zich bewust van hun verantwoordelijkheid en dragen actief bij aan ons motto: meer aandacht, gezonder werk! Bij ons maak je deel uit van een team dat écht het verschil maakt.

Assist Verzuim is onderdeel van Veldsink Groep

Assist Verzuim is een onderdeel van Veldsink Groep, een familiebedrijf dat sinds 1979 actief is binnen de financiële dienstverlening en de arbodienstverlening. Inmiddels bestaat de holding uit meerdere bedrijven en meer dan 1400 werknemers. De warmte, de nuchterheid en betrokkenheid is hier dagelijks voelbaar en daar zijn we trots op. We groeien door ons ondernemerschap, door onze gedrevenheid en door het feit dat alle medewerkers de kans krijgen zich optimaal te ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van arbeidsdeskundige onderzoeken, hebt een hart voor de mens en houdt van de dynamiek die elke nieuwe casus met zich mee brengt. Daarnaast ben je empathisch maar kun je als de situatie hierom vraagt ook zakelijk zijn. Je bent gedreven en wilt resultaat zien. Je onderzoekt en weet wat je kunt bereiken en verliest het belang van de werknemer en werkgever nooit uit het oog. Met jouw inlevingsvermogen en creativiteit maak je het verschil. Daarnaast:

  • Heb je ervaring in de rol van Arbeidsdeskundige;
  • Ben je in het bezit bent van een Hbo-diploma tot Arbeidsdeskundige;
  • Ben je geregistreerd bij de Stichting Register Arbeidsdeskundigen;
  • Heb je kennis van sociale wetgeving en de veranderingen op dit gebied;
  • Ben je goed in het managen van verwachtingen en kunt uitstekend omgaan met verschillende belangen;
  • Beschik je over zeer goede mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden en je helder kunt uitleggen hoe jouw oordeel tot stand is gekomen.

Dit vind je bij ons

  • Een salaris tussen de € 3.000,- en € 5.500,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur (afhankelijk van kennis- en ervaring);
  • Naast je salaris krijg je een goede pensioensregeling, waarvan wij 2/3 betalen;
  • 29 vakantiedagen o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen;

· Reiskostenvergoeding;

  • De Veldsink Academy voor jouw persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling;
  • De mogelijkheid om thuis te werken met daarbij een thuiswerkvergoeding;

· Voordeliger sporten;

  • Een fietsplan waardoor je voordelig een (elektrische) fiets kan leasen;

· Gezellige bedrijfsfeestjes.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, MSSP, you will be tasked with owning messaging and content for the MSSP (Managed Security Service Provider) audience, a distinct buyer with its own economics, delivery model, and competitive set. You'll translate SentinelOne's platform story into positioning, content, and enablement that helps MSSPs sell, deliver, and scale on top of our platform. You'll work closely with teams across Marketing, Partner, Sales, and Product to create and maintain MSSP-specific messaging.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own the MSSP-specific messaging, including pricing/packaging language, multi-tenant management, co-managed vs. fully-managed models, and margin/economics framing that resonates with partner leadership.
  • Keep MSSP positioning aligned to corporate narrative while adapting it to a partner lens.
  • Maintain a clear point of view on how SentinelOne's platform model reduces MSSP operational overhead versus point-tool stacks.
  • Build and maintain the MSSP partner enablement kit, including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, and sales plays tailored to how MSSPs sell and deliver.
  • Develop MSSP-specific case studies and proof points, and adapt existing customer proof points for a partner-delivery narrative.
  • Produce webinars, partner newsletters, and co-marketing content in partnership with Alliances.
  • Track the MSSP-friendly competitive landscape and translate findings into trap questions and differentiation for partner sales teams; partner with Competitive Intelligence to keep MSSP content current and relevant.
  • Train partner-facing Sales and Alliances teams on MSSP messaging, packaging, and objection handling.
  • Act as the go-to PMM resource for MSSP-related questions from Sales, Alliances, and the partners themselves.
  • Partner with Product Marketing leads across product areas to ensure MSSP content reflects current product capabilities and roadmap; flag MSSP-specific messaging gaps or conflicts to the broader PMM team before content ships externally.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5 or more years in product marketing or partner marketing, with direct experience marketing to or through MSSPs, MSPs, or channel partners in cybersecurity or enterprise software.
  • Working knowledge of MSSP business models, including per-endpoint/per-seat pricing, multi-tenant consoles, and co-managed and fully-managed delivery.
  • Proven ability to translate platform/product messaging into partner-economics language without losing brand consistency.
  • Strong writing and content production skills across decks, one-pagers, battlecards, and case studies.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Partners, Sales, and Marketing functions.
  • Cybersecurity domain knowledge is a strong plus.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

⚠️ Immediate Joiners Only — candidates currently serving notice with immediate availability or very short notice period will be prioritized. Candidates with a long notice period (30+ days) may not be considered given the urgency of this requirement.
About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced DB Developer to join our Workforce Management (WFM) team on an urgent basis. Our WFM application is backed by MS SQL Server and currently has a codebase of 7,000+ stored procedures. We need a hands-on developer who can quickly ramp up, troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain this large and complex stored procedure library while also supporting day-to-day database administration needs.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, debug, and optimize complex T-SQL stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers within the WFM database environment.
Analyze, refactor, and performance-tune existing stored procedures (7,000+) to improve execution efficiency and maintainability.
Troubleshoot production issues related to stored procedures, jobs, and data integrity within tight SLAs.
Perform query optimization, indexing strategy, and execution plan analysis to resolve performance bottlenecks.
Support core DBA activities: backups, restores, job scheduling (SQL Agent), monitoring, user/permission management, and basic capacity planning.
Collaborate with application developers and business teams to translate WFM business logic into efficient database code.
Participate in code reviews, version control practices, and deployment/release processes for database changes.
Document database objects, changes, and standard operating procedures.
Provide production support, including occasional off-hours support for critical issues.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience:
3–4 years of hands-on experience as a DB Developer / SQL Developer.
Solid, demonstrable experience in a DBA capacity (backups/restores, job scheduling, monitoring, security/permissions, performance tuning) — this is mandatory, not optional.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) — writing and optimizing complex T-SQL (stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, CTEs).
Experience working with large-scale stored procedure codebases (prior exposure to high-volume SP environments is a strong plus).
Good understanding of query performance tuning, indexing, and execution plans.
Familiarity with SQL Server Agent jobs, SSIS (preferred), and basic replication/HA concepts (Always On, mirroring, log shipping) is a plus.
Experience with Workforce Management (WFM) systems or similar transaction-heavy enterprise applications is a strong advantage.
Ability to work independently, prioritize under pressure, and handle production support responsibilities.
Good communication skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Good to Have:
Exposure on version control tools (Git, Azure DevOps, etc.) for database change management.
Knowledge of database CI/CD or migration tools (Flyway, Liquibase, Redgate, DACPAC).
Basic scripting (PowerShell) for automation of DBA tasks.

Senior Full-Stack .NET Web Developer

Location: Remote
Employment Type: Contract

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack .NET Web Developer with deep expertise across the full web stack — from server-side C#/.NET services to modern JavaScript front ends — to join our technology team. The ideal candidate will bring at least a decade of professional software development experience, with a strong track record of designing, building, and maintaining polished, secure, and high-performing web applications. This role requires a blend of technical excellence, UI/UX sensibility, problem-solving, and leadership to architect, build, and optimize mission-critical, public-facing web systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible web applications using ASP.NET Core (MVC/Razor Pages) and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Build and maintain RESTful/GraphQL APIs and backend services in C#/.NET that power front-end applications and integrate with SQL Server and other enterprise systems.
  • Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into clean, semantic, cross-browser HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Architect scalable, secure, and performant front-end and back-end web architectures, including component libraries, state management, and reusable UI patterns.

  • Support cloud-based hosting and deployment initiatives using Azure (App Service, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to front-end and back-end technical best practices, code reviews, and architectural discussions.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid, reliable, and automated web application deployments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize web application performance, scalability, and reliability in production.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong emphasis on web application development.
  • Proven expertise in C#/.NET (Core/Framework), including ASP.NET Core MVC/Razor Pages and building RESTful APIs.
  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript/TypeScript and hands-on experience with at least one major front-end framework (React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Solid command of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive, cross-browser design principles.
  • Proven experience with SQL Server (or comparable relational databases) and strong SQL query and optimization skills.
  • Experience implementing web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA / Section 508).
  • Experience with Azure, including App Service, DevOps/CI-CD pipelines, and cloud deployment for web applications.
  • Strong understanding of web application security best practices (authentication/authorization, OWASP Top 10, data protection).
  • Excellent problem-solving, troubleshooting, debugging, communication, and leadership abilities across front-end, back-end, and database code.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with public sector or government web applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage generative AI and AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality, code review, refactoring, unit-test creation, troubleshooting/debugging, and technical documentation while validating generated output for accuracy and security.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Power Automate, or other Microsoft 365 integration technologies.
  • Relevant technical certifications in web development, .NET, Azure, or JavaScript frameworks.
  • Prior experience leading small development teams or mentoring peers.

Why Contract with Us?

  • Contract is with local government entity
  • Serve in a high-impact senior technical role supporting mission-critical public services across traditional Microsoft enterprise technologies and modern Azure-native services.
  • Support a strategic Azure-hosted messaging platform while strengthening automation, reliability, and troubleshooting capabilities through an independent contractor engagement with competitive hourly compensation.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Technical Marketing Manager, you will be tasked with owning the technical story that earns SentinelOne attention long before a deal exists, across our market-leading Singularity™ Platform: Endpoint Security, Cloud Security, AI Security, and the Autonomous SOC, and the products behind them, Singularity Endpoint, Singularity Cloud, Singularity Identity, Singularity AI-SIEM, Purple AI, and Prompt Security. Your job is to make the practitioners and technical influencers who shape buying decisions curious enough to come looking. Technical Marketing and Product Marketing are different jobs here: Product Marketing owns the market story, including segmentation, positioning strategy, pricing, launch, and the business case, while you own the technical one.

Some travel may be required.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead one or two medium to high impact projects while contributing to several others, creating the demos, content, and technical thought leadership that earn practitioners' attention early.
  • Own the technical value proposition for the work you take on, articulating the how and the why behind the product, not only the what; develop, refine, and defend technical positioning covering technical benefits, integration capabilities, security features, and performance metrics, and translate it into customer-centric narratives a practitioner recognizes as true.
  • Develop and land high-quality technical content, including white papers, technical blogs, solution briefs, deployment and integration guides, technical articles, FAQs, and reference architectures, making each one an argument a practitioner wants to follow rather than a specification they have to decode; build for reuse so each piece keeps producing long after the launch that prompted it, and hold the technical accuracy line on your own work and on the content you review for others.
  • Develop demos, demo scenarios, webinars, and videos end to end, from the environment it runs on through the final edit, with light manager input rather than step-by-step direction, standing up whatever environment you need and pressure-testing what you are about to say before it reaches a slide.
  • Design realistic attack and threat simulations that bring customer outcomes to life, and turn public testing such as MITRE ATT&CK Evaluations into content practitioners actually want to read.
  • Own the plan and the calendar for the work you take on, sequencing topical content, community activity, and thought leadership against launches, threat events, and what practitioners are already talking about; run it like a program with named deliverables, real dates, and a current view of who owes what, chasing contributors you do not manage and landing the work on the date you committed to across competing timelines.
  • Use data and insights, including content performance, demo telemetry, field feedback, and search behavior, to decide what to make next and what to retire.
  • Work closely with product management, product engineering, detection engineering, threat research, product marketing, sales engineering, and analyst and media relations to stay ahead of what is shipping, why it was built that way, and where adversary tradecraft is moving; partner with competitive and market intelligence, bringing the hands-on technical read to the market picture they own, build the credibility and relationships that make people who do not report to you want to help, and bring the right people in when a problem is bigger than your project.
  • Present the work at webinars, user groups, and partner engagements as opportunities come up, and stay active in the communities where security practitioners discuss this technology.
  • Carry real deployment and evaluation feedback into product management and engineering, grounded in what you see in labs, proofs of concept and value, competitive bake-offs, and architecture and design reviews, and bring whatever instincts you built in a customer-facing technical seat to that work.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • Big passion for cyber-security and for the technology itself, with genuine enjoyment in understanding how a product works under the hood.
  • Real technical depth and the hands-on habits that keep it current, a requirement we do not flex: you stand up your own lab, build your own demo environment, run your own tests, read the detection logic, and hold a technical conversation with detection engineers and threat researchers without an interpreter.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint, cloud, identity, and data security, and familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • 3 to 5 years of directly related experience, or 4 to 6 years of general professional experience, across technical marketing, sales engineering, solutions architecture, product management, or a hands-on security operations role.
  • Strong storytelling in both writing and demos: the ability to carry a technical argument in prose, edit your own work down hard, land the same argument live in a demo, and simplify complex technical concepts without flattening them into marketing language, with presence and credibility in a room of practitioners.
  • Strong organizational skills: you track your own deliverables and dates, keep a dozen threads straight at once, and people hear about a slip from you before they notice it themselves.
  • A highly collaborative, low-ego approach, comfort in cross-functional teams with competing priorities, the ability to build technical partnerships that outlast any single launch, and a positive, problem-solving attitude.
  • The ability to operate independently inside established procedures, taking a demo or piece of content from idea to published with light manager input, holding a consistent delivery cadence rather than working in bursts, and building frameworks others can reuse rather than one-offs only you can run.
  • A growth mindset with comfort in experimentation, data-driven about what is working and unsentimental about what is not, with the relentlessness to stay with a hard problem, adjust when the evidence says to, and land the commitment you made.
  • Prior technical marketing engineer or sales engineer experience is preferred but not critical if the depth above and proven demo-building, content, and positioning skills can be demonstrated.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match

  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAt Ledgebrook, we’re building a next-generation insurance infrastructure — fast, smart, and scalable — and are looking for a Director of Credit & Collateral Risk to protect the balance sheet of Stonehaven Specialty Insurance Company, Ledgebrook’s new third-party hybrid fronting carrier.
jobs.description:
Description

At Ledgebrook, we’re building a next-generation insurance infrastructure — fast, smart, and scalable — and are looking for a Director of Credit & Collateral Risk to protect the balance sheet of Stonehaven Specialty Insurance Company, Ledgebrook’s new third-party hybrid fronting carrier.

This role reports to the Chief Risk Officer and provides independent credit review of every counterparty Stonehaven relies on. It works closely with Finance, Legal, the Director of Ceded Reinsurance, and the program teams, and approves counterparties independently of the people who negotiate with them.

About the Role

Stonehaven is seeking a Director of Credit & Collateral Risk to independently approve, monitor, and secure every counterparty on its balance sheet, from reinsurers and captives to MGAs, TPAs, and banks. The successful candidate will be a seasoned credit risk professional with hands-on command of letters of credit, reinsurance trusts, and collateral sizing, a track record of enforcing concentration limits and running watch-list governance, and the independence and judgment to decline a counterparty regardless of the program attached to it.

﻿What You'll Do:

  • Maintain the Third-Party Credit Risk Policy for the Chief Risk Officer, including credit standards by counterparty type, reinsurer credit tiers, concentration limits, and the exception process.
  • Perform independent due diligence and credit approval for reinsurers, captives, MGAs, TPAs, banks, premium finance companies, and surplus lines brokers before Stonehaven engages them, including reinsurers that arrive attached to a program.
  • Independently verify all collateral, confirming letters of credit directly with issuing banks and trust assets directly with trustees, never relying on counterparty-supplied documents alone.
  • Size collateral for each collateralized reinsurer and captive, compare required and posted collateral monthly, and issue and escalate top-up demands when collateral falls short.
  • Monitor the credit quality of letter-of-credit issuing banks and ensure every letter of credit comes from an eligible institution.
  • Enforce hard concentration limits per reinsurer, reinsurer group, collateral provider, and bank, and in aggregate across all programs.
  • Build and maintain the counterparty credit risk register, the collateral register, and the aggregate credit exposure dashboard with Finance and Technology.
  • Run ongoing monitoring of rating alerts, financial statements obtained from independent sources, recoverable aging, MGA premium trust accounts, and TPA loss funds.
  • Manage the Watch List, including placement triggers, required actions, exit plans, and Board notification.
  • Design and run the credit stress scenarios used in ORSA, including reinsurer default, simultaneous downgrades, letter-of-credit bank failure, and MGA or TPA insolvency.
  • Present counterparty, collateral, and concentration status to the Reinsurance Security and Risk & Capital Committees, and support Finance on Schedule F, RBC credit risk, and Form F disclosures.
  • Review material contracts with Legal through a credit lens, including offset rights, collateral triggers, security interests, and termination for financial cause.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years in credit risk, reinsurance security, or counterparty risk at an insurer, reinsurer, rating agency, or financial institution.
  • Either an actuarial or accounting background
  • Hands-on experience with collateral structures, including letters of credit and reinsurance trust accounts.
  • Strong financial statement analysis across insurers and non-insurance counterparties.
  • Working knowledge of statutory credit for reinsurance, Schedule F, and RBC credit risk charges.

Nice to Haves:

  • Prior experience on a reinsurance security committee or at a fronting or program carrier.
  • Experience evaluating captives, ILS vehicles, or other collateralized reinsurance capacity.
  • Professional designation such as CFA, FRM, PRM, or CPCU.
  • Experience building risk registers, dashboards, or credit monitoring tools.

Benefits

US Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

Compensation

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is $200,000-450,000 This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

For Candidates Applying From The U.S.:

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

Ledgebrook may use Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) as part of the job application process, including to assist us in evaluating your application. AI is used as a support tool, and hiring decisions are made by human recruiters. By submitting your information, you acknowledge that the company may use AI tools as part of our evaluation. If you need a reasonable accommodation or alternative review process because of a disability or other legally protected basis, contact . Requesting an accommodation will not negatively affect your application.

jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Corporate IT Engineer to our Corporate IT team in Brazil - Remote! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

CorpIT builds scalable, data-driven solutions that raise Wellhubber productivity across the organization. This role sits at the center of that mandate: you will be the technical owner and strategic voice for the platforms that every Wellhubber touches daily, balancing hands-on administration with long-term technology and vendor strategy. Reporting directly to the Corporate IT Director, you will act as a high-level technical lead and individual contributor, driving strategic partnerships with global vendors, managing enterprise AI capabilities, and collaborating across infrastructure, infosec, and executive leadership without people-management overhead.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Own the end-to-end administration, configuration, and lifecycle management of our core corporate IT platforms (including Google Workspace, access tools, and endpoint ecosystems) from discovery to retirement.
  • Drive our enterprise AI strategy hands-on by evaluating, installing, configuring, maintaining, and integrating tools like Gemini and Claude, while actively monitoring token costs and system efficiency.
  • Establish and maintain a multi-quarter technology roadmap for all owned platforms, anticipating future business needs, evaluating market innovations, and executing time-bound milestones.
  • Lead vendor relationship management end-to-end, steering contract renewals, pricing negotiations, SLA enforcement, and technical escalations directly with global tech partners.
  • Own software licensing and cost optimization, systematically auditing usage data to right-size tiers and deliver transparent cost savings to leadership.
  • Partner closely with Infosec, Legal, and Compliance to maintain secure access policies (ZTNA/SASE, SSO/MFA) and uphold strict security standards such as SOC 2 and GDPR.
  • Take a hands-on approach as an escalation subject-matter expert, building automated self-service workflows while solving complex cross-functional challenges alongside internal squads.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A highly experienced technical leader with hands-on experience in corporate IT engineering and enterprise systems architecture, with a proven track record as an individual contributor.
  • An expert in Google Workspace administration at scale, with solid in-depth knowledge of Admin Console settings, DLP, SSO/MFA, and enterprise productivity governance.
  • A forward-thinking technologist with deep familiarity in enterprise AI tools (such as Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI), possessing the ability to deploy, integrate, manage access, and govern usage costs.
  • A skilled negotiator with extensive experience managing enterprise SaaS vendors, holding partners accountable to SLAs, and driving complex contract renewals.
  • A strategic thinker with the ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams without direct authority, translating technical trade-offs into business value.
  • A security-conscious engineer with solid knowledge of secure cloud access, network connectivity (Zscaler or equivalent SASE/ZTNA), and data residency compliance.
  • An effective and clear communicator with full professional fluency in written and spoken English, capable of negotiating with international vendors and collaborating across distributed teams.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Google Workspace enterprise administration, hands-on enterprise AI implementation/governance, and fluent English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.description:
About Lastwall

We are a cybersecurity company with offices in the United States and Canada, specializing in the development and delivery of highly secure, identity-centric, and quantum-resilient cybersecurity solutions. We aim to build innovative, security-first technologies designed for compliance-driven and threat-intensive environments such as those found in defense, government, and critical infrastructure sectors.

Our solutions are engineered with a security-first approach, leveraging cutting-edge advancements in identity and digital defense to outpace threat actors and protect sensitive systems from evolving cyber threats. By focusing on inhibiting the efficacy of adversaries and exponentially bolstering client security, we provide essential tools to safeguard operations in some of the most mission-critical industries.

If you’re a US or Canadian Citizen who is passionate about working at the forefront of cybersecurity technology in environments that demand unparalleled security and reliability, we’d love to have you join our team!

The Opportunity

Lastwall is a Canadian cybersecurity company focused on identity and mission-critical operations across defense, government, and critical infrastructure.

Trusted by the U.S. Department of Defense and the Government of Canada, Lastwall has spent nearly a decade securing sensitive government environments. With FedRAMP Moderate Authorization, proven traction in the U.S. federal market, and growing demand for sovereign cybersecurity capability, we are entering a defining growth phase across Canada and the United States.

We are hiring a Lead Infrastructure Engineer to help design, operate, and scale the infrastructure that supports Lastwall’s secure identity platform. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can own production systems, improve reliability and security, and help mature the infrastructure practices behind mission-critical software.

You will work across cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, observability, reliability, security, and compliance-driven operations. The right candidate will be comfortable operating in high-trust environments where uptime, auditability, resilience, and secure execution matter.

You will join a small, high-impact engineering team where technical judgment, ownership, and practical leadership are essential. You will help strengthen the systems, practices, and infrastructure foundations that allow Lastwall to scale with demanding government, defense, and critical infrastructure customers.

Headquartered in Fredericton, New Brunswick, and with offices in Vancouver and Honolulu, Lastwall is positioned to help strengthen North American cyber resilience.

The Role

  • Infrastructure Leadership
    • Lead the design, implementation, and operation of secure, reliable infrastructure that supports Lastwall’s identity platform. Help define infrastructure standards, operating practices, and technical direction as the company scales.
  • Cloud & Platform Operations
    • Build, manage, and improve cloud-based systems across development, staging, and production environments. Support infrastructure that is scalable, observable, secure, and resilient for enterprise and government customers.
  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code
    • Develop and maintain automation for provisioning, deployment, configuration, and environment management. Use infrastructure-as-code practices to improve repeatability, reduce manual effort, and support secure change management.
  • Reliability, Observability & Performance
    • Improve system reliability through monitoring, alerting, logging, metrics, and incident response practices. Help define and track service health, availability, performance, and operational readiness.
  • Security & Compliance-Driven Infrastructure
    • Apply secure infrastructure practices across cloud environments, access controls, secrets management, networking, deployment pipelines, and production operations. Support compliance-driven requirements for regulated and high-trust customers.
  • CI/CD & Developer Enablement
    • Partner with software developers to improve build, test, deployment, and release workflows. Help maintain and evolve CI/CD pipelines that support secure and efficient delivery of Lastwall’s products.
  • Incident Response & Operational Ownership
    • Participate in production support, troubleshooting, incident response, and Learning From Incidents. Bring structure to operational issues and help improve systems so recurring problems are addressed at the source.
  • Technical Mentorship
    • Provide technical mentorship to engineers working with infrastructure, deployment, and production systems. Help raise the team’s infrastructure maturity through documentation, review, guidance, and practical standards.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of professional infrastructure, DevOps, platform, SRE, or systems engineering experience, ideally in SaaS, cybersecurity, identity, government technology, or other complex software environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience operating distributed systems in production cloud infrastructure, including secure, reliable, and scalable systems.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code, automation, environment management, and repeatable deployment practices.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build systems, deployment automation, and developer enablement.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar.
  • Experience with EC2, Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized workloads.
  • Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, security controls, and production operations.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, and incident response.
  • Familiarity with secure infrastructure practices, including access control, secrets management, segmentation, vulnerability management, and least-privilege design.
  • Ability to work independently and lead technical initiatives end-to-end, from design through implementation, documentation, and operational handoff.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering, security, product, and operations.
  • Comfort in a small but growing company, where ownership, adaptability, and practical execution matter.

Nice to Have

  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including AWS GovCloud or similarly regulated cloud environments.
  • Experience working in FedRAMP, government, defense, critical infrastructure, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with containerized environments, such as Docker and orchestration platforms.
  • Experience supporting Rust, PostgreSQL, and modern web application infrastructure.
  • Experience with compliance frameworks, audit evidence collection, or secure change-management processes.
  • Experience with high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, backup strategy, and resilience planning.
  • Familiarity with authentication, identity, PKI, SAML, OAuth, OIDC, or Zero Trust architectures.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or helping lead an infrastructure, DevOps, platform, or SRE function.

Why Lastwall?

Lastwall offers a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of the role. Final compensation will reflect experience, location, and fit with the mandate.

This is an opportunity to join after the product, customers, and proof points are real—but before the next stage of scale is fully built. Lastwall has a proven platform, demanding customers, meaningful accreditations, strong market timing, and new strategic perspective from investors and board leadership.

At Lastwall, your voice is heard, recognized, and valued. We are building a people-first, security-always culture where strong contributors can have meaningful impact as the company grows.

For the right candidate, this is a chance to help build secure, resilient infrastructure at the intersection of identity, sovereignty, resilience, and national security.
