jobs.description:
BOOKKEEPER

Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 20 Hours/Week

This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.

VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.

We are looking for an experienced Bookkeeper who is already doing this work independently, whether through their own practice or freelance engagements, and who can adapt to different chart of accounts structures, navigate varied client preferences, and deliver results without needing repeated direction. You will own the financial record-keeping for your assigned clients, manage the full bookkeeping cycle, and serve as a trusted point of contact for anything related to the numbers. The contractors who succeed in this role carry their expertise confidently and communicate with clients the same way.

Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another's success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.

Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.

EXPECTATIONS

Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive and Professional Manner

  • Bring a professional standard to every client interaction, written and verbal, that reflects the quality and credibility VaVa is known for.
  • Treat all client financial information as strictly confidential. Use only approved tools and storage, follow each client's data security requirements, and never enter client data into unsanctioned AI tools or share it outside the scope of the engagement.
  • Embrace VaVa’s values and contribute to a contractor culture built on accountability, consistency, and genuine investment in one another’s success.
  • Maintain open communication with the VaVa team and participate in regular contractor calls and all-company gatherings.

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

  • Manage the full bookkeeping relationship for each assigned client, including communication, deliverable timelines, and proactive issue resolution.
  • Flag financial discrepancies, process gaps, and potential issues before they become problems for the client.
  • Adapt to each client’s chart of accounts, preferences, and industry context without requiring repeated direction on the same item.
  • Deliver accurate, complete, and timely work in every engagement, and communicate clearly when timelines or scope need to shift.
  • Track engagement hours with awareness and flag any need to adjust hours up or down to maintain quality of service.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Set up and maintain client accounts in their preferred financial software, including chart of accounts configuration, account mapping, and initial data migration as needed.
  • Run the full bookkeeping cycle for clients across varied industries and company sizes, including transaction entry, categorization, and reconciliation.
  • Reconcile monthly bank statements, credit card accounts, and long-term liability accounts with accuracy and within agreed timelines.
  • Manage month-end close for each client, ensuring all financials are accurate, complete, and delivered on schedule.
  • Generate and issue financial statements including profit and loss reports, balance sheets, accounts payable and receivable reports, and any additional reporting the client requires.
  • Process accounts payable and accounts receivable as needed, including issuing invoices, recording incoming payments, and following up with client customers on outstanding balances.
  • Record and categorize company expenses in alignment with the client’s chart of accounts and annual budget, and flag material variances to the client.
  • Identify and resolve categorization issues or last-minute adjustments based on client preferences and GAAP standards, with clear documentation of the reasoning.
  • Maintain an organized financial filing system for each client that supports easy retrieval, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable local, state, and federal reporting requirements.
  • Keep all client financial data strictly confidential; use only approved tools and storage, follow each client's data security requirements, and never transmit or process sensitive information outside sanctioned systems.
  • Prepare financial documentation for external auditors, CPAs, or tax preparers when requested.
  • Communicate proactively with each client about task completion, reporting status, and any items requiring their input or decision.
  • Apply automation within bookkeeping software to streamline reconciliation, categorization, and reporting workflows where appropriate.
  • Manage competing client deadlines across multiple engagements without compromising accuracy or timeliness for any one client.
  • Complete additional bookkeeping tasks as requested, within the scope of the contractor engagement.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States.
  • At least 3 years of demonstrated bookkeeping or accounting experience, including direct responsibility for client accounts.
  • At least 2 years of experience working full-time in a virtual or remote capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting multiple clients across different industries; candidates who are actively running their own bookkeeping practice or taking on independent freelance engagements are strongly preferred.
  • Available at least 20 hours per week to support high-touch, deliverable-focused clients.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and its application across different business types and sizes.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

  • Demonstrated proficiency in QuickBooks Online, including setup, reconciliation, reporting, and chart of accounts management.
  • Experience using at least one alternate financial software platform such as Xero, Wave, or equivalent.
  • Experience building and maintaining chart of accounts for clients across different industries, including account mapping and structural adjustments.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, including formulas, data organization, and financial reporting formats.
  • Experience with high-volume transaction entry, bank reconciliation, invoicing, and payment processing.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace; regular use of Slack and Zoom for client and team communication.
  • Experience with at least one expense management tool (e.g., Bill.com, Ramp, Concur) for processing and tracking client business expenses.
  • AI literacy; comfort using AI tools to support research, draft client communications, and identify workflow efficiencies, with an understanding of what client data should and should not be entered into AI systems.

Preferred

  • Experience in nonprofit bookkeeping, including fund accounting, grant tracking, and compliance with nonprofit financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience with legal billing and trust accounting, including IOLTA compliance and matter-based expense tracking.
  • Experience with medical billing or coding, or familiarity with the financial workflows specific to medical practices and HIPAA.
  • Proficiency in at least one project management tool (e.g., Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Trello) for tracking client deliverables and deadlines.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as Zapier to reduce manual steps in recurring bookkeeping processes.
  • Experience processing payroll through QuickBooks Online, Gusto, ADP, or equivalent.

EDUCATION

A degree is not required. Relevant experience and a track record of client work carry more weight than academic credentials.

Candidates without a degree should hold at least one relevant certification. Examples include: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, Intuit Bookkeeping Professional, NACPB Bookkeeping Certification, or a comparable credential from an accredited provider. An Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred where held.

A commitment to continued learning is an expectation of this role. Accounting standards, tax regulations, and software capabilities shift regularly; staying current is part of the job.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated, bilingual Appointment Setter who speaks fluent English and Spanish to convert incoming leads into confirmed appointments for salon and beauty service businesses targeting customers in New York.

The company has an established software platform that generates a high volume of leads. The primary challenge is converting these leads into appointments quickly, consistently, and effectively. The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator, a confident salesperson, and a results-driven professional who can engage prospects, follow up consistently, overcome objections, and upsell services when appropriate.

Candidates with 3–5 years of experience in the salon or beauty industry are strongly preferred. However, candidates from other professional backgrounds with proven sales, appointment-setting, or lead-conversion experience are also encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contact incoming leads promptly through phone calls, text messages, email, or other designated communication channels.

  • Convert inbound leads into confirmed appointments for salon and beauty service businesses.

  • Follow up consistently with prospects to improve response rates and appointment conversion.

  • Engage potential customers professionally, understand their needs, and communicate the value of the services offered.

  • Handle customer questions, objections, and hesitations to move prospects toward booking an appointment.

  • Identify opportunities to upsell services and increase customer engagement and revenue.

  • Maintain accurate records of lead interactions, follow-up activities, appointment status, and conversion outcomes within the company's software platform or CRM.

  • Manage a high volume of leads while maintaining responsiveness, professionalism, and attention to detail.

  • Ensure prospective customers receive timely and consistent communication to improve the overall customer experience.

  • Meet or exceed performance targets related to appointments booked, lead conversion, follow-up completion, and upselling.

  • Identify recurring lead-conversion challenges and recommend improvements to outreach and sales processes.

  • Collaborate with the team to improve appointment-setting strategies and contribute to business growth.

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent in both English and Spanish, with strong verbal communication skills in both languages.

  • Clear, professional spoken English suitable for communicating with customers in the New York market.

  • A neutral or light accent that is easy for New York-based customers to understand.

  • Proven experience in appointment setting, inside sales, telesales, customer engagement, lead generation, or sales development.

  • Strong persuasion, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

  • Ability to convert leads into confirmed appointments and maintain consistent follow-up.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a high volume of incoming leads.

  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.

  • Self-motivated, organized, and accountable for individual performance metrics.

  • Comfortable using CRM systems, lead management software, scheduling tools, and communication platforms.

  • Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable remote working environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience working in the salon, spa, beauty, aesthetics, or personal care industry.

  • Experience booking appointments for salons, spas, beauty professionals, or service-based businesses.

  • Demonstrated success in lead conversion, sales, upselling, and appointment scheduling.

  • Experience working with customers or businesses in the United States, particularly New York.

  • Background in digital marketing, SEO, lead generation, or marketing operations.

  • Experience identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates and generate additional business growth.

  • Familiarity with sales KPIs, CRM reporting, and performance-based compensation models.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a confident, persuasive, and customer-focused professional who understands that appointment setting involves more than simply making calls. They know how to respond quickly to leads, build trust, create interest, overcome objections, and secure bookings.

A candidate with salon or beauty industry experience will have an advantage because they are familiar with the services, customer expectations, and booking process. However, strong sales ability, bilingual communication, consistent follow-up, and measurable conversion performance are the most important factors.

Application Requirements

Candidates must be based in Latin America and fluent in English and Spanish.

As part of the initial screening process, candidates must submit a short video introduction or call recording in which they speak about their professional background, relevant experience, and interest in the role. The recording will be used to assess spoken English clarity, communication skills, confidence, and suitability for customer-facing sales responsibilities.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview and may be asked to complete a brief role-play exercise demonstrating how they would contact a lead, handle an objection, and convert the prospect into a confirmed appointment.

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to respond to leads quickly, consistently convert prospects into appointments, drive upselling opportunities, and contribute to improved client satisfaction and business growth.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

Preferred

  • Familiarity with data reporting tools or dashboards used to surface business performance insights

Business Development Manager

Candidate Location: South Africa
Working Arrangement: Fully Remote
Working Hours: United Kingdom 09h00 to 17h00, Monday to Friday

﻿Salary Range: ﻿R40,000 to R52,000 per month + commission ( Based on Experience )

Focus: B2B Business Development, Outbound Sales and New Business Growth

About the Business

Our client is an established Australian B2B business development and outsourced sales company working with organisations across a range of professional services and B2B sectors.

The business partners with clients to identify target markets, engage senior decision makers, qualify genuine opportunities and build sustainable sales pipelines.

Following strong growth in Australia, the business is now beginning its expansion into the United Kingdom. This role will be one of the first dedicated positions supporting that expansion and provides an exciting opportunity to play a meaningful role in building its United Kingdom presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Business Development Manager based in South Africa to drive new business development across the United Kingdom market.

This is a hands-on sales role for someone who enjoys creating opportunities from the ground up. You will combine proactive outbound prospecting with opportunity qualification, discovery meetings and progressing prospects through the sales process.

Your time will be split between supporting an established client campaign and developing new business for the company's growing United Kingdom operation.

This is not a pure appointment setting role. We are looking for someone who can prospect confidently while developing into a self-sufficient Business Development Manager capable of owning opportunities from initial outreach through to conversion.

Key Responsibilities

Client Campaign | Approximately 1 Day Per Week

You will support an established client campaign focused on generating qualified opportunities within the United Kingdom market.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting targeted outbound prospecting into identified organisations
  • Cold calling relevant decision makers across the United Kingdom
  • Engaging prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn
  • Qualifying prospects against agreed criteria and the defined Ideal Customer Profile
  • Building rapport and identifying genuine business opportunities
  • Booking qualified meetings for the client team
  • Maintaining accurate prospect, activity and opportunity information within the Customer Relationship Management system
  • Following agreed messaging, scripts and campaign strategies
  • Working closely with the Sales Operations team to maximize campaign performance
  • Working towards agreed activity, conversation and opportunity targets
  • Target lists, contact information, direct phone numbers, systems, messaging, scripts and campaign training will be provided.

United Kingdom Business Development | Approximately 4 Days Per Week

The majority of your week will focus on helping establish and grow the business within the United Kingdom market.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting proactive outbound prospecting into defined United Kingdom target markets
  • Engaging senior decision makers and starting meaningful commercial conversations
  • Generating new opportunities through cold calling, email and LinkedIn
  • Conducting initial discovery and qualification meetings
  • Understanding prospective clients' businesses, challenges and commercial requirements
  • Assessing whether opportunities represent a genuine commercial fit
  • Developing and progressing qualified opportunities through the B2B sales pipeline
  • Managing follow ups and maintaining momentum across active opportunities
  • Supporting proposals and commercial discussions
  • Initially working alongside senior leadership during later stage sales meetings
  • Building and managing a sustainable pipeline of new United Kingdom business opportunities
  • Progressively taking ownership of the complete sales process from initial outreach through to conversion

The long-term objective is for you to become confident and capable of independently originating, developing and converting new business.

Sales Support and Infrastructure

Your focus will be on selling, rather than spending a significant proportion of your time researching companies or building prospect lists.

The business will provide the strategy, target markets, data and sales infrastructure required for you to execute effectively.

  • A dedicated Sales Operations team will support you with:
  • Defined Ideal Customer Profiles and target markets
  • Target account and contact data
  • Direct phone numbers and prospect information
  • Customer Relationship Management support
  • Aircall
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Email and supporting sales tools
  • Messaging and scripts
  • Campaign and sales training
  • Ongoing operational support

This structure is designed to allow you to spend more of your time speaking with prospects, developing relationships, progressing opportunities and generating new business.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong B2B outbound sales or new business development experience
  • Proven experience generating opportunities through proactive prospecting
  • Excellent cold calling skills and confidence speaking with senior business decision makers
  • A genuine hunter mentality with the ability to create opportunities from scratch
  • Experience conducting discovery and qualification meetings
  • Experience developing and progressing prospects through a B2B sales pipeline
  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage naturally and credibly with United Kingdom based decision makers
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to identify genuine business opportunities
  • Confidence working independently within a fully remote environment
  • Strong organization, follow up and pipeline management skills
  • Confidence using Customer Relationship Management systems and modern sales tools
  • A commercially minded and results focused approach
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with international teams
  • The ambition to develop into a self-sufficient, full cycle Business Development Manager

Nice to Have

It would be advantageous if you have:

  • Previous experience selling into the United Kingdom market
  • Experience working within an international sales environment
  • Experience using Aircall and LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience managing opportunities through multiple stages of a sales cycle
  • Previous experience selling professional services, technology or other B2B solutions

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role goes beyond simply booking meetings.

Initially, success will be measured through consistent prospecting activity, quality decision maker conversations, qualified meetings and the development of a healthy sales pipeline.

As you become established in the role, the focus will progressively move towards managing your own opportunities, conducting discovery meetings, progressing proposals and commercial conversations and ultimately converting new business.

Over time, the expectation is that you will be able to independently prospect, qualify, develop, manage and convert suitable opportunities.

Growth Opportunity

This is an opportunity to join at the beginning of an exciting United Kingdom expansion and play a meaningful role in helping build the operation.

As the business gains traction and secures additional United Kingdom clients, the intention is to grow the sales team by adding further Sales Development Representative resources.

For the right person, this creates the potential to progress into a more senior role within the United Kingdom operation with greater responsibility for business development, client growth and potentially supporting or leading additional sales resources.

We are therefore looking for someone who is comfortable being highly hands on today while also having the ambition and capability to grow alongside the business.

If you are a commercially driven Business Development Manager based in South Africa who thrives on creating opportunities, engaging senior decision makers and turning conversations into genuine commercial opportunities, we would love to hear from you.

  • Work a hybrid or remote schedule depending on geographic proximity to a BeyondTrust office; travel to offices or datacenters as needed (5–10%).

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of total network administration/engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on AWS cloud networking work with VPC design, Transit Gateway, VPN/Direct Connect, Route 53, network security controls across hybrid environments.

  • Experience implementing and maintaining security controls aligned with industry frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC2, and FedRAMP.

  • Strong analytical and cross-team communication skills; comfortable operating as a liaison between technical teams with different priorities.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with IPAM tooling such asNetBox, phpIPAM, Infoblox, BlueCat.
  • Experience with Azure networking services and hybrid connectivity.
  • Direct experience supporting a FedRAMP ATO or continuous monitoring (ConMon) process.
  • Formal project management or technical project leadership experience.
  • Proficiency in dynamic routing protocols (EIGRP, BGP) and in identity and access management services including RADIUS, TACACS+, Duo, Okta, and Cisco ISE.

jobs.excerpt: We, at Leggett & Platt Inc. , are searching for a Sr.
jobs.description:
We, at Leggett & Platt Inc., are searching for a Sr. EHS Specialist within our EHSteam to help support our UK Spring business. Did you know we have been revolutionizing the sleep industry since 1883? That’s right! In fact, we hold the original patent on a spiral steel coil bed spring, filed way back in 1885. Since then, we have been an industry leader in guaranteeing you get the best sleep possible. If you join our team, your work will ensure people across the world have a little more comfort in their lives.

As a Sr. EHS Specialist you will have the opportunity to support and strengthen EHS’ performance across its European operations. Reporting directly to the Regional EHS Manager, this role works closely with site EHS representatives and site leadership to help improve compliance, reduce risk, support practical EHS solutions, and promote consistent execution of BU and corporate EHS expectations. The role requires strong EHS and Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) knowledge, good judgment, and the ability to work independently while knowing when to escalate complex or high-risk matters.

So, what will you be doing as a Sr. EHS Specialist?

Leadership & Strategy

  • Support regional EHS plans and improvement activities aligned with corporate goals, BU priorities, and site-specific risks across Europe.
  • Serve as a regional EHS resource to site leadership teams on regulatory expectations, safety culture, employee engagement, and practical risk reduction.
  • Work independently to assess site needs, prioritize EHS actions, and recommend practical solutions, escalating complex or high-risk matters to the Regional EHS Manager as required.
  • Maintain visible field presence during site visits and provide hands-on guidance to local leaders, supervisors, employees, and EHS representatives.
  • Identify EHS capability gaps at assigned sites and help strengthen local ownership, accountability, and execution.
  • Promote consistent adoption of corporate EHS expectations while interpreting country-specific regulatory requirements and operating practices.

Incident Management & Corrective Action

  • Work collectively with site EHS representatives and site leadership to ensure incidents, near misses, and hazards are reported and investigated by the responsible site teams in accordance with company expectations.
  • Assist with incident investigations as needed, particularly for complex, recurring, or higher-risk events, by helping site teams evaluate facts, identify root causes, develop corrective actions, and consider the hierarchy of controls.
  • Analyze incident trends and recurring findings to identify systemic prevention opportunities and recommend practical process improvements.
  • Share lessons learned and support preventive actions across assigned facilities.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable EU-level requirements, national implementing legislation, and country-specific environmental and occupational safety and health requirements.
  • Conduct and support site inspections and assessments related to workplace conditions, work equipment, machinery safety, chemical management, dangerous substances, occupational exposure risks, emergency preparedness, and EHS program implementation.
  • Interpret internal and external compliance challenges and recommend best practices to improve EHS processes, controls, and site-level execution.
  • Develop practical action plans to close regulatory, program, and risk-control gaps and monitor progress through sustainable completion.
  • Provide technical guidance for environmental compliance activities, including waste management, hazardous substances, air and water requirements, permits, regulatory reporting, sustainability data, and related inspections or records.
  • Support implementation of ISO 14001, ISO 45001, REACH, CLP, ATEX, machinery safety, work equipment, and other applicable EHS requirements where relevant to assigned operations.
  • Support emergency response plans, first aid, fire prevention, procedures, drills, and preparedness activities based on local site risks and regulatory expectations.

Training & Development

  • Provide guidance/assistance to sites in coordination of required EHS training, including new hire orientation, annual compliance training, regional program rollouts, and site-specific safety topics.
  • Evaluate training needs based on incident trends, compliance findings, risk assessments, operational changes, worker feedback, site leadership input, and emerging regulatory expectations.
  • Coach site leaders and EHS representatives on safety communication, hazard recognition, worker engagement, accountability, and practical risk control.
  • Help strengthen site-level EHS knowledge and capabilities through education, coaching, technical guidance, and practical support.

Performance Monitoring

  • Track, evaluate, and communicate leading and lagging EHS indicators, including injuries, near misses, hazard observations, inspections, audit findings, corrective actions, and training completion.
  • Analyze EHS performance data to identify trends, recurring risks, and improvement opportunities that may affect compliance, operations, projects, or service objectives.
  • Prepare routine and ad hoc reports that communicate trends, priorities, risks, and recommended improvement actions to site, BU, and corporate leadership.
  • Partner with site managers to develop measurable action plans, assign clear ownership, and monitor progress through completion.
  • Maintain accurate EHS documentation, records, reports, and system entries in accordance with company and regulatory expectations.

Audits & Program Management

  • Lead periodic EHS audits and assessments to evaluate compliance, risk-control implementation, and program effectiveness.
  • Lead or support functional EHS projects with moderate risk or complexity, including regional program rollouts, corrective action initiatives, and continuous improvement efforts within assigned operations.
  • Help implement corporate EHS programs, tools, standards, and improvement initiatives in a way that fits regional and site-specific needs.
  • Follow up on audit findings and program gaps to ensure timely closure, effective verification, and sustainable improvement.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with HR, Operations, Legal, Engineering, Maintenance, site leadership, worker representatives, safety committees, and external agencies to support EHS initiatives and practical risk reduction.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive EHS/OSH topics clearly and professionally, while helping build agreement on required actions.
  • Influence leaders and cross-functional partners to improve compliance, reduce risk, and strengthen EHS execution.
  • Support site engagement with workers, worker representatives, and applicable safety committees in accordance with local consultation and participation requirements.
  • Represent Leggett & Platt professionally during regulatory inspections, agency interactions, customer inquiries, and industry forums.
  • Support customer sustainability inquiries related to finished goods by coordinating EHS, environmental, and product-related information as needed.

To be successful in this role, you’ll need:

  • Relevant Environmental, Health & Safety qualification, certification, or equivalent regional credential preferred, such as a NEBOSH, NVQ Level 5/6, or comparable qualification; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive EHS experience, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment with multi-site, regional, or cross-functional exposure.
  • In-depth practical knowledge of applicable EU-level EHS/OSH requirements, national implementing legislation, country-specific regulations, standards, and compliance expectations.
  • Strong practical knowledge of EU OSH principles and applicable environmental, chemical, machinery safety, work equipment, occupational exposure, waste management, and emergency preparedness requirements is preferred.
  • Demonstrates ability to identify known, potential, and emerging workplace hazards and recommend sustainable risk-reduction solutions.
  • Experience assisting with incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective action development, and verification of corrective action effectiveness in partnership with responsible site teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex or sensitive EHS information, prepare reports, communicate expectations, and influence others without direct authority.
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures, languages, and geographically dispersed operations.
  • Ability to travel regularly within Europe as business needs require.
  • Specialized EHS expertise with strong field presence and the ability to build trust with site leadership and employees.
  • Practical understanding of manufacturing operations, EHS controls, business priorities, and how EHS execution impacts operational performance.
  • Ability to guide others through complex problem solving using data, judgment, technical experience, and multiple sources of information.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, build agreement, influence action, and reinforce accountability across functions and cultures.
  • Ability to balance hands-on site engagement with broader regional priorities, project leadership, and sustainable program execution.
  • Ability to respond calmly and professionally to emergencies, regulatory inquiries, and changing priorities.

Things we consider a plus:

  • Experience supporting EHS programs in a multi-country European manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with manufacturing-related EHS programs such as ergonomics, machinery safety, work equipment, contractor safety, chemical management, and occupational exposure controls.
  • Experience using cloud-based EHS/EMS software platforms such as Enablon, Benchmark Gensuite, or similar systems.

jobs.excerpt: Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe PartnerErhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.
jobs.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Jetzt registrieren

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe-Seite.

  • Identify gaps, risks, and unusual requirements requiring technical review

Pre-Sales Support

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at .

What You’ll Do

You’ll join CoreWeave’s IaaS organization as the Engineering Manager for the Launch & Sandboxes team. The team owns two connected areas: Sandboxes, cloud execution environments that let practitioners run code in isolated, GPU-enabled containers, and Launch, the services and integrations that support job submission, compute orchestration, and HPC schedulers.

You’ll lead the engineering work that connects developer workflows to the compute where AI workloads run. The systems span Kubernetes clusters, HPC nodes, and cloud virtual machines, and are designed to make it easier for customers to launch, manage, and scale workloads across CoreWeave’s infrastructure.

About the role

As the Engineering Manager for Launch & Sandboxes, you'll be involved in the full product lifecycle, from ideation and roadmap shaping through delivery and being available for customers. Your day-to-day will involve partnering with product management to prioritize across competing initiatives, unblocking your engineers on cross-team dependencies, and ensuring the team ships reliably while managing technical debt. You'll need to be technically fluent enough to participate in architecture discussions around container orchestration, distributed authentication, and billing infrastructure, and you're not afraid to get your hands dirty when the team needs it.

At the same time, your primary focus is growing your engineers into autonomous leaders and technical decision-makers. We're an AI-forward organization that embraces LLM-based coding tools and agentic workflows to accelerate development, and we'd expect you to champion that culture within your team. This role carries a heavy customer and user focus: you'll stay close to how ML practitioners use the product and make sure that perspective drives your team's priorities.

Like any role at a hyperscaler, this comes with high accountability and ownership. You'll own your team's outcomes end-to-end, from roadmap commitments through production reliability. We expect engineering managers to make hard prioritization calls, hold the bar on engineering quality, and build teams that operate with autonomy and urgency.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of shipping infrastructure or platform products

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience prior to management, with backend systems depth

  • Technical fluency in Go, Python, and Kubernetes (you won't write code daily, but you need to review PRs, unblock architectural decisions, and understand production incidents)

  • Experience managing teams that own distributed systems in production

  • Demonstrated ability to balance product delivery with technical health (managing tech debt, reliability, on-call)

  • Experience partnering with product managers to shape and prioritize a roadmap

  • Track record of growing engineers across levels

  • Strong communication skills with both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially in newer product areas where scope is still being defined

Preferred

  • Experience with ML infrastructure, ML platforms, or developer tools for data scientists

  • Familiarity with compute orchestration, job scheduling, or container isolation technologies

  • Experience managing teams through a product area transition (e.g., early-stage to growth, or post-acquisition integration)

  • Background in HPC or scientific computing environments

  • Experience with billing systems, metering, or usage-based pricing infrastructure

  • Founding experience or early-stage background where you took a product from idea to the hands of users

Wondering if you're a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams, even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.

  • You're energized by building a team around a product area that is still finding its shape, not just maintaining something mature.

  • You care about developer experience and understand that infrastructure teams succeed when their users actually love the tools.

About Stripe

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About our organization

The Developer Experience & Product Platform (DEeP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that delivers high-quality, consistent, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. DEeP focuses on providing a scalable developer experience that any developer can leverage to accelerate a customer's ability to create value from Stripe.

Within DEeP, the Extensibility program is how Stripe expands its total addressable market, and increases customer retention. With extensibility, Stripe becomes programmable — customers and product teams can adapt Stripe to their needs on a common platform.

Stripe has three interconnected extensibility primitives:

Scripts — Secure, isolated TypeScript runtime allowing merchants and developers to customize Stripe product behavior (e.g., discount calculations, invoice logic, proration).

Custom Objects — User-defined data models (e.g., Shipments, Locations, Warranties, Entitlements) with first-class APIs, SDKs, and Dashboard experiences.

Workflows — A programmable orchestration layer (graduating to GA at Sessions) enabling no-code and pro-code business logic across Stripe, including custom actions, delays, smart retries, and 3P integrations.

These primitives are deeply interdependent, involve 10+ cross-functional teams and culminate in a flagship product launch.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a product-focused Technical Program Manager to drive the Extensibility program across the Workflows, Custom Objects, and Scripts workstreams. This is a newly created, high-impact role at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and cross-organizational program ownership.

In this role, you will own one of the most strategically consequential programs in DEeP — driving the direction, health, and outcomes of Stripe's Extensibility platform across Scripts, Custom Objects, and Workflows. You will set the program strategy in partnership with DEeP leadership, holding organizations accountable to the success of the program.

  • Drive cross-org decisions across DRIs in Script Platform, Custom Objects, Apps, SDK, Observability, DevEx, and Versioning — actively resolving the hard, ambiguous integration and ownership questions that fall between team boundaries.
  • Own the critical path to major launches — proactively shaping scope, driving descope decisions, and negotiating trade-offs across teams so that launches reflect deliberate strategic choices.
  • Influence and shape product and engineering roadmaps — bringing a program-level perspective to team planning cycles, pushing back where individual team roadmaps are misaligned with broader extensibility strategy, and advocating for cross-cutting investments that no single team will prioritize on their own.
  • Support ProServ and Partnerships — Ensure ProServ and Partnerships requirements are surfaced into the roadmap with the same rigor as product requirements, and hold the bridge between what the platform delivers and what those teams need to close and serve complex customers.

Qualifications

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of technical program management experience with demonstrated success in driving complex cross organizational programs.
  • Strong product sense and ability to understand enterprise customer needs
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate with precision and credibility across engineering, product, and executive audiences, translating complex technical trade-offs into strategic decisions, and driving alignment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align cross-functional teams — driving decisions, resolving conflict, and building consensus across organizations with competing priorities
  • Proven track record of successful program delivery in complex technical environments

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Payment Operations Engineer

Customer-Facing · Remote, Europe, Africa or Asia

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

Caliza moves money across fiat payment rails in the Americas, Europe and Asia, including Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA and CNAPS, as well as blockchains. Most payments flow through automatically. When one doesn't, our customers need someone who can work out exactly what happened, explain it clearly, and get it resolved.

That's this role. When a customer asks "where's my payment?", you'll own the answer. You'll follow the payment from their API call, through our internal systems and ledger, out to our partner banks, the payment rail or the blockchain, and back. Then you'll explain what you found to the customer, push the bank for answers when needed, and hand our engineers a precise problem when something is genuinely broken.

You don't need to be an expert in every system a payment touches, but you need to be able to follow one through all of them. You're comfortable reading logs, querying a database and decoding a bank message, and equally comfortable explaining what you found to a customer, a bank or an engineer. You'll build a deep understanding of how our rails really behave over time; we'll teach you the Caliza-specific parts.

Location: Europe, Africa, or Asia. You'll be based there so customers get help during their working hours, but the role covers every rail we operate, not just the ones in your region. Professional English required.

In your first six months, you'll

  • Learn how payments flow through Caliza end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoins.

  • Within three months, understand all of our rails well enough to handle most customer payment issues on your own, whichever rail they're on.

  • Own customer payment investigations during your hours, across every rail, keeping customers informed from first message to resolution.

  • Write runbooks for the issues you see most, so the rest of the team can rely on them.

  • Build at least one tool or automation that measurably reduces manual work.

What you'll be doing

  • Be the technical point of contact for customers with payment problems, especially when the answer isn't obvious.

  • Answer technical API questions from live customers, such as failed webhooks, error codes or unexpected payment statuses. Helping new customers integrate before launch is handled separately by engineering.

  • Trace payments across our API, internal systems, ledger, partner banks, rails and blockchain to find where things stand and what happens next.

  • Tell expected behavior from a real bug, and escalate to engineering with clear evidence when it's a bug.

  • Work with partner banks and providers on investigations, returns and recalls.

  • Support compliance with information requests about specific payments.

  • Tag the root cause of each issue so we can fix the most common ones for good.

  • Review new rails and corridors before launch, bringing an operational view of how they'll fail.

  • Write SQL queries and scripts to automate repetitive work.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years in a technical, customer-facing role at a fintech, payments company, bank or API-first business, such as technical support, payment operations or implementation.

  • A solid understanding of how payments work: statuses, settlement, cutoffs, finality, returns and recalls. Experience with any major rail is fine; we'll teach you ours.

  • Comfort reading JSON API requests, logs and webhooks.

  • Working SQL, and some scripting in Python or similar.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, for scripting, investigation or documentation, with the judgment to check what they produce.

  • A methodical approach to investigations: you form hypotheses and check them, rather than guessing.

  • Clear, calm communication with customers, especially when the full answer isn't known yet.

  • Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with any of our rails: Fedwire, ACH, SPEI, SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst) or CNAPS. Experience across more than one region is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with ISO 20022 payment messages (e.g. pacs.002, pacs.004, camt.053, camt.056).

  • Experience with stablecoins, crypto wallets or block explorers.

  • Experience working with partner or sponsor banks on investigations.

  • Familiarity with double-entry accounting and reconciliation.

How we work

We use AI tools every day and expect you to as well, for scripting, investigation and documentation alike. You own what you produce with them: you check it, understand it, and stand behind it. Because we handle customer and payment data, we follow clear rules about which data can go into which tools.

Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: This is a senior consulting design position.  You'll shift between owning projects from start to finish — running discovery, getting stakeholders on the same page, setting direction — and doing the hands-on design work yourself when that's what the engagement calls for.
jobs.description:
This is a senior consulting design position. You'll shift between owning projects from start to finish — running discovery, getting stakeholders on the same page, setting direction — and doing the hands-on design work yourself when that's what the engagement calls for.

The work centers on mature products already in the hands of real users. Success here means making what exists work better: streamlining workflows, tightening visual hierarchy, raising conversion, and cutting friction. There's little greenfield work and few obvious portfolio showpieces. If you take pride in making a live product measurably better for the people who rely on it daily, this will suit you.

What we need

  • 6–10+ years in UX or Product Design, preferably including consultancy, agency, or embedded-team work where client and stakeholder relationships were yours to manage.

  • Proven range: able to lead a project or small team one week and work as a senior IC the next, depending on what the engagement requires.

  • A history of strengthening existing products rather than launching new ones — with measurable gains in usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency to point to.

  • Sharp visual and UI instincts for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout, plus the ability to argue a layout choice on substance.

  • Fluency working alongside engineers against shipped code — you can look at a live interface and diagnose the problems before you ever open Figma.

  • Clarity in explaining the reasoning behind a design and the problem it solves, whether you're talking to an engineer or an executive.

  • Experience running cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.

Helpful, not required

  • Design experience in regulated or enterprise contexts (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, and the like).

  • Experience designing software that lives inside third-party platforms.

  • Familiarity with established component libraries and design systems such as MUI.

  • A track record of mentoring designers through critique and example.

  • Practical HTML/CSS knowledge; JavaScript is a bonus.

  • A degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or something adjacent — or equivalent experience.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning design problems on your assigned projects: framing the question, carrying it through discovery, design, and delivery, and keeping stakeholders with you at every stage.

  • Leading or contributing as the situation demands — directing the design effort at times, producing the work in Figma at others. Both should feel natural.

  • Working closely with product managers and engineers to turn vague requirements into concrete, testable solutions, then iterating against what's actually been built.

  • Running the full loop from rough exploration to high-fidelity handoff, validating with users at the moments where testing genuinely changes the answer.

  • Facilitating workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive groups — making decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.

  • Mentoring the designers around you and raising the standard of the work.

  • Building lasting stakeholder relationships: understanding the real goal behind the request, and pushing back thoughtfully when the brief itself is off.

We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

About this Role:

This role is a 3-month, W2, full-time contract (40 hours per week.)

Scope of the Role:

We are looking for detail-oriented Voice Specialists to evaluate the performance of AI models through real-time, voice-based conversations. In this role, you will interact with two different AI models using the same assigned scenario, carefully compare their responses, and provide structured evaluations based on defined quality criteria.

The goal of the evaluation is to create a fair, consistent comparison between models and identify which model delivers the stronger overall conversational experience.

What You’ll Own:

  • Review an assigned scenario and roleplay a natural conversation with two different AI models.
  • Conduct comparable conversations with Model A and Model B, keeping the scenario, conversational approach, and overall interaction as consistent as possible.
  • Maintain approximately the same number of conversational turns with each model to support a fair comparison.
  • Record your voice during each interaction and pay close attention to the quality and behavior of the model's responses.
  • Evaluate each model across five defined evaluation dimensions.
  • Identify and categorize relevant error clusters that may occur in the audio or conversation.
  • Compare the performance of Model A and Model B based on the evaluation criteria and your observations.
  • Select the model that demonstrated the stronger overall performance according to the defined evaluation framework.
  • Write a detailed rationale explaining your final preference, referencing specific examples and observations from both conversations.
  • Apply evaluation guidelines consistently across different scenarios and model interactions

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have

  • Bachelors Degree
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to notice subtle differences in conversational quality.
  • Excellent listening and comprehension skills.
  • Strong written communication skills, particularly the ability to explain observations clearly and objectively.
  • Ability to consistently follow detailed evaluation guidelines.
  • Comfort speaking naturally and role-playing different conversational scenarios.
  • Ability to compare two interactions fairly without allowing personal preferences to influence the evaluation.
  • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills.
  • Reliability and consistency when completing structured evaluation tasks.
  • Familiarity with AI assistants, voice-based AI, or conversational systems

  • Sharp experimental and statistical intuition; comfortable making decisions from messy, incomplete results and separating critical unknowns from nice-to-haves

Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

You will own and scale Pindrop’s strategic technology and channel alliances and turn them into repeatable, revenue-generating partnerships. You’ll be accountable for:

  • Growing strategic alliance relationships: Building executive and working-level relationships across partners’ product, partner, and field organizations. You’ll align on joint strategy, marketplace readiness, and co-sell priorities for Pindrop’s solutions across partner platforms.

  • Being the voice of the partner: Bringing partner and reseller feedback back to Product and leadership to shape roadmap, messaging, and support.

Who you are

  • Strategic and entrepreneurial: You’ve built partner programs from the ground up and are comfortable defining the playbook as you go.
  • Driven by the number: You think in revenue, pipeline, and growth rates. When you describe your work, you lead with business impact, such as quota attainment, partner-sourced revenue, and year-over-year growth.
  • Relationship-driven: You earn trust quickly with partner executives, technical teams, and channel sellers alike.
  • A skilled navigator: You know how to move through large, complex partner organizations to find the right stakeholders and get alignment.
  • Commercially sharp: You understand partner economics, pricing, and contracting, and you negotiate deals that work for both sides.
  • Collaborative and execution-minded: You rally cross-functional teams and follow through on what you commit to.

Your skill-set
Must-haves

  • 5+ years in partner alliances, channel sales, or partner ecosystem development at a software company
  • Proven track record of driving revenue through partnerships with resellers and/or other ISV partners, with quantifiable results (for example, partner-sourced revenue, % of pipeline from partners, and growth against target)
  • Proven track record of building and scaling reseller or channel programs
  • Strong understanding of contracting, pricing models, partner enablement, and partner economics
  • Understanding of the telecommunications space, with experience or relationships in the ecosystem
  • Conversant in Conversational AI technologies, including how AI agents and agent platforms are changing partner ecosystems and go-to-market models
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills

Nice-to-haves

  • Established relationships within contact center/CCaaS partner and integrator communities
  • Experience partnering on SaaS or enterprise software in voice, AI, security, fraud, or CX
  • Direct experience with NICE or CXone

What’s in it for you

This is a chance to own strategic alliances with real influence on Pindrop’s growth. You’ll have executive visibility, a clear mandate to build and scale our partner ecosystem, and a direct line to the business outcomes it drives. Fraud and deepfake attacks hit hardest in the contact center and across telecommunications and financial services, and your work will put Pindrop’s protection in front of enterprises at scale through the industry’s leading platforms and partners.

In an era where synthetic media, fraud, and identity manipulation are accelerating, we ensure that every interaction involves the real human and the right human. Our work directly protects financial institutions, enterprises, and consumers from fraud, deception, and identity compromise. You will wake up every day knowing your work has real-world impact.

You will work alongside some of the best technical minds in security, AI, and voice intelligence. We are intense about excellence, but we are also a team that enjoys the journey.

If you want to build something that matters, and be proud of the company you help shape, this is that opportunity.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!

  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer. This position is eligible for additional compensation in the form of commission payments.

US Base Pay Range
$130,000—$160,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Role Overview

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant architectural ownership. You will set the technical direction for how Backblaze detects, correlates, and responds to infrastructure incidents across our data centers, and you will mentor other engineers on the team as that platform matures. If you have a passion for making complex distributed systems visible, you are comfortable making architecture decisions that will outlive your tenure, and you are excited about applying AI and agentic automation to infrastructure operations, this role was built for you..

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Set technical direction and standards for observability across the organization, including instrumentation conventions, alerting philosophy, and dashboard design patterns.
  • Mentor engineers on the Observability team and act as a technical resource for SRE, Storage Engineering, and Network Engineering on observability practice.
  • Lead design reviews for observability work and represent the team in cross-functional architecture discussions.
  • Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions for observability and AIOps tooling, including data sovereignty and compliance considerations.
  • Produce and maintain design documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records that make the platform operable and extensible by future contributors.

Observability Platform

  • Own and evolve our metrics pipeline, including VictoriaMetrics, Prometheus, and the Consul-based service discovery layer that keeps scrape targets current as infrastructure scales.
  • Own and expand our logging stack (OpenSearch, Logstash, and Filebeat) across all Backblaze data centers.
  • Architect and expand distributed tracing with Jaeger and OpenTelemetry, extending coverage beyond the current application instrumentation to new services.
  • Define and maintain Grafana dashboard standards for infrastructure, storage, and application performance visibility.
  • Drive expansion of internal application telemetry in partnership with application teams to improve visibility.
  • Define capacity and retention strategy for the telemetry stack as the fleet grows.

Infrastructure & Automation

  • Own infrastructure-as-code for observability stack deployments across multiple Kubernetes clusters.
  • Write and review automated playbooks for configuration management and automation across Debian-based bare metal servers.
  • Partner with the SRE team on Consul-based service discovery for VictoriaMetrics scrape target automation.
  • Lead Ceph storage observability, including OSD health, performance metrics, and integration with alerting.
  • Collaborate with the Network Engineering team on BGP, routing, and network-level observability.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in a systems engineering, SRE, DevOps, or observability-focused role, including demonstrated technical leadership on a platform or infrastructure team.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, or equivalent metrics platforms, including PromQL, Alertmanager, and operating these systems at scale.
  • Experience designing and operating log aggregation pipelines such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Logstash, Filebeat, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of distributed tracing (Jaeger, OpenTelemetry, or equivalent), including instrumentation strategy, not just operation.
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Go for automation and tooling.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, including deploying workloads and understanding pod networking and storage.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling and configuration management.
  • Strong understanding of Linux internals, with Debian/Ubuntu preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You'll work across engineering, SRE, security, and leadership, and you'll be expected to write design documents that drive decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading the evaluation or deployment of AIOps tooling, including alert correlation, deduplication, or automated root cause analysis.
  • Experience building, deploying, or operating AI agents or agentic AI systems. This is a strong differentiator.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) or self-hosted LLM inference in an infrastructure context.
  • Familiarity with Ceph storage, including OSD management, pool configuration, and CRUSH maps.
  • Experience with incident management platforms.
  • Familiarity with BGP, network observability, or working in multi-DC environments.
  • Experience with secrets management in production environments.
  • Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-driven environment.
  • Prior experience in a storage-focused company or hyperscale infrastructure environment.

What You'll Work On

  • A telemetry stack spanning several data centers with exabytes of storage under observation.
  • Real infrastructure at scale: Kubernetes, Ceph, Vitess, KVM, and a custom storage platform serving hundreds of thousands of customers.
  • A collaborative team that values engineering excellence, transparency, and operational rigor.
