Who We Are

Insurity empowers insurance organizations to quickly capitalize on new opportunities by delivering the world’s most configurable, cloud-native, easy-to-use, and intuitively analytical insurance software. Just as importantly, we empower our people—providing the tools, support, and opportunities they need to grow and succeed.

We don’t just make bold promises—we deliver results. As the largest cloud-based software provider for the Property & Casualty market, Insurity is trusted by 22 of the top 25 P&C carriers and 7 of the top 10 wholesale brokers in the MGA space. Behind that trust is a team that delivers exceptional value and deep industry expertise.

While our technology sets us apart, it’s our people who truly make the difference. At Insurity, you’ll collaborate with some of the most creative and knowledgeable minds in insurance tech—in a culture that fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning. Our award-winning onboarding experience welcomes and supports you from the moment you accept our offer.

Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you. #UatInsurity

Insurity’s NextPartner Success Manager

We are looking for our next Partner Success Manager to help us manage our growing ecosystem of System Integrator and Technology Partners. You will be a critical cog in the gears that drive mutual revenue growth for both Insurity and your assigned ecosystem Partners.

 What Our Partner Success Manager Will Do

The Partner Success Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and operations of the Insurity Partner Program (IPP), launched in January 2026, and their assigned Partners. This role oversees onboarding and ongoing management of Partners, supports Partner operational requirements across their lifecycle, and helps design and execute/drive Partner-led GTM efforts to build qualified joint pipeline and drive incremental revenue for Insurity and our Partners. The Partner Success Manager also collaborates with Program leadership to design, implement, and refine AI automation processes that improve operational efficiency, velocity, and throughput.

Responsibilities will include the following for your assigned/named Partners:

Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned Partners throughout their lifecycle.
• Manage inbound Partner requests from initial engagement through exit, as needed.
• Perform due diligence on new Partner signup requests, present the Program, support joint GTM business plans, onboard partners and their resources into our systems, and help execute agreed tactical initiatives.
• Proactively communicate resources, training, product materials, marketing assets, Portal guidance, and QBR/EBR coordination needed for Partner success.
• Support Partner renewal processes and help execute structured Partner exit processes when required.
• Manage Partner communications such as newsletters and event invitations in partnership with Partner Marketing and Product.
• Manage Partner sponsorships of Insurity events and drive Partner Day attendance/sponsorship package sales with assigned Partners. Participate at Partner Day as deemed appropriate by Management.

Program Operations & Delivery

• Orchestrate Partner onboarding by creating Partner and contact records in SFDC PRM, assigning training, and ensuring required systems, environments, and tools are in place.
• Ensure accuracy and completeness of lead forecasting, deal registration, opportunity tagging, and related SFDC CRM/PRM updates for assigned Partners.
• Manage deal registration and assigned Partner sales pipeline processes, including overlap checks against direct sales, existing Partner submissions, and the current Insurity client base.
• Manage Partner legal agreement processing and coordinate with the appropriate internal stakeholders.
• Own Partner Sales Assist Fee (SAF) / referral fee calculations and payment tracking in partnership with Finance.
• Coordinate Program operations that support joint Partner marketing and sales activities, including campaigns, events, Campaign-in-a-Box, and Deal-in-a-Box initiatives.
• Lead Partner performance monitoring and reporting for assigned Partners, including annual promotion / relegation reviews within the Partner tiering model.

Internal Process

• Manage operational interactions within the PRM Partner Portal for assigned Partners, including operational “how do I...?” support.
• Create and maintain Program documentation such as Partner agreements, Program guidelines, GTM sales kits, and enablement assets.
• Track and analyze operational and performance metrics to identify trends, issues, and opportunities to improve Program effectiveness.
• Develop and implement approved automation and agentic AI-driven process improvements that streamline Partner Program operations.
• Drive continuous improvements in the overall Insurity Partner experience and Partner Program operations.
• Help design and launch our Operations AI Fleet of agents to automate many partner tasks for improved partner experiences.

• Other related duties as assigned

Who We’re Looking For 

  • 5–7 years of relevant business experience in enterprise SaaS Partner Success Management or a closely related role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (equivalent work experience may be considered).
  • Strong understanding of the Insurity Partner Program, Partner lifecycle management, and Partner-led GTM motions.
  • Working knowledge of Insurity products, SaaS / BaaS positioning, and how Partners generate qualified pipeline and revenue.
  • Familiarity with Partner scorecards, tiering models, incentive programs, and co-sell / referral processes.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise software operations; insurance / P&C market familiarity preferred.
  • Have the ability to perform these skills at an advanced level:
    • Ability to create concise, audience-relevant, objective-oriented documentation and communications.

    • Analytical and critical thinking.

    • Written and oral English communication.
    • Time management including work planning, prioritization, and organization.
    • Ability to handle multiple priorities or tasks.
    • Self-starter and quick learner.
    • Detail-oriented and process disciplined.
    • Active listening and cross-functional collaboration.
    • Expectation management.
    • Project management.
    • Process analysis, design, and management.
    • Data analysis and metric interpretation.
    • Business acumen and Partner Program acumen.
    • Technical acumen across SaaS systems and workflows.
    • Change management.
    • Coaching, training, and Partner enablement.
    • Meeting facilitation and professional presentation of information.
    • Partner advocacy.

  • Nice to have: complete one or more of the following:
    • Applicable insurance certification(s).
    • Salesforce / SFDC PRM-related certification(s).
    • Partner ecosystem / channel program certification(s).
  • Advanced experience & knowledge:
    • SFDC CRM and SFDC PRM.
    • PRM Partner Portal administration and support workflows.
    • Lead registration, opportunity management, and pipeline hygiene processes.
    • Workflow, ticketing, and project management tools.
    • Reporting, spreadsheet, and dashboard tools.
    • Document, knowledge-management, and enablement repositories.
    • Automation and agentic AI tools used to improve Partner operations.
  • Travel required 0-20%

What’s In It For U 

Work Where You Thrive
Find the work environment that supports your best—whether that’s remote, in-office, or hybrid—depending on your role and location. Our Flex First Workforce approach offers many fully remote opportunities, while some teams follow hybrid or in-office schedules to stay connected and collaborative.

Take Time When You Need It
We trust our team to manage their time with our Open PTO Policy, empowering you to recharge when it matters most.

Benefits That Start on Day One
Enjoy comprehensive health coverage and employer-matched retirement savings right from your first day—because we know how important these are to you.

Living Our Values Every Day
Our core values are more than words on a wall—they guide how we hire, grow, and retain the very best talent.

Award-Winning Onboarding
From your first day to your first anniversary, our onboarding program is designed to set you up for success and help you make an immediate impact.

Grow Your Career from Within
We believe in promoting from within. In fact, over 25% of our open roles are filled by internal candidates.

Mentorship That Matters
Our mentorship program connects you with experienced leaders who are committed to helping you grow both personally and professionally.

Insurity Podcasts
Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.

Keep Learning, Always
Fuel your growth with full access to LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan—because continuous development is key to success.

Invest in Your Future—And Your Family’s
Through our partnership with the University of Arizona Global Campus, you and your family can access discounted tuition and pursue educational goals affordably.

Earn When You Refer
Love where you work? Invite others to join us! Our Employee Referral Bonus program rewards you for bringing great people on board.

We have five Core Values at Insurity; one of which is to Act with Integrity.  Providing pay transparency helps you make the best decision for you.  We continuously analyze and update our salary ranges for our roles according to market trends to not only ensure our employees are paid fairly, but also help close gender, race, and disability wage gaps. Along with the benefits listed above, the career level salary range for this role is $70,000 to $140,000. We share a career level salary as a guideline; however, actual salary may vary based on your experience and qualifications. If your application advances, your recruiter will review these details with you during a video interview.

Insurity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer 

We are dedicated to creating an exceptional work environment for all our employees by extending a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging into the very fabric of our organization.  We embrace differences and diversity of identity, experience, and thought, and actively strive for inclusive behaviors across our company. 

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application and/or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.  Please contact us to request accommodation. 

Thank you for your interest in Insurity!  Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Nous ne nous contentons pas de faire des promesses audacieuses, nous obtenons des résultats. En tant que plus grand fournisseur de logiciels basés sur le cloud pour le marché de l'assurance IARD, Insurity bénéficie de la confiance de 22 des 25 plus grands assureurs IARD et de 7 des 10 plus grands courtiers en gros dans l'espace MGA. Chez Insurity, vous collaborerez avec certains des esprits les plus créatifs et les plus compétents de la technologie de l'assurance, dans une culture qui favorise l'innovation, le travail d'équipe et l'apprentissage continu. Notre expérience d’intégration primée vous accueille et vous soutient dès l’instant où vous acceptez notre offre.

Prêt à faire évoluer votre carrière au sein d'un leader du secteur ? Posez votre candidature dès aujourd'hui - nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir.

Le futur Responsable de la réussite des partenaires d’Insurity 

Nous sommes à la recherche de notre prochain responsable de la réussite des partenaires afin de nous aider à gérer notre écosystème en pleine expansion d’intégrateurs de systèmes et de partenaires technologiques. Vous serez un rouage essentiel du mécanisme qui favorise la croissance mutuelle des revenus d’Insurity et des partenaires de l’écosystème qui vous seront attribués.

Ce que notre Responsable de la réussite des partenaires fera 

Le gestionnaire de la réussite des partenaires est responsable de la gestion quotidienne et des opérations du programme de partenariat Insurity (IPP), lancé en janvier 2026, ainsi que des partenaires qui lui sont attribués. Ce poste supervise l’intégration et la gestion continue des partenaires, répond à leurs besoins opérationnels tout au long de leur cycle de vie, et contribue à la conception, à la mise en œuvre et à la conduite des initiatives de mise sur le marché menées par les partenaires afin de constituer un pipeline conjoint qualifié et de générer des revenus supplémentaires pour Insurity et nos partenaires. Le gestionnaire de la réussite des partenaires collabore également avec la direction du programme pour concevoir, mettre en œuvre et perfectionner des processus d’automatisation basés sur l’IA qui améliorent l’efficacité opérationnelle, la rapidité et le débit.

Vos responsabilités comprendront les tâches suivantes pour les partenaires qui vous sont attribués :

Gestion des relations

• Agir à titre de principal point de contact opérationnel pour les partenaires assignés tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Gérer les demandes des partenaires, de la prise de contact initiale jusqu’à la fin de la collaboration, au besoin.
• Effectuer une vérification préalable des nouvelles demandes d’inscription de partenaires, présenter le programme, appuyer les plans d’affaires conjoints de mise sur le marché, intégrer les partenaires et leurs ressources dans nos systèmes, et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des initiatives tactiques convenues.
• Communiquer de manière proactive les ressources, la formation, la documentation sur les produits, les outils de marketing, les directives relatives au portail et la coordination des QBR/EBR nécessaires à la réussite des partenaires.
• Soutenir les processus de renouvellement des partenariats et contribuer à la mise en œuvre de processus structurés de fin de partenariat lorsque cela est nécessaire.
• Gérer les communications destinées aux partenaires, telles que les bulletins d’information et les invitations à des événements, en collaboration avec les équipes de marketing et de produit dédiées aux partenaires.
• Gérer les commandites des partenaires pour les événements d’Insurity et stimuler la participation à la Journée des partenaires ainsi que la vente de forfaits de commandite auprès des partenaires assignés. Participer à la Journée des partenaires selon ce que la direction jugera approprié.

Opérations et exécution du programme

• Coordonner l’intégration des partenaires en créant des fiches de partenaires et de contacts dans SFDC PRM, en attribuant les formations et en s’assurant que les systèmes, environnements et outils requis sont en place.
• Veiller à l’exactitude et à l’exhaustivité des prévisions de prospects, de l’enregistrement des ententes, du balisage des occasions d’affaires et des mises à jour connexes dans SFDC CRM/PRM pour les partenaires assignés.
• Gérer l’enregistrement des ententes et les processus liés au pipeline de ventes des partenaires assignés, y compris les vérifications de chevauchement par rapport aux ventes directes, aux soumissions existantes des partenaires et à la clientèle actuelle d’Insurity.
• Gérer le traitement des ententes juridiques des partenaires et assurer la coordination avec les intervenants internes concernés.
• Assumer la responsabilité du calcul des honoraires d’assistance à la vente (SAF) des partenaires et des commissions de recommandation, ainsi que du suivi des paiements, en collaboration avec le service des finances.
• Coordonner les opérations du programme qui soutiennent les activités conjointes de marketing et de vente avec les partenaires, y compris les campagnes, les événements et les initiatives « Campaign-in-a-Box » et « Deal-in-a-Box ».
• Diriger le suivi de la performance et la production de rapports pour les partenaires assignés, y compris les examens annuels de promotion ou de relégation dans le cadre du modèle de classification des partenaires.

Processus interne

• Gérer les interactions opérationnelles au sein du portail des partenaires PRM pour les partenaires assignés, y compris l’assistance opérationnelle de type « Comment faire pour… ? ».
• Créer et tenir à jour la documentation du programme, telle que les ententes avec les partenaires, les lignes directrices du programme, les trousses de vente GTM et les ressources d’habilitation.
• Suivre et analyser les indicateurs opérationnels et de rendement afin d’identifier les tendances, les problèmes et les occasions d’améliorer l’efficacité du programme.
• Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de processus approuvées, fondées sur l’automatisation et l’IA agentique, qui rationalisent les opérations du programme de partenariat.
• Favoriser l’amélioration continue de l’expérience globale des partenaires d’Insurity et des opérations du programme de partenariat.
• Contribuer à la conception et au lancement de notre « flotte d’agents IA » opérationnels afin d’automatiser de nombreuses tâches des partenaires et d’améliorer ainsi leur expérience.

• Autres tâches connexes qui pourraient lui être confiées

La personne que nous recherchons 

  • 5 à 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente dans la gestion de la réussite des partenaires SaaS en entreprise ou dans un poste étroitement lié.
  • Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (une expérience professionnelle équivalente peut être prise en compte).
  • Excellente compréhension du programme de partenariat d’Insurity, de la gestion du cycle de vie des partenaires et des stratégies de mise sur le marché menées par les partenaires.
  • Connaissance pratique des produits Insurity, du positionnement SaaS/BaaS, ainsi que de la manière dont les partenaires génèrent un pipeline de prospects qualifiés et des revenus.
  • Connaissance des tableaux de bord des partenaires, des modèles de classification par niveau, des programmes d’incitation et des processus de vente conjointe et de recommandation.
  • Connaissance pratique des opérations liées aux logiciels d’entreprise; une connaissance du marché de l’assurance et de l’assurance de dommages est un atout.
  • Posséder les compétences suivantes à un niveau avancé :
    • Capacité à rédiger de la documentation et des communications concises, adaptées au public cible et axées sur les objectifs.
    • Esprit d’analyse et de réflexion critique.
    • Communication écrite et orale en anglais.
    • Gestion du temps, notamment la planification du travail, l’établissement des priorités et l’organisation.
    • Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités ou tâches simultanément.
    • Esprit d’initiative et capacité d’apprentissage rapide.
    • Souci du détail et rigueur dans le respect des processus.
    • Écoute active et collaboration interfonctionnelle.

    • Gestion des attentes.

    • Gestion de projet.

    • Analyse, conception et gestion des processus.
    • Analyse des données et interprétation des indicateurs.
    • Sens des affaires et connaissance approfondie du programme de partenariat.
    • Compétences techniques relatives aux systèmes SaaS et aux flux de travail.
    • Gestion du changement.
    • Encadrement, formation et autonomisation des partenaires.
    • Animation de réunions et présentation professionnelle de l’information.
    • Défense des intérêts des partenaires.

  • Atouts : posséder au moins l’une des qualifications suivantes :
    • Certification(s) en assurance pertinente(s).
    • Certification(s) liées à Salesforce / SFDC PRM.
    • Certification(s) relative(s) à l’écosystème des partenaires ou aux programmes de distribution.
  • Expérience et connaissances avancées :
    • SFDC CRM et SFDC PRM.
    • Administration du portail des partenaires PRM et processus de soutien.
    • Processus d’enregistrement des prospects, de gestion des occasions d’affaires et d’assainissement du pipeline.
    • Outils de gestion des flux de travail, de gestion des tickets et de gestion de projet.
    • Outils de production de rapports, de feuilles de calcul et de tableaux de bord.
    • Répertoires de documents, de gestion des connaissances et de formation.
    • Outils d’automatisation et d’IA agentique utilisés pour améliorer les opérations des partenaires.
    Déplacements requis : 0 à 20 %

Ce que nous vous offrons

Travailler là où vous vous épanouissez

Trouvez l’environnement de travail qui vous convient le mieux, qu’il soit à distance, au bureau ou hybride, en fonction de votre rôle et de votre lieu de travail. Notre approche Flex First Workforce offre de nombreuses possibilités de travail à distance, tandis que certaines équipes suivent des horaires hybrides ou au bureau pour rester en contact et collaborer.

Prenez du temps quand vous en avez besoin

Des avantages qui commencent dès le premier jour

jobs.description:
Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

jobs.description:
ABOUT OUR COMPANY:

The crushing weight of debt is something that we believe holds people back from reaching their dreams and making a splash in the world. So in 2013, after seeing our friends and family struggle with student loans, we created Splash Financial.

Over the years, our mission has expanded to include helping people with other forms of debt - such as refinancing credit cards, which are at all time highs in the US. And we’ve been able to refinance $6+ Billion in loans through our network of Splash, powered credit union and bank partners who leverage our marketplace and automated loan processing technology. And we’ve raised over $135 million from investors like partners of DST Global, Citi Ventures, TruStage Ventures, Northwestern Mutual Future Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners, and more.

But at our core, we’re still that little company from Cleveland with a big dream: to make people more powerful than their debt and we’re just getting started..

ABOUT OUR WORKPLACE:

Splash is remote-first, and proud of it — though our collections team works in-person at our Arizona location.

We spend our days simplifying financial products and getting them into the hands of people who need them most. Right now, we’re focused on building financial technologies that fundamentally transform how the industry lends.

Although Splash has been around since 2013, we still operate like a startup — fast-paced, nimble, and full of heart. We’re good people who care deeply about doing meaningful work and we approach challenges with creativity, passion, and urgency.

And to hire the best, we provide the best: great health insurance, competitive salaries, and unique benefits like quarterly meet-ups and access to engagement tools that keep us connected — even from afar.

At Splash, everything we do is guided by our values:

Own It – We take full accountability and follow through on commitments.

Raise the Bar – We move fast, innovate faster, and push through barriers.

Say the Hard Thing – We speak up with honesty, respect, and a desire to solve problems and make things better.

Elevate Each Other – We win as a team by lifting each other up.

These values show up in how we work and how we connect — whether we’re collaborating on big projects or bonding over everyday moments. Yes, we even have Slack channels for #kids-and-pets and #food because we believe being human makes us better teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Splash Financial is seeking an Operations Data Analyst who loves using data to solve problems and drive real business impact. You’ll help improve performance across multiple teams by:

  • Delivering data-driven insights that inform strategy and decision-making.
  • Using AI tools to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
  • Building the analysis behind business cases that support growth and operational excellence.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, eager to connect data to real-world outcomes, enjoys collaborating across teams, and is curious about finding better ways of doing things.

WHAT YOU’LL DO AT SPLASH:

  • Analyze servicing and collections performance along with application funnels and contact-center metrics.
  • Build and maintain automated reports and data files for our lending partners, investors, and vendors, working with your manager to map partner requirements to our data and deliver on time.
  • Maintain and extend data models in Snowflake and dbt, and support the dashboards Operations leaders use to run their teams.
  • Apply consistent key metrics definitions, help audit existing models, and reconcile our numbers against partner figures.
  • Identify performance gaps, test hypotheses with data, and build the analysis behind business cases and recommendations to leadership.
  • Apply AI tools to streamline analytics work (e.g., AI-assisted dbt development, automated request triage).
  • Partner with data engineering, product, and business teams to scope requests and deliver solutions.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO SPLASH:

  • 3+ years of experience in a Data Analyst or Business Analyst role.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience building and maintaining data models.
  • Proficiency with BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Tableau, or Power BI).
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to manage your own workload and deliver projects on time with minimal direction.
  • Experience working with AI/ML tools or implementing AI-driven solutions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or a high-growth environment.
  • Familiarity with Python or another programming language for data analysis.
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Master's degree in a related field.

WHAT MAKES YOU STANDOUT:

  • Business-Minded: Connects data to business impact, not just analysis.
  • AI & Analytics Curiosity: Excited to explore LLMs, predictive modeling, and new tools, and quick to put them to work.
  • Operationally Grounded: Uses data to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Clear Communicator: Turns data into clear, actionable stories for teams and leaders.
  • Collaborative: Builds trust and works well across Ops, Product, and other teams.
  • Ownership: Proactive self-starter who raises concerns early and follows through.
  • Adaptability: Shifts focus quickly as priorities change while keeping existing work on track.
  • Member-Centric: Always ties insights back to improving customer experience.

COMPENSATION:

The base salary range for this role is $61,000 to $97,000 annually, based on market data and internal compensation practices. Final compensation will be determined by factors such as location, experience, and skill level.

SPLASHERS ENJOY:

  • Fully remote work freedom (for most roles)
  • Competitive salary packages
  • Flexible PTO + 9 company holidays
  • Equity: Share in our start-up success
  • Comprehensive and affordable insurance benefits
  • Paid parental leave for both caregivers
  • Essential modern equipment to get the job done
  • Fully paid Claude subscription to supercharge your work
  • 401(k) for your future savings
  • Quarterly meet-ups: In person & virtual fun
  • Awesome Splash swag to flaunt your team spirit

Employment at Splash is based on individual merit. Opportunities are open to all, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, creed, age, handicap, national origin, ancestry, military status, veteran status, medical condition, marital status, sexual orientation, affectional preference, or other irrelevant factors. Splash is an equal opportunity employer.

JOB OFFER & RECRUITMENT SCAM NOTICE

At Splash Financial, we want candidates to feel confident and safe throughout the hiring process. Unfortunately, scammers sometimes pose as employers to trick job seekers into sharing personal information or money.

PLEASE BE AWARE:

  • Splash Financial will never ask for payment, banking details, or cryptocurrency as part of our hiring process.
  • All legitimate job communications from Splash Financial will come from an @splashfinancial.com email address.
  • We do not conduct interviews solely via text message or chat apps.
  • Any offer of employment will be made only after a formal interview process and will be sent directly from Splash Financial.

IF YOU RECEIVE A SUSPICIOUS MESSAGE:

  • Do not respond or share personal information.
  • Do not click on unknown links or download attachments.
  • Report the message to

About Reveal Technology

Founded in 2019, Reveal is a dynamic startup revolutionizing field operations by delivering software tools and intelligence to operators in remote, disconnected, and extreme environments. Reveal is the Digital Arms Room for the Modern Warrior — providing the tactical intelligence and automation platform for physical, human, and digital terrain at the edge.
Our flagship products include Farsight, a 3D processing and mission planning platform that transforms complex terrain into operational advantage, and Identifi, a secure identity verification solution designed for rapid, trusted identification in dynamic environments. In 2026, Reveal expanded its software portfolio to include Chronos and Anomaly 6, further strengthening its capabilities across the modern battlefield.
Reveal exists to serve defense, security, and public safety missions where time is compressed, information is contested, and precision matters. We are scaling our team and technology to meet the accelerating demands of modern warfare and national security.

About the Role

Reveal is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to lead product marketing for Farsight and Emerging Products as we deliver on our mission to Modernize the Warrior.
Farsight is a 3D mapping and terrain intelligence platform that turns drone, satellite, and sensor imagery into a single operational interface, empowering frontline units to plan, rehearse, and execute missions at the tactical edge.
Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, you will partner with the GM of our Geospatial Business Unit who leads Farsight, our CTO who leads Emerging Products, and Sales leaders to develop positioning, market strategy, and build and execute the mission-focused campaigns supported by your product portfolio. You will become fluent in our markets, customers, and products and translate those insights into differentiated messaging, compelling customer evidence, and integrated marketing campaigns.
This is a hands-on role spanning research, strategy, writing, and execution. You should be equally comfortable developing a product narrative, designing a sales deck or slick sheet, editing a video demo, manning a tradeshow booth, driving content generation at tactical events, and measuring KPIs.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Product Marketing for Farsight & Emerging Products: Own product marketing for your portfolio. Use customer, market, and competitive research to shape positioning, inform pricing, and develop GTM strategy with the Director of Product Marketing and your Product and Sales partners.
  • Develop and Execute Strategic Campaigns: Partner with BU and GTM leaders to develop and execute the Edge Mission Command, Agile Targeting, and Expeditionary Mobile Ops campaigns supported by Farsight and Emerging Products.
  • Build the GTM Kit & Sales Enablement Assets: Own the writing, design, maintenance, and adoption of your portfolio’s GTM assets, including sales decks, slick sheets, competitive battlecards, customer case studies, product videos, demos, and white papers.
  • Execute Email Marketing: Develop product-specific nurture content and sales outreach emails within Reveal’s centralized email marketing program, coordinating with Sales, Product, and Marketing Operations.
  • Drive Product Announcements: Develop messaging, customer evidence, and supporting assets for product launches, contract awards, and fielding milestones, coordinating with the Director of Product Marketing, Communications, Social Media, Product, and GTM partners.
  • Support Tradeshows & Field Demos: Own product messaging, content, and demo narratives for your portfolio at tradeshows, BattleLab, and field demonstrations. Partner with Events, Product, and Sales to engage priority customers, capture customer feedback, and advance opportunities.
  • Drive Lead Generation & Measure Success: Maintain monthly and quarterly scorecards tracking qualified lead generation, target customer engagement, sales enablement adoption, and pipeline progression for your portfolio. Partner with Sales to convert engagement into qualified opportunities and use results to refine strategy and tactics.

Requirements

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, mission-driven work ethic, and a high standard of excellence and culture.
  • 5–7 years of experience in Product Marketing, GTM Marketing, or a similar role at a high-velocity defense tech company or startup.
  • Experience in defense technology, national security, or government-facing technology markets, with an understanding of how user needs, technical evaluation, funding, and acquisition shape purchasing decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop product positioning and execute GTM campaigns in partnership with Product and Sales.
  • Strong customer research and market analysis skills with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations re: pricing, positioning, and GTM tactics.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Ability to write compelling narratives, key messages, and sales materials (no AI-generated copy) that translate product capabilities into customer value.
  • Demonstrated ability to create high-quality sales enablement assets, customer case studies, product videos, and demo content that support adoption and commercial growth.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to track meaningful KPIs, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality work.
  • Demonstrated ability to roll up your sleeves to write, design, build, and edit digital and video assets using Adobe, Figma, Canva, and Google Slides; manage projects; and build trusted partnerships across Product, Sales, Engineering, and Marketing.

Location

  • Remote
  • Strong preference to those located in Bozeman, MT or Washington DC

Compensation

  • Salary ($100,000 - $130,000) + Equity
  • Salary is determined by the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision coverage
  • HSA/FSA options

  • 401(k): 100% match for the first 6% contributed
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

Description

At Ledgebrook, we’re building a next-generation insurance infrastructure — fast, smart, and scalable — and are looking for a Chief Risk Officer to lead risk, actuarial, and reinsurance strategy for Stonehaven Specialty Insurance Company, Ledgebrook’s new third-party hybrid fronting carrier.

This role reports to the President and serves as one of Stonehaven’s independent control functions, with direct access to the Board of Directors. The Chief Risk Officer leads the enterprise risk, actuarial, reinsurance, and counterparty credit functions, and holds an equal seat with the Chief Program Officer and Chief Operating Officer in deciding which programs Stonehaven supports.

About the Role

Stonehaven is seeking a Chief Risk Officer to price risk, protect the balance sheet, and govern the counterparty credit exposure that comes with ceding the large majority of its premium. The successful candidate will be a seasoned risk executive with deep reinsurance, actuarial, and enterprise risk experience, a proven record of counterparty and collateral oversight, credibility with boards, regulators, and rating agencies, and the judgment to decline a program that does not clear Stonehaven’s appetite.

What You'll Do:

  • Draft Stonehaven’s risk appetite statement covering program, counterparty, concentration, and retained underwriting risk, including the exception and breach-escalation processes.
  • Build and own the enterprise risk management framework and ORSA, applying a three-lines-of-defense model, quarterly risk attestations from senior leaders, and stress testing for counterparty default, collateral failure, rating downgrades, and losses that exceed reinsurance caps.
  • Lead the actuarial function: validate third-party bordereaux data, set expected loss ratios and development patterns before each program onboards, monitor actual-versus-expected results quarterly, and reserve gross, ceded, and net, with the net reserved independently.
  • Ensure the retained share and any tail re-assumed above treaty caps are reserved and capitalized to full-carrier standards.
  • Set reinsurance strategy, including preferred treaty wording on security, downgrade, offset, insolvency, and dispute resolution; risk-transfer testing to preserve statutory credit; and placements that keep net retention within appetite.
  • Independently approve every reinsurer and collateral provider, including capacity that arrives attached to a program.
  • Own the Third-Party Credit Risk Policy across reinsurers, MGAs, TPAs, captives, banks, and intermediaries, including credit standards, hard concentration limits, the counterparty risk register, and the Watch List.
  • Require independent verification of all collateral, confirming letters of credit with issuing banks and trust assets with trustees, and maintaining collateral sufficiency with defined top-up triggers.
  • Assess every proposed program for actuarial soundness, risk-appetite fit, and secured reinsurance capacity before it writes business, as a member of the Program Underwriting Committee.
  • Lead the Risk & Capital and Reinsurance Security Committees, report risk, counterparty, and collateral status to the Board, and support the Reserve Committee and the independent actuary’s annual statement of opinion.
  • Partner with Finance on the Schedule F, RBC, and AM Best BCAR impact of reinsurance and collateral decisions, and with Technology on the contract management system, collateral register, and concentration monitoring.
  • Build and lead the risk organization, including actuarial, reinsurance and counterparty risk, portfolio and catastrophe risk, and risk data and reporting.

About you

We love working with people who are eager to learn constantly and genuinely excited about the chaotic, rewarding process of building a company from the ground up.

You’ll be a great fit if you bring:

  • A Strong Moral Compass: You believe in doing the right thing, period. We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for toxic behaviors.
  • Customer-First Empathy: You are passionate about delivering an exceptional experience to everyone you work with, both inside and outside the company.
  • Intellectual Curiosity: You naturally question the status quo and love finding innovative ways to solve problems.
  • A Growth Mindset: You possess a hunger for continuous learning and want to constantly expand your skillset.
  • Urgency & Prioritization: You can pivot quickly and balance the need to get things right with the speed of getting them done right now.
  • A Solution-Oriented Outlook: When things go wrong, you don't look for blame—you immediately focus on how to fix it.
  • Transparent Communication: You value honesty, clarity, and open feedback.
  • Team-First Energy: You want to win together as a high-performing team and actively build connections across our remote locations.

Requirements

Must Haves:

  • 15+ years in P&C actuarial, reinsurance, or enterprise risk, including senior leadership at a carrier, fronting carrier, or reinsurer.
  • Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society
  • Direct experience structuring and negotiating reinsurance treaties, including capped quota shares, sliding-scale commissions, and collateralized capacity.
  • Demonstrated counterparty credit and collateral risk management, including collateral verification, concentration limits, and watch-list governance.
  • Ownership of an ERM framework and ORSA, with board-level risk reporting.

Nice to Haves:

  • FCAS, CPCU, CERA, or FRM.
  • Prior experience at a fronting, hybrid fronting, or program carrier.
  • Experience with captive, ILS, or other collateralized reinsurance capacity.
  • Experience working with rating agencies and regulators on capital and risk matters.

Benefits

US Benefits

  • Full remote flexibility and asynchronous work culture.
  • Unlimited PTO and fully paid sick leave.
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus HSA and FSA options.
  • Additional financial protection and retirement benefits, including a 401(k), company-paid life insurance, and disability coverage.

Compensation

Compensation:

  • The base salary range for this position is $250,000-550,000. This is a good-faith compensation range based on what Ledgebrook reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of this posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to experience, qualifications and geographic location.
  • Employees in this position are eligible to participate in Ledgebrook’s equity incentive program.

For Candidates Applying From The U.S.:

Please note: This position is open only to candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. We are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

AI is used as a support tool, and hiring decisions are made by human recruiters. By submitting your information, you acknowledge that the company may use AI tools as part of our evaluation. In cosa consiste un incarico DriiveMe?

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

jobs.excerpt: JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides investigative support for special investigation unit (SIU) activities.
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides investigative support for special investigation unit (SIU) activities. Responsible for supporting for the prevention, detection, investigation, reporting, and when appropriate, recovery of money related to health care fraud, waste, and abuse (FWA). Responsible for reviewing and analyzing information to draw conclusions on allegations of FWA and/or may determine appropriateness of care, and recognizing and adhering to national and local coding and billing guidelines in order to maintain coding accuracy and excellence.

Essential Job Duties

  • Responsible for developing leads presented to the special investigation unit (SIU) to assess and determine whether potential fraud, waste, or abuse (FWA) is corroborated by evidence.
    • Conducts both preliminary assessments of FWA allegations, and end-to-end investigations, including but not limited to witness interviews, background checks, data analytics to identify outlier billing behavior, contract and program regulation research, provider and member education, findings identification and communications development, recommendations and preparation of overpayment identifications, and closure of investigative cases.
    • Completes investigations within the mandated period of time required by either state and/or federal contracts and/or regulations.
    • Conducts both on-site and desktop investigations.
    • Conducts low to medium, and extensive investigations, including reviews of medical records and data analysis, and makes determinations as to whether the investigation and/or audit identified potential FWA.
    • Performs accurate and reliable medical review audits that may also include coding and billing reviews.
    • Produces audit reports for internal and external review.
    • Coordinates with various internal customers (e.g., provider services, contracting and credentialing, healthcare services, member services, claims, etc.), to gather documentation pertinent to investigations.
    • Detects potential health care FWA through the identification of aberrant coding and/or billing patterns through utilization review.
    • Prepares appropriate FWA referrals to regulatory agencies and law enforcement.
    • Documents appropriately all case related information in the case management system in an accurate manner, including storage of case documentation following SIU related requirements.
    • Prepares detailed preliminary and extensive investigation referrals to state and/or federal regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies when FWA is identified as required by regulatory and/or contract requirements.
    • Renders provider education on appropriate practices (e.g., coding) as appropriate based on national or local guidelines, contractual, and/or regulatory requirements.
    • Interacts with regulatory and/or law enforcement agencies regarding case investigations.
    • Prepares audit results letters to providers when overpayments are identified.
    • Ensures compliance with applicable contractual requirements, and federal and state regulations.
    • Complies with SIU policies as and procedures as well as goals set by SIU leadership.
    • Supports SIU in arbitrations, legal procedures, and settlements.
    • Actively participates in Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU) meetings and roundtables on FWA case development and referrals.
    • May work with other internal departments, including compliance, corporate legal counsel, and medical affairs to achieve and maintain appropriate anti-fraud oversight.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of investigative experience in the health care industry, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Valid and unrestricted driver’s license.
    • Proven investigatory skills including ability to organize, analyze, and effectively determine risk with corresponding solutions, and remain objective and separate facts from opinions.
    • Knowledge of investigative and law enforcement procedures with emphasis on fraud investigations.
    • Knowledge of managed care and Medicaid, Medicare, and Marketplace programs.
    • Understanding of claim billing codes, medical terminology, anatomy, and health care delivery systems.
    • Understanding of datamining and use of data analytics to detect FWA.
    • Ability to research and interpret regulatory requirements.
    • Effective interpersonal skills and customer service focus; ability to interact with individuals at all levels.
    • Strong presentation skills with ability to create and deliver training, informational and other types of programs.
    • Strong logical, analytical, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.
    • Strong sense of initiative, excellent follow-through, and persistence in locating and securing needed information.
    • Fundamental understanding of audits and corrective actions.
    • Ability to multi-task and operate effectively across geographic and functional boundaries.
    • Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to meet tight deadlines.
    • Ability to develop realistic, motivating goals and objectives, track progress and adapt to changing priorities.
    • Energetic and forward-thinking with high ethical standards and a professional image.

• Collaborative and team-oriented.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
    • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software program(s) proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in government programs (i.e., Medicare, Medicaid, Marketplace).

• Experience in FWA or related work.

  • Accredited Health Care Fraud Investigator (AHFI) and/or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE).

  • Synthesize customer feedback and partner with Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Data Science to identify and reduce product friction.

MultiTech is a global company with a 50+ year legacy of designing and manufacturing connectivity solutions for a broad range of industries. We are gearing up for the next phase of our journey and are seeking top talent to bolster our team. Our people are our greatest asset and we’re focused on making MultiTech the employer of choice in the industry.

SUMMARY: The Account Manager owns a portfolio of roughly 8–15 established mid-tier customers and is accountable for growing them by building and running account plans, expanding assigned accounts into new product lines and connectivity services, building relationships beyond a single buying contact, and structuring commercially sound deals with our deal desk. This role collaborates closely with Business Development, the deal desk, Product, Engineering, and Operations.

NUMBER OF POSITIONS OPEN: 2

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Portfolio Ownership & Growth

  • Own revenue growth and retention across an assigned portfolio of roughly 8–15 mid-tier accounts, against an annual growth target
  • Track buying patterns across the portfolio and proactively act on changes such as expansion signals, slowing orders, or competitive pressure
  • Identify and drive cross-sell into new product lines and MultiTech connectivity services
  • Partner with Business Development to take over newly won accounts and move them smoothly into managed coverage

Account Planning & Business Reviews

  • Maintain a one-page account plan for each account, refreshed semi-annually to feed the budgeting and quota cycle, such as: current revenue by product line and trend; buying-center map and contact coverage; the customer’s business context and roadmap; 2–3 named opportunities with value and next step; and key risks (competitive exposure, single-threading, product lifecycle, and contract renewal)
  • Run quarterly business reviews with the larger accounts in the portfolio

Relationships & Multi-threading

  • Hold credible conversations about connectivity, integration, and product fit, bringing in technical specialists for deeper engagements
  • Manage long, multi-stakeholder industrial sales cycles through to decision
  • Build relationships beyond the primary buying contact, reaching the wider buying center across engineering, operations, procurement, and leadership

Deal Execution & Pipeline

  • Work quotes through the deal desk, structuring commercially sound deals on value, volume, and terms (vs. defaulting to discounts)
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, opportunity, and contact data in CRM as the leading indicator of portfolio health
  • Forecast portfolio revenue and flag risks early, including at-risk renewals, single-threaded accounts, and product end-of-life transitions
  • Coordinate with Operations and Product on lead times, lifecycle changes, and escalations that affect account health

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a technical field, or equivalent experience
  • 2–5 years of B2B experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, or applications/sales engineering
  • Self-directed and organized enough to run account plans across 8–15 relationships without being chased
  • A proven track record of growing accounts through your own targeted initiative
  • Experience in industrial hardware, electronics, IoT, or connectivity a plus
  • Technically literate; credibly discusses connectivity, integration, and product fit
  • Commercially curious; notices when a customer’s buying pattern shifts and takes appropriate action
  • Clear written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to customer leadership in business reviews
  • Comfortable with long, uneven sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying
  • Experience with a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Lifting requirements up to 25 pounds.
  • Requires sitting for periods of time
  • Requires travel using all modes of transportation.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This is a remote position. Work is performed primarily from a home office, with regular travel to customer sites. Minimal noise.
  • Our Minnesota facility includes a manufacturing environment. Moderate noise level. Machinery operation requires the use of safety equipment to include but not limited to; safety glasses, hearing protection, wrist and shoe straps, and ESD smock. Loose fitting clothing and jewelry are not permitted. No food is allowed in the manufacturing area. No cell phone use allowed in manufacturing area unless approved by management.

EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS USED:

Laptop computer Standard office equipment

But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. As an Online Data Analyst, you will use your knowledge of Switzerland, together with online research and project guidelines, to review and evaluate map, location, business, and search information. jobs.title: Senior/Principal Algorithms Engineer, Power Applications
jobs.excerpt: Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid, bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.

The Power Applications team takes power orchestration algorithms from idea to production. We develop, ship, and maintain the applications that run on Karman to orchestrate closed-loop control actions and deliver quantifiable customer value. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role. As a Senior Algorithms Engineer, you will develop and deliver these control algorithms, working day to day with the principal engineer who owns our control architecture. You will develop the theory behind our algorithms, validate them against real hardware and realistic workloads, implement them in production code alongside our software engineers, and stay with them in the field, measuring, tuning, and improving them release after release.

Your time will be split between improving the algorithms already in production and R&D for the next iterations of the product, from smarter forecasting and online learning to orchestration across larger portions of a data center and new generations of GPU hardware.

Strong candidates come from many paths. Some lean toward control theory and estimation, others toward building and hardening real-time systems. Both are welcome. What we require is rigor, a systems mindset, and the drive to see your work shipped and owned.

Responsibilities
  • Design, analyze, and deliver improvements to the control and orchestration algorithms that allocate and enforce power across servers, racks, and rows at high speed and with hard reliability guarantees
  • Own algorithms end to end: theory and prototyping (Python), production implementation (Rust and Python), validation, deployment, and ongoing tuning in the field
  • Help to define how we measure algorithm performance, from adherence to electrical limits to impact on compute throughput, and build the benchmark and regression suites that hold each release to that bar
  • Continuously improve the performance, robustness, and operability of the algorithm-driven services already in production
  • Drive R&D that de-risks and shapes future product iterations (forecasting, automated parameter tuning, orchestration at larger scales, new compute and actuation hardware), running experiments in our lab and pilot environments and turning results into clear decisions
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, physics, mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Deep expertise in control systems and mathematical optimization, including feedback control, state estimation, and the practical realities of latency, noise, and missing data, ideally in distributed or edge settings
  • A track record of taking algorithms from concept to production in physical systems, owning their performance once deployed, and designing them to fit the whole system rather than optimizing components in isolation
  • Strong Python skills for prototyping and analysis (e.g. pyspark, tensorflow, pytorch) and the ability to work in production codebases in a systems language (we use Rust, and will support you in learning it)
  • Comfort in a continuous delivery environment: working directly in production repositories, writing tests, reviewing code, and using field performance data to understand and improve algorithms
  • Excellent written communication and the habits of a strong remote teammate: proactive updates, thorough documentation, empathy, and assuming good intent
  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time
Enhanced Qualifications (Nice to Have)
  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in control, electrical or mechanical engineering, applied mathematics, robotics, computer science, or a related field, or similar research experience
  • Background in power systems or data center electrical infrastructure, including protection, power quality
  • Experience with time series forecasting, or learning-based control, including online learning and re-enforcement learning frameworks
  • Experience with GPU power management (NVML, DCGM, or BMC/Redfish) or with LLM inference serving and its telemetry
  • Experience with LLM inference stacks (e.g vLLM, Dynamo)
  • Publications or open-source contributions in state estimation, optimization, or control
  • Experience driving model development workflows in DataBricks, including exploratory data analysis, feature extraction, and model prototyping
Salary Range: $170,000 to $220,000 base compensation depending on experience plus stock options. Salary will be commensurate with an individual's skills, training, years of experience, and in line with internal compensation bands.

Location: This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States. Preference will be given to candidates based in Michigan with the ability to work on site in Utilidata’s headquarters.

Our Commitments: Karman values the diversity of our team. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or childbirth, sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, or status as a covered veteran or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws.

We are committed to:
  • Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is welcoming, supportive, affirming and respectful
  • Empowering employees to solve problems and work together to make a difference
  • Providing mentorship and growth opportunities as part of a collaborative team
  • A flexible work environment with flexible paid time off
  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including health, dental, vision, and employer-match 401k

About Quaker Houghton

At Quaker Houghton, we are experts in the development, production and application of industrial process fluids, lubricants and coatings for the manufacturing industry. We have been an integral part in the growth of the world’s largest industrial and manufacturing companies from aerospace and automotive to primary metal and energy. Today, we have a global presence, with our corporate headquarters located in the PA, USA. Quaker Houghton is a global publicly traded company with a unique collaborative culture that supports career growth for its associates.

Your responsibilities

The EMEA Procurement Specialist supports the procurement, quotation, supplier management, and order fulfilment processes for Fluid Intelligence and third-party equipment across EMEA.

This role partners with Commercial, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Procurement, Accounting, and external suppliers to ensure equipment quotations, purchasing activities, and customer orders are completed accurately, efficiently, and in line with company processes. The position requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, stakeholder collaboration, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Obtain and review supplier quotations, ensuring pricing, specifications, lead times, and commercial terms are accurate.

  • Prepare and maintain equipment quotation information for Commercial and Fluid Intelligence teams.

  • Create and maintain product, supplier, and pricing data within JD Edwards and other relevant systems.

  • Collaborate with Customer Service and other stakeholders to support accurate and timely equipment order processing.

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new suppliers in partnership with Procurement and Finance teams.

What we are looking for

  • Qualification in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Administration, Logistics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum of 5 years experience in procurement, purchasing, order management, supply chain, or commercial support.

  • Experience working with suppliers, quotations, purchasing processes, and order fulfilment.

  • Experience using ERP systems; JD Edwards experience is advantageous.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and data management skills.

  • Experience within manufacturing, industrial, engineering, or technical environments is beneficial.

  • Knowledge of transportation, shipping, customs, and inventory planning systems is advantageous.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills; additional languages are a plus.

Your benefits

We support you with a company pension plan, private pension, and life & disability insurance for your financial security.

Enjoy flexible working hours, remote work options, and home office equipment including a home office setup to support your daily work.

Benefit from travel expenses compensation, free parking, paid sick leave, parental leave, and 25 vacation days per year based on a 36-hour work week.

Your first months at Quaker Houghton

You will have familiarized yourself with our regional supply chain networks and established direct communication channels with our key suppliers across EMEA. During this time, you will also take ownership of ongoing procurement processes and begin implementing data-driven improvements for our fluid intelligence operations.

Who are we?

We are the global leader in industrial process fluids present in 40+ countries continually improving and innovating so the world’s steel, aluminium, automotive, aircraft, machinery and industrial parts manufacturers can stay ahead in a changing world. Throughout our 100+ locations, our chemists, engineers and industry experts partner with our customers to continually improve their operations so they can run even more efficiently, even more effectively, whatever comes next.

Our values:

Live Safe

Act with integrity

Exceed Customer Expectations

Drive Results

Do Great Things Together

Our core values embody who we are as a company, guide our decisions and inspire us. Our commitment to these values, in words and actions, builds a safer, stronger Quaker Houghton. They are the fundamental beliefs that guide our internal conduct and our relationship with the outside world.

jobs.excerpt: Data Engineer, Marketing Technology About Us:Foxit is remaking the way the world interacts with documents through advanced PDF technology and tools.
jobs.description:
Data Engineer, Marketing Technology

About Us:

Foxit is remaking the way the world interacts with documents through advanced PDF technology and tools. We are a leading global software provider of fast, affordable, and secure PDF solutions that are used by millions of people worldwide. Winner of numerous awards, Foxit has customers in more than 200 countries and global operations. We have a complete product line and an exciting and aggressive development schedule. Our proven PDF technology is disrupting the status quo establishment and has accelerated our company growth. We are proud to list as customers Google and Amazon, and with your skills and help, we plan to add many more. Foxit has offices all over the world, including locations in the US, Asia, Europe, and Australia.

For more information, visit us @

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to own the data pipelines that power our go-to-market systems. While this role is aligned to the marketing department's priorities, you will work day-to-day within our Business Applications & Data Analytics team, following the team's established development standards, architecture patterns, and code review processes. This ensures the pipelines you build are consistent with our broader data platform and maintainable by the wider engineering team.

Your primary focus will be marketing-related data needs - working closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales operations, and digital teams to understand their requirements, then building and maintaining the pipelines and integrations that deliver on them.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will build and operate the data infrastructure that connects our marketing automation platform (HubSpot), CRM (Salesforce), data warehouse (Databricks), licensing system, payment platform, and other source systems. Your work will directly support marketing's ability to segment audiences, measure attribution, and run data-driven campaigns at scale.

What You'll Do

Data Pipeline Development & Operations

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, building upon and further optimizing our existing medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) to move data between source systems (Salesforce CRM, HubSpot, NetSuite, Stripe, DealHub, LMS) and our Databricks data warehouse.
  • Build pipelines using PySpark and SQL in Databricks notebooks, following established development standards for naming, project structure, and layer-appropriate transformations.
  • Own the data sync layer between Databricks and HubSpot — enrichment flows inbound to HubSpot (license status, renewal dates, subscription state, firmographic data) and marketing engagement data flowing back to Databricks (email events, workflow enrollment, lifecycle changes).
  • Build and maintain Exchange layer pipelines that curate data for external system consumption, formatting and validating data to meet target system requirements.
  • Build and maintain scheduled batch jobs and event-driven integrations using APIs (REST, webhooks, OAuth).
  • Monitor pipeline health, set up alerting for failures and data quality degradation, and own incident response when syncs break.
  • Maintain documentation of data flows, integration architecture, and troubleshooting runbooks.

Data Modeling & Quality

  • Build and maintain dimensional models in Databricks (fact tables, dimension tables, bridge tables) following our data warehouse object type definitions and naming standards.
  • Work in collaboration with stakeholders and data analysts to build curated, business-ready tables and datamarts that apply business logic, KPI calculations, and aggregations optimized for analytics and campaign activation.
  • Implement identity resolution and deduplication logic to produce unified customer profiles from multiple source systems.
  • Establish data validation rules, quality checks, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and freshness of data flowing into marketing systems.
  • Normalize disparate data sources into clean centralized schemas with proper type enforcement, deduplication, and null handling.

Marketing Data & Segmentation Support

  • Ensure the data infrastructure supports audience segmentation, including firmographic, behavioral, and engagement signals.
  • Build the data layer that powers lifecycle marketing - triggered campaigns, dynamic journey branching, and personalization based on enriched customer profiles.
  • Support marketing and demand gen teams with reliable, accessible data for building audience targets in HubSpot.
  • Maintain data flows for email deliverability, subscription management, and suppression list synchronization.

Integration Development

  • Build and maintain API integrations between marketing, sales, and operational systems using Python and SQL.
  • Implement field-level transformation logic, sync orchestration, and error handling for system-to-system data flows.
  • Support website form and lead capture data flows - ensuring clean handoff from web properties into HubSpot and Databricks.
  • Work with third-party enrichment providers (firmographic, intent, technographic) to integrate enrichment data into automated workflows.

Reporting & Attribution

  • Build and maintain the data infrastructure that supports campaign attribution, channel performance analysis, and funnel reporting.
  • Ensure accurate data for conversion analytics, lead source tracking, and marketing ROI measurement.
  • Support centralized reporting by routing marketing engagement data back into Databricks for cross-functional analysis.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, with hands-on pipeline development and production operations.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python/PySpark for data pipeline development.
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms - Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Solid understanding of dimensional data modeling - fact tables, dimension tables, schema design, and data warehouse concepts.
  • Experience with medallion or layered data architectures (raw → cleansed → business-ready), Kimball-style star schemas, and one-big-table approaches to data modeling.
  • Working knowledge of API integration patterns - REST, webhooks, OAuth, batch sync architectures.
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), marketing automation systems, and CPQ/quoting tools (DealHub or similar).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent industry experience.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, PySpark, Unity Catalog).
  • Familiarity with HubSpot APIs and data model.
  • Experience with identity resolution and customer data deduplication across multiple source systems.
  • Exposure to marketing data concepts — lead scoring, audience segmentation, campaign attribution, lifecycle stages.
  • Experience with Azure cloud services (Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, Azure Data Factory).
  • Knowledge of data security and privacy practices, particularly regarding PII handling.
  • Experience with code review processes and development standards compliance in a collaborative data engineering team.

What Sets You Apart

  • You've built and operated production data pipelines that marketing teams depend on daily - you understand the impact of data freshness and accuracy on campaign execution.
  • You're comfortable working within a marketing department and can translate data requests from non-technical stakeholders into pipeline requirements.
  • You take ownership of pipeline reliability - building monitoring and alerting proactively rather than waiting for someone to report a problem.
  • You've worked with multiple data sources and know how to handle the messiness of real-world identity resolution and deduplication.

Why Join Us

  • High-impact work. Your pipelines will directly power how our marketing engine operates and scales.
  • Modern stack. Databricks, Delta Lake, PySpark, HubSpot, Python, SQL - you'll work with current tools, not legacy systems.
  • Room to build. We're investing in our data infrastructure as part of a major platform migration, and you'll shape how it's built.
  • Collaborative environment. You'll work closely with marketing, sales, and IT teams - visible, cross-functional work without being siloed.

Foxit is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

What began as a self-serve growth surface (Station) is becoming the customer-facing window into Veriff's accuracy and fraud advantage for our largest enterprise customers.

The shape of this role

This is an IC-first leadership role, and the first genuine step into product leadership — distinct from a strong senior IC. At first you will lead through craft, authority and influence. You own the strategy, discovery, roadmap and delivery for your product area.

As you refine the strategic themes for this large product, we expect you to propose the team configuration needed to support our growth and company objectives. That will move you progressively from IC to manager, while retaining hands-on ownership of at least one part of the Customer Portal area in the mid-term. We will deliberately assess for both the IC craft bar and the latent management capability, because the role is designed to traverse the line.

What you will do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the Customer Portal area, tied explicitly to Veriff's commercial model and revenue drivers.
  • Run disciplined, continuous discovery with customers, and translate it into well-defined problem statements and a sequenced roadmap.
  • Make transparent prioritisation and trade-off calls across product ambition, technical sustainability and business urgency — especially where capability gaps mean we cannot do everything at once.
  • Define success metrics before building, and hold the team accountable to outcomes, not output.
  • Partner as a credible peer to Engineering, GTM, Fraud Ops and Design. Be the connective tissue that turns internal expertise into a customer-facing product.
  • Own launch as a discipline from the start — internal platform releases and external GTM — not a milestone at the end.
  • Set and uphold the product-craft bar. Mentor PMs and, in time, build and lead the team.

Who you are

You are a product leader who has earned authority through the quality of your thinking rather than a title.

You have owned a product area end-to-end
